verses.1:1: Blessed is the man who has not walked by the counsel of the wicked, has not stood on the path of sinners, and has not sat in the seat of mockers.
verses.1:2: Instead, his delight is in the instruction of the LORD, and he meditates on His instruction day and night.
verses.1:3: And he will be like a tree planted beside channels of water, which gives its fruit in its season, and its leaf does not fade; and everything he does will succeed.
verses.1:4: The wicked are not like this; instead, they are like chaff that the wind drives off.
verses.1:5: For this reason, the wicked will not stand up in the judgment, nor sinners in the community of the righteous.
verses.1:6: For the LORD knows the path of the righteous, yet the path of the wicked will perish.
verses.2:1: Why are the nations in tumult, and why do the peoples plot emptiness?
verses.2:2: The kings of the earth station themselves, and the rulers confer together against the LORD and against His anointed one.
verses.2:3: "Let us snap their bonds and fling their ropes away from us!"
verses.2:4: The One seated in the heavens laughs; the Lord mocks them.
verses.2:5: Then He will speak to them in His anger, and in His burning wrath He will terrify them:
verses.2:6: "Yet I Myself have established My king on Zion, My holy mountain."
verses.2:7: I will recount the decree: the LORD said to me, "You are My son; today I Myself have fathered you.
verses.2:8: Ask Me, and I will give the nations as your inheritance, and as your possession the ends of the earth.
verses.2:9: You will smash them with an iron rod; like a potter's vessel you will shatter them."
verses.2:10: And now, kings, act wisely; accept correction, judges of the earth.
verses.2:11: Serve the LORD with reverence, and exult with trembling.
verses.2:12: Kiss the son, or He will grow angry and you will perish along the path, for His anger may soon blaze up. Blessed are all who seek refuge in Him.
verses.3:1: A psalm of David, when he was fleeing from his son Absalom.
verses.3:2: LORD, how my foes have multiplied! Many rise against me.
verses.3:3: Many say about my soul, "He has no deliverance in God." Selah.
verses.3:4: Yet You, LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the One who raises my head.
verses.3:5: With my voice I call out to the LORD, and He answers me from His holy mountain. Selah.
verses.3:6: As for me, I lay down and slept; I woke up, because the LORD upholds me.
verses.3:7: I will not fear tens of thousands of people who have positioned themselves against me on every side.
verses.3:8: Rise up, LORD! Deliver me, my God! For You have struck all my enemies on the jaw; the teeth of the wicked You have shattered.
verses.3:9: To the LORD belongs deliverance; may Your blessing be upon Your people. Selah.
verses.4:1: For the music director, on stringed instruments. A psalm of David.
verses.4:2: When I call, answer me, God of my righteousness; in distress You have made room for me. Show me favor and hear my prayer.
verses.4:3: Sons of men, how long will my glory be turned to disgrace? How long will you love emptiness and seek falsehood? Selah.
verses.4:4: And know that the LORD has set apart a faithful one for Himself; the LORD will hear when I call to Him.
verses.4:5: Tremble and do not sin; speak in your heart on your bed, and keep silent. Selah.
verses.4:6: Offer sacrifices of righteousness, and place your trust in the LORD.
verses.4:7: Many say, "Who will let us see good?" Lift up the light of Your face over us, LORD.
verses.4:8: You have placed joy in my heart, more than at the time when their grain and their new wine multiply.
verses.4:9: In peace I will at once lie down and sleep, for You alone, LORD, cause me to dwell in security.
verses.5:1: For the music director, for the Nehiloth. A psalm of David.
verses.5:2: Listen closely to my words, LORD; discern my groaning.
verses.5:3: Pay attention to the sound of my cry for help, my King and my God, for it is to You I pray.
verses.5:4: LORD, in the morning You will hear my voice; in the morning I will set my plea in order for You and keep watch.
verses.5:5: For You are not a God who finds delight in wickedness; evil does not sojourn with You.
verses.5:6: The boastful will not take their stand before Your eyes; You hate all who practice iniquity.
verses.5:7: You destroy speakers of falsehood; the LORD detests a man of bloodshed and treachery.
verses.5:8: Yet as for me, by the abundance of Your loyal love I will come into Your house; I will bow low toward Your holy sanctuary in fear of You.
verses.5:9: LORD, guide me in Your righteousness on account of my foes; make Your way level before me.
verses.5:10: For there is nothing trustworthy in his mouth; their inward being is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb; they make their tongue smooth.
verses.5:11: Pronounce them guilty, God; let them fall through their schemes. Because of the multitude of their transgressions drive them out, since they have rebelled against You.
verses.5:12: Yet may all who seek refuge in You rejoice; may they shout for joy forever, and may You extend shelter over them; and may those who love Your name be jubilant in You.
verses.5:13: For You, LORD, bless the righteous one; You encircle him with favor like a large shield.
verses.6:1: For the music director, on stringed instruments, according to the Sheminith. A psalm of David.
verses.6:2: LORD, do not reprove me in Your anger, and do not discipline me in Your fury.
verses.6:3: Show me favor, LORD, for I am feeble; heal me, LORD, for my bones are terrified.
verses.6:4: And my soul is deeply terrified; yet You, LORD, how long?
verses.6:5: Turn back, LORD, rescue my soul; save me for the sake of Your loyal love.
verses.6:6: For there is no remembrance of You in death; in Sheol, who gives thanks to You?
verses.6:7: I am exhausted from my groaning; each night I cause my bed to swim; with my tears I melt my couch.
verses.6:8: From grief my eye has wasted away; it has grown old on account of all my adversaries.
verses.6:9: Turn away from me, all who practice iniquity, because the LORD heard the sound of my weeping.
verses.6:10: The LORD heard my plea for favor; the LORD will accept my prayer.
verses.6:11: All my enemies will be put to shame and deeply terrified; they will turn back; in an instant they will be put to shame.
verses.7:1: A Shiggaion of David, which he sang to the LORD regarding the words of Cush, a Benjaminite.
verses.7:2: LORD, my God, I have taken refuge in You; save me from all my pursuers and rescue me,
verses.7:3: or else he will tear my soul like a lion, ripping it apart while there is no one to rescue.
verses.7:4: LORD, my God, if I have done this thing, if wrongdoing is in my hands,
verses.7:5: if I have repaid the one at peace with me with evil—though I delivered my adversary without cause—
verses.7:6: then let an enemy pursue my soul and overtake it; let him tread my life to the ground and make my glory dwell in the dust. Selah.
verses.7:7: Arise, LORD, in Your anger; be lifted up against the wrath of my adversaries, and awake on my behalf; You have commanded judgment.
verses.7:8: And let the congregation of peoples surround You, and above it return to the height.
verses.7:9: The LORD passes judgment on the peoples; judge me, LORD, according to my righteousness and according to my integrity within me.
verses.7:10: May the evil of the wicked come to an end, and may You establish the righteous, and the righteous God tests hearts and kidneys.
verses.7:11: My shield rests upon God, who saves the upright of heart.
verses.7:12: God is a righteous judge, and a God who is indignant every day.
verses.7:13: If he does not turn back, He will sharpen His sword; He has bent His bow and readied it.
verses.7:14: And for Himself He has prepared weapons of death; He makes His arrows fiery.
verses.7:15: Look, he is in labor with iniquity; he conceives trouble and gives birth to falsehood.
verses.7:16: He dug a pit and excavated it, and fell into the pit he was making.
verses.7:17: His trouble will return on his own head, and his violence will come down on the crown of his head.
verses.7:18: I will thank the LORD according to His righteousness, and I will sing praises to the name of the LORD Most High.
verses.8:1: For the music director, according to the Gittith. A psalm of David.
verses.8:2: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name throughout all the earth—You who have set Your splendor above the heavens!
verses.8:3: From the mouth of young children and nursing infants You have founded strength on account of Your adversaries, to halt the enemy and the avenger.
verses.8:4: When I see Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and stars You have fixed in place,
verses.8:5: what is mortal man that You remember him, and a son of man that You attend to him?
verses.8:6: Yet You have made him a little less than God, and with glory and honor You crown him.
verses.8:7: You make him rule over the works of Your hands; You have placed everything beneath his feet:
verses.8:8: flocks and cattle, all of them, and also the animals of the field,
verses.8:9: birds of the heavens and fish of the sea, whatever travels the pathways of the seas.
verses.8:10: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name throughout all the earth!
verses.9:1: For the music director, according to Muth-labben. A psalm of David.
verses.9:2: I will thank the LORD with all my heart; I will recount all Your wonders.
verses.9:3: I will rejoice and exult in You; I will sing praises to Your name, Most High.
verses.9:4: When my enemies turn backward, they stumble and perish from before You.
verses.9:5: For You have upheld my right and my cause; You sat on the throne, judging righteously.
verses.9:6: You have rebuked the nations; You have destroyed the wicked one; their name You have wiped out forever and ever.
verses.9:7: As for the enemy, they are finished in ruins forever, and cities You have uprooted; the very memory of them has perished.
verses.9:8: Yet the LORD sits enthroned forever; for judgment He has established His throne.
verses.9:9: And He Himself will judge the world in righteousness; He will pass judgment on the peoples in equity.
verses.9:10: So the LORD will be a high refuge for the oppressed, a high refuge in times of distress.
verses.9:11: And those who know Your name will trust in You, for You have not abandoned those who seek You, LORD.
verses.9:12: Sing praises to the LORD, who is enthroned in Zion; proclaim His deeds among the peoples.
verses.9:13: For He who demands an accounting for bloodshed remembers them; He does not forget the outcry of the humble.
verses.9:14: Show me grace, LORD; look at my affliction from those who hate me, You who raise me up from the gates of death,
verses.9:15: so that I may recount all Your praises in the gates of Daughter Zion; I will rejoice in Your salvation.
verses.9:16: Nations have sunk into the pit they made; in the net they hid, their foot has been trapped.
verses.9:17: The LORD has made Himself known; He has carried out judgment; by the work of his hands He snares the wicked one. Higgaion. Selah.
verses.9:18: The wicked will return to Sheol—all nations forgetful of God.
verses.9:19: For the needy will not be forgotten perpetually, nor will the hope of the afflicted perish forever.
verses.9:20: Arise, LORD; do not let mortal man prevail; let the nations be judged in Your presence.
verses.9:21: Place dread upon them, LORD; let the nations know they are mortal. Selah.
verses.9:22: Why, LORD, do You stand at a distance and hide Yourself in times of distress?
verses.9:23: In arrogance the wicked one hotly pursues the afflicted; let them be seized in the schemes they have devised.
verses.9:24: For the wicked one boasts over the desire of his soul; he blesses the greedy and spurns the LORD.
verses.9:25: The wicked one, in the haughtiness of his face—"He will not call to account; there is no God"—such are all his thoughts.
verses.9:26: His ways endure at all times; Your judgments are high above, beyond his sight; as for all his adversaries, he scoffs at them.
verses.9:27: He says in his heart, "I will not be shaken; from generation to generation I will not be in misfortune."
verses.9:28: His mouth is full of cursing, deceits, and oppression; beneath his tongue are trouble and iniquity.
verses.9:29: He sits in ambush among the villages; in concealed places he kills the innocent; his eyes watch in secret for the helpless.
verses.9:30: He lies in wait in a concealed place like a lion in its thicket; he lies in wait to snatch the afflicted; he snatches the afflicted as he drags him into his net.
verses.9:31: He crouches, he stoops low, and the company of the downcast falls by his strong ones.
verses.9:32: He says in his heart, "God has forgotten; He has concealed His face; He will never see."
verses.9:33: Arise, LORD! God, raise Your hand; do not forget the humble.
verses.9:34: Why has the wicked one spurned God? He has said in his heart, "You will not call to account."
verses.9:35: You have seen—for You Yourself look upon trouble and grief to take it into Your hand; to You the helpless entrusts himself; for the orphan You have been a helper.
verses.9:36: Break the arm of the wicked one; as for the evildoer, call his wickedness to account until You find none.
verses.9:37: The LORD is King forever and ever; the nations have perished out of His land.
verses.9:38: The desire of the humble You have heard, LORD; You will steady their heart; You will make Your ear attentive,
verses.9:39: to render judgment for the orphan and the oppressed, so that mortal man from the earth will terrify no more.
verses.10:1: For the music director. Of David. In the LORD I have taken refuge; how can you tell my soul, "Flee to your mountain, bird!
verses.10:2: For look, the wicked bend a bow; they have readied their arrow on the bowstring to shoot in darkness at those upright of heart.
verses.10:3: When the foundations are torn down, what can a righteous one accomplish?"
verses.10:4: The LORD is in His holy temple; the LORD, His throne is in the heavens. His eyes gaze; His eyelids examine the sons of mankind.
verses.10:5: The LORD examines the righteous, yet the wicked and the lover of violence His soul hates.
verses.10:6: He will rain down traps upon the wicked; fire and sulfur and a scorching wind will be the allotment of their cup.
verses.10:7: For the LORD is righteous; He loves acts of righteousness. The upright will gaze upon His face.
verses.11:1: For the music director, on the Sheminith. A psalm of David.
verses.11:2: Save, LORD, for the loyal one has come to an end; for the trustworthy have vanished from among the sons of mankind.
verses.11:3: They speak deceit, each one with his neighbor; with a lip of flattery and a double heart they speak.
verses.11:4: May the LORD cut off all lips of flattery, the tongue speaking boastful things,
verses.11:5: those who have said, "By our tongue we will triumph; our lips are with us; who is master over us?"
verses.11:6: "On account of the plundering of the afflicted, on account of the groaning of the needy, now I will arise," says the LORD; "I will set him in the deliverance for which he longs."
verses.11:7: The utterances of the LORD are pure utterances, silver smelted in a crucible on the ground, purified sevenfold.
verses.11:8: You, LORD, will guard them; You will protect him from this generation forever.
verses.11:9: All around, the wicked walk about when depravity rises high among the sons of mankind.
verses.12:1: For the music director. A psalm of David.
verses.12:2: How long, LORD, will You forget me forever? How long will You conceal Your face from me?
verses.12:3: How long must I set counsels in my soul, with grief in my heart daily? How long will my enemy rise high over me?
verses.12:4: Look, answer me, LORD my God; brighten my eyes, so that I do not sleep in death,
verses.12:5: so that my enemy does not say, "I have overpowered him," nor my adversaries exult if I am shaken.
verses.12:6: Yet I have trusted in Your loyal love; my heart will exult in Your deliverance. I will sing to the LORD, for He has dealt generously with me.
verses.13:1: For the music director. Of David. A fool has said in his heart, "There is no God." They have acted corruptly; they have performed detestable deeds; there is no one doing good.
verses.13:2: The LORD looked down from heaven on the sons of mankind to see whether there is anyone who has insight, who seeks God.
verses.13:3: Everyone has turned aside; together they have become tainted. There is no one doing good; there is not even one.
verses.13:4: Do all those who practice iniquity not know, those who devour my people just as they eat bread, who do not call on the LORD?
verses.13:5: There they trembled in great dread, because God is among the righteous generation.
verses.13:6: You would bring the counsel of the afflicted to shame, yet the LORD is his refuge.
verses.13:7: If only Israel's salvation would come from Zion! When the LORD restores His people's fortunes, may Jacob exult; may Israel be glad.
verses.14:1: A psalm of David. LORD, who may sojourn in Your tent? Who may dwell on Your holy mountain?
verses.14:2: One who walks blamelessly, and practices righteousness, and speaks truth within his heart.
verses.14:3: He does not spread slander with his tongue; he does no harm to his companion, and he does not carry a reproach against his neighbor.
verses.14:4: A contemptible person is rejected in his eyes, yet he honors those who fear the LORD; he takes an oath to his own detriment and does not alter it.
verses.14:5: He does not lend his money at interest, and he takes no bribe against an innocent person. Anyone who does these things will never be shaken.
verses.15:1: A Miktam of David. Guard me, God, for I have taken refuge in You.
verses.15:2: You have said to the LORD, "You are my Lord; I have no good beyond You."
verses.15:3: As for the holy ones who are in the land, and the noble ones, all my delight is in them.
verses.15:4: The sorrows of those who acquire another god will increase; I will not pour out their libations of blood, and I will not lift up their names on my lips.
verses.15:5: The LORD is the portion of my allotment and my cup; You uphold my lot.
verses.15:6: Measuring lines have fallen for me in pleasant places; truly, my inheritance is lovely to me.
verses.15:7: I bless the LORD, who has counseled me; even during the nights my inward parts instruct me.
verses.15:8: I have placed the LORD before me continually; since He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
verses.15:9: For this reason my heart is glad, and my glory exults; even my flesh will dwell in safety.
verses.15:10: For You will not leave my soul to Sheol; You will not permit Your devoted one to see the pit.
verses.15:11: You will make the path of life known to me; abundance of joys is in Your presence; pleasures are in Your right hand forever.
verses.16:1: A prayer of David. Hear a righteous plea, LORD; pay attention to my outcry; lend an ear to my prayer, not from lips of deceit.
verses.16:2: From Your presence let my verdict go forth; let Your eyes gaze upon what is upright.
verses.16:3: You have examined my heart; You have inspected me at night; You have refined me and find nothing; I have resolved that my mouth will not transgress.
verses.16:4: Concerning the deeds of mankind, by the word of Your lips I have guarded against the paths of the violent.
verses.16:5: My steps have kept firm hold of Your tracks; my feet have not slipped.
verses.16:6: I have called to You, for You will answer me, God; turn Your ear to me; hear my utterance.
verses.16:7: Show marvelously Your acts of loyal love, You who by Your right hand save those who take refuge from adversaries.
verses.16:8: Guard me like the pupil of the eye; in the shadow of Your wings conceal me,
verses.16:9: from the wicked who ravage me; my mortal enemies close in around me.
verses.16:10: They have closed up their fat; with their mouth they speak in arrogance.
verses.16:11: At our steps they have now surrounded us; they fix their eyes to bring us down to the ground.
verses.16:12: He resembles a lion longing to tear apart, and a young lion crouching in secret places.
verses.16:13: Rise up, LORD; confront him face to face, bring him to his knees; deliver my life from the wicked by Your sword,
verses.16:14: from men by Your hand, LORD, from men of this world, whose portion is in life, and with what You have stored up You fill their belly; they are satisfied with children, and they leave their surplus to their little ones.
verses.16:15: As for me, in righteousness I will gaze upon Your face; upon awaking, I will be satisfied with Your likeness.
verses.17:1: For the music director. Of the servant of the LORD, David, who spoke to the LORD the words of this song on the day the LORD rescued him from the grasp of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.
verses.17:2: And he said, "I deeply love You, LORD, my strength.
verses.17:3: The LORD is my crag and my fortress and my deliverer, my God, my rock in whom I take refuge, my shield and the horn of my salvation, my high stronghold.
verses.17:4: I call out to the LORD, who is to be praised, and from my enemies I am saved.
verses.17:5: The ropes of death encircled me, and torrents of ruin terrified me.
verses.17:6: The ropes of Sheol surrounded me; the traps of death confronted me.
verses.17:7: In my distress I called to the LORD, and to my God I cried out for help; from His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for help before Him entered His ears.
verses.17:8: Then the earth heaved and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains shuddered and heaved to and fro, because He burned with anger.
verses.17:9: Smoke rose from His nostrils, and fire from His mouth consumed; coals blazed forth from Him.
verses.17:10: He bent the heavens and descended, and heavy darkness was beneath His feet.
verses.17:11: He rode a cherub and flew, and He soared on the wings of the wind.
verses.17:12: He set darkness as His secret place, His canopy around Him—darkness of waters, dense clouds of the skies.
verses.17:13: Out of the radiance before Him His thick clouds swept past—hail and coals of fire.
verses.17:14: And the LORD thundered in the heavens, and the Most High sounded His voice—hail and coals of fire.
verses.17:15: He sent out His arrows and scattered them, and He shot forth lightning bolts and threw them into panic.
verses.17:16: Then the channels of water came into view, and the foundations of the world were uncovered at Your rebuke, LORD, at the blast of the wind of Your nostrils.
verses.17:17: He reached out from on high, He took hold of me; He drew me out from great waters.
verses.17:18: He rescued me from my powerful enemy and from those who hated me, for they were stronger than I.
verses.17:19: They confronted me on the day of my disaster, yet the LORD became a support to me.
verses.17:20: He brought me out into an open space; He set me free, because He delighted in me.
verses.17:21: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the purity of my hands He repaid me.
verses.17:22: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not turned wickedly away from my God.
verses.17:23: For all His judgments were before me, and His statutes I did not remove from me.
verses.17:24: And I was blameless with Him, and I guarded myself against my iniquity.
verses.17:25: So the LORD repaid me according to my righteousness, according to the purity of my hands before His eyes.
verses.17:26: With the loyal You prove Yourself loyal; with a blameless man You prove Yourself blameless;
verses.17:27: with the pure You prove Yourself pure, and with the crooked You prove Yourself shrewd.
verses.17:28: For You save an afflicted people, but lofty eyes You bring low.
verses.17:29: For You give light to my lamp; the LORD my God brightens my darkness.
verses.17:30: For by You I rush through a raiding band, and by my God I leap over a wall.
verses.17:31: This God—His way is blameless; the word of the LORD is refined; He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
verses.17:32: For who is God apart from the LORD, and who is a rock besides our God?
verses.17:33: God is the one who girds me with might and makes my way blameless.
verses.17:34: He makes my feet like those of deer, and on my high places He makes me stand.
verses.17:35: He trains my hands for battle, and my arms bend a bow of bronze.
verses.17:36: You gave me the shield of Your salvation, and Your right hand sustains me, and Your humility makes me great.
verses.17:37: You widen my stride beneath me, and my ankles have not slipped.
verses.17:38: I pursued my enemies and caught up with them, and I did not turn back until I had finished them off.
verses.17:39: I crushed them, and they could not rise; they fell beneath my feet.
verses.17:40: You girded me with might for battle; You made those who rose against me bow down beneath me.
verses.17:41: And You turned the backs of my enemies toward me, and those who hated me I annihilated.
verses.17:42: They cried out for help, yet there was no one to save—even to the LORD, yet He did not answer them.
verses.17:43: Then I ground them fine like dust before the wind; like mud of the streets I poured them out.
verses.17:44: You delivered me from the disputes of the people; You appointed me head of the nations; a people I did not know serve me.
verses.17:45: The moment their ears hear, they obey me; foreigners cower before me.
verses.17:46: Foreigners wither away and come quaking out of their strongholds.
verses.17:47: The LORD lives, and blessed is my rock; let the God of my salvation be exalted—
verses.17:48: the God who grants vengeance to me and subdues peoples beneath me,
verses.17:49: who delivers me from my enemies. Indeed, above those who rise against me You raise me high; from the man of violence You rescue me.
verses.17:50: Therefore I will thank You among the nations, LORD, and to Your name I will sing praise.
verses.17:51: He magnifies the victories of His king and shows loyal love to His anointed, to David and to his seed forever."
verses.18:1: For the music director. A psalm of David.
verses.18:2: The heavens recount the glory of God, and the expanse announces the work of His hands.
verses.18:3: Day to day pours out utterance, and night to night discloses knowledge.
verses.18:4: There is no utterance, and there are no words; their voice is unheard.
verses.18:5: Through all the earth their measuring line has gone out, and to the end of the world their words. For the sun He has set a tent in them.
verses.18:6: And it is like a bridegroom going out from his canopy; it exults like a mighty man to run a course.
verses.18:7: From one end of the heavens is its going out, and its circuit reaches to their ends; nothing remains hidden from its heat.
verses.18:8: The instruction of the LORD is flawless, restoring the soul; the testimony of the LORD is reliable, making the naive wise.
verses.18:9: The precepts of the LORD are upright, gladdening the heart; the commandment of the LORD is radiant, illuminating the eyes.
verses.18:10: The fear of the LORD is pure, standing forever. The judgments of the LORD are truth; they are altogether righteous.
verses.18:11: More desirable are they than gold and than abundant fine gold, and sweeter than honey and drippings from the honeycombs.
verses.18:12: Also, Your servant takes warning from them; in observing them there is great reward.
verses.18:13: Who can perceive errors? Absolve me from hidden faults.
verses.18:14: Also restrain Your servant from presumptuous deeds; do not let them rule over me. Then I will be without blame, and I will be absolved of great transgression.
verses.18:15: May the utterances of my mouth and the musing of my heart find acceptance before You, LORD, my rock and my redeemer.
verses.19:1: For the music director. A psalm of David.
verses.19:2: May the LORD answer you on the day of distress; may the name of the God of Jacob keep you safe on high.
verses.19:3: May He send your help from the sanctuary, and from Zion may He sustain you.
verses.19:4: May He remember all your grain offerings, and regard your burnt offering as rich. Selah.
verses.19:5: May He give to you according to your heart, and all your counsel may He fulfill.
verses.19:6: Let us shout with joy over your deliverance, and in the name of our God let us raise banners. May the LORD fulfill all your requests.
verses.19:7: Now I know that the LORD has saved His anointed; He will answer him from His holy heavens with the mighty saving acts of His right hand.
verses.19:8: Some make mention of chariots, and some of horses, but we make mention of the name of the LORD our God.
verses.19:9: They have collapsed and fallen, but we have risen and stood firm.
verses.19:10: LORD, save! May the King answer us on the day of our calling.
verses.20:1: For the music director. A psalm of David.
verses.20:2: LORD, in Your strength the king is glad, and in Your deliverance how exceedingly he exults!
verses.20:3: The longing of his heart You have given to him, and the request of his lips You have not withheld. Selah.
verses.20:4: For You come to meet him with blessings of goodness; You place on his head a crown of fine gold.
verses.20:5: Life he asked from You; You gave him length of days forever and ever.
verses.20:6: Great is his glory in Your deliverance; majesty and splendor You lay on him.
verses.20:7: For You make him blessings forever; You gladden him with joy in Your presence.
verses.20:8: For the king trusts in the LORD, and by the loyal love of the Most High he will not be shaken.
verses.20:9: Your hand will find all your enemies; your right hand will find those who hate you.
verses.20:10: You will make them like a furnace of fire at the time of your appearing; the LORD in His anger will swallow them up, and fire will devour them.
verses.20:11: Their fruit you will destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the sons of man.
verses.20:12: Though they directed evil against you and devised a scheme, they will not prevail.
verses.20:13: For you will cause them to turn their backs; with your bowstrings you will take aim at their faces.
verses.20:14: Be exalted, LORD, in Your strength! We will sing and make music to Your might.
verses.21:1: For the music director, according to The Doe of the Dawn. A psalm of David.
verses.21:2: My God, my God, why have You abandoned me? Why are You far from my salvation, from the words of my roaring?
verses.21:3: My God, I call out by day, yet You do not answer, and by night, yet there is no quiet for me.
verses.21:4: Yet You are holy, seated upon the praises of Israel.
verses.21:5: Our fathers trusted in You; they trusted, and You brought them to safety.
verses.21:6: They cried out to You and escaped; they trusted in You and were not ashamed.
verses.21:7: Yet I am a worm and not a man, a reproach to mankind and one despised by the people.
verses.21:8: All who see me jeer at me; they open their lips wide, they shake their heads.
verses.21:9: "Entrust yourself to the LORD! Let Him bring him to safety; let Him rescue him, for He takes pleasure in him."
verses.21:10: Yet You are the One who drew me out of the womb, making me trust at my mother's breasts.
verses.21:11: I was cast upon You from the womb; from my mother's womb You are my God.
verses.21:12: Do not stay far from me, for distress is near, for there is no helper.
verses.21:13: Numerous bulls have surrounded me; the mighty ones of Bashan have encircled me.
verses.21:14: They have opened their mouths wide against me, like a tearing and roaring lion.
verses.21:15: Like water I have been poured out, and all my bones have come apart; my heart has become like wax, melted within my inward parts.
verses.21:16: My strength has dried up like a pottery shard; my tongue is stuck to my jaws, and You place me in the dust of death.
verses.21:17: For dogs have surrounded me; a band of evildoers has closed in around me, like a lion at my hands and my feet.
verses.21:18: I count all my bones; they look on, they gloat over me.
verses.21:19: They divide up my garments for themselves, and over my clothing they cast a lot.
verses.21:20: But You, LORD, do not stay far off; my strength, hurry to my aid.
verses.21:21: Rescue my soul from the sword, my only life from the paw of a dog.
verses.21:22: Save me from a lion's mouth; and from the horns of wild oxen You have answered me.
verses.21:23: I will recount Your name to my brothers; within the assembly I will praise You.
verses.21:24: Praise Him, you who fear the LORD; all the seed of Jacob, honor Him, and stand in awe before Him, all the seed of Israel.
verses.21:25: For He has not despised and has not detested the affliction of the afflicted one, nor has He hidden His face from him; but when he cried out for help to Him, He listened.
verses.21:26: My praise in a great assembly comes from You; I will fulfill my vows in the presence of those who fear Him.
verses.21:27: The humble will eat and have their fill; those who seek Him will praise the LORD. May your heart live on forever.
verses.21:28: All the ends of the earth will remember and return to the LORD, and all the clans of the nations will bow down before You.
verses.21:29: For the kingdom belongs to the LORD, and He is ruler over the nations.
verses.21:30: All the thriving of the earth eat and bow down; all who descend to the dust will kneel before Him, even one who could not keep his own soul alive.
verses.21:31: A seed will serve Him; it will be recounted about the Lord to the future generation.
verses.21:32: They will come and announce His righteousness to a people yet to be born, that He has acted.
verses.22:1: A psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd; I will not lack anything.
verses.22:2: He makes me lie down in meadows of fresh grass; He guides me beside restful waters.
verses.22:3: He brings back my soul; He leads me in tracks of righteousness for the sake of His name.
verses.22:4: Even though I walk in a valley of death's shadow, I will not fear evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.
verses.22:5: You arrange a table before me in front of my foes; You have anointed my head with oil; my cup is brimming over.
verses.22:6: Surely goodness and loyal love will pursue me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for length of days.
verses.23:1: A psalm of David. To the LORD belong the earth and its fullness, the world and those who inhabit it.
verses.23:2: For He Himself founded it upon the seas and set it firm upon the rivers.
verses.23:3: Who can go up onto the LORD's mountain, and who can stand in the place of His holiness?
verses.23:4: The one with clean hands and a pure heart, who has not lifted up My soul to falsehood and has not sworn with deceit.
verses.23:5: He will obtain blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his deliverance.
verses.23:6: This is the generation of those seeking Him, those searching for Your face—Jacob. Selah.
verses.23:7: Raise your heads, gates, and be raised up, ancient doorways, so that the King of glory may enter.
verses.23:8: Who is this, the King of glory? The LORD, powerful and mighty, the LORD, mighty in war.
verses.23:9: Raise your heads, gates, and raise them up, ancient doorways, so that the King of glory may enter.
verses.23:10: Who is He, this King of glory? The LORD of hosts—He is the King of glory. Selah.
verses.24:1: Of David. LORD, I lift up my soul to You.
verses.24:2: My God, I have trusted in You; may I not be put to shame; may my enemies not triumph over me.
verses.24:3: Truly, no one who waits for You will be put to shame; those who act treacherously without cause will be put to shame.
verses.24:4: Make Your ways known to me, LORD; teach Your paths to me.
verses.24:5: Make me walk in Your truth and teach me, for You are the God of my deliverance; I have waited for You all day long.
verses.24:6: Remember Your compassions, LORD, and Your acts of loyal love, for they are from ages past.
verses.24:7: Do not remember the sins of my youth and my rebellions; in accordance with Your loyal love, You Yourself remember me, on account of Your goodness, LORD.
verses.24:8: The LORD is good and upright; for this reason He instructs sinners in the way.
verses.24:9: He makes the humble walk in justice and teaches His way to the humble.
verses.24:10: All the LORD's paths are loyal love and truth for those who guard His covenant and His testimonies.
verses.24:11: For the sake of Your name, LORD, forgive my iniquity, because it is great.
verses.24:12: Who is this man who fears the LORD? He will instruct him in the way he ought to choose.
verses.24:13: His soul will dwell in well-being, and his seed will possess the land.
verses.24:14: The secret counsel of the LORD belongs to those who fear Him, and He will make His covenant known to them.
verses.24:15: My eyes are always toward the LORD, for He Himself will bring my feet out of the net.
verses.24:16: Turn toward me and show me grace, since I am alone and afflicted.
verses.24:17: The distresses of my heart have expanded; bring me out from my anguish.
verses.24:18: See my affliction and my hardship, and pardon all my sins.
verses.24:19: See my enemies, for they have multiplied, and with violent hatred they have hated me.
verses.24:20: Watch over my soul and rescue me; may I not be put to shame, because I have taken refuge in You.
verses.24:21: May blamelessness and uprightness guard me, because I have waited for You.
verses.24:22: Redeem Israel, God, from all its distresses.
verses.25:1: Of David. Judge me, LORD, because I have walked in my integrity, and in the LORD I have trusted; I will not slip.
verses.25:2: Examine me, LORD, and put me to the test; refine my inward parts and my heart.
verses.25:3: For Your loyal love is right before my eyes, and I have walked continually in Your truth.
verses.25:4: I have not sat with men of deceit, nor will I go with those who conceal themselves.
verses.25:5: I hate the gathering of those who do evil, and with the wicked I will not sit.
verses.25:6: I will wash my palms in innocence and walk around Your altar, LORD,
verses.25:7: to make a voice of thanksgiving heard and to recount all Your marvelous deeds.
verses.25:8: LORD, I love the dwelling of Your house and the place where Your glory resides.
verses.25:9: Do not gather up my soul with sinners, or my life with men of bloodshed,
verses.25:10: in whose hands is evil plotting, and whose right hand is filled with bribery.
verses.25:11: But I will walk in my integrity; ransom me and show me favor.
verses.25:12: My foot stands on a level plain; in the gatherings I will bless the LORD.
verses.26:1: Of David. The LORD is my light and my deliverance; whom will I fear? The LORD is the fortress of my life; whom will I dread?
verses.26:2: When those who do evil closed in against me to eat my flesh, those adversaries and enemies of mine, they themselves stumbled and fell.
verses.26:3: Even if an army camps against me, my heart will not be afraid; even if war rises up against me, in this I trust.
verses.26:4: One thing I have requested from the LORD; that I will seek: to dwell in the LORD's house all the days of my life, to gaze at the loveliness of the LORD and to inquire in His temple.
verses.26:5: For He will conceal me in His shelter on a day of calamity; He will hide me in the hiding place of His tent; on a rock He will raise me high.
verses.26:6: And now my head will rise high above my enemies surrounding me, and I will sacrifice in His tent sacrifices of joyful shouting; I will sing and play music to the LORD.
verses.26:7: Hear, LORD, my voice as I call, and show me favor and answer me.
verses.26:8: Concerning You my heart has said, "Seek My face." Your face, LORD, I will seek.
verses.26:9: Do not hide Your face from me; do not turn aside Your servant in anger. You have been my help; do not desert me and do not abandon me, God of my deliverance.
verses.26:10: For my father and my mother have abandoned me, yet the LORD will gather me in.
verses.26:11: Instruct me in Your way, LORD, and guide me on a level path because of those who lie in wait for me.
verses.26:12: Do not hand me over to the desire of my adversaries, because lying witnesses have risen up against me, and one who breathes out violence.
verses.26:13: If I had not believed I would see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living—
verses.26:14: Wait for the LORD; be strong, and let your heart be resolute; and wait for the LORD.
verses.27:1: Of David. To You, LORD, I call; my rock, do not remain deaf to me; otherwise, if You keep silent toward me, I will be likened to those going down into the pit.
verses.27:2: Hear the sound of my pleas for mercy as I cry out to You for help, as I raise my hands toward Your holy inner sanctuary.
verses.27:3: Do not pull me away with the wicked and with doers of iniquity, those who speak peace with their companions, though evil is in their heart.
verses.27:4: Give to them according to their deeds and according to the evil of their practices; according to the work of their hands give to them; return their recompense to them.
verses.27:5: Because they pay no attention to the deeds of the LORD or to the work of His hands, He will demolish them and will not build them up.
verses.27:6: Blessed be the LORD, because He has heard the sound of my pleas for mercy.
verses.27:7: The LORD is my strength and my shield; in Him my heart trusted, and I was helped; so my heart exulted, and with my song I will give Him thanks.
verses.27:8: The LORD is strength for them, and He is a fortress of deliverances for His anointed one.
verses.27:9: Deliver Your people and bless Your inheritance; shepherd them and carry them forever.
verses.28:1: A psalm of David. Give to the LORD, sons of the mighty; give to the LORD glory and strength.
verses.28:2: Give to the LORD the glory of His name; bow down to the LORD in holy splendor.
verses.28:3: The voice of the LORD is above the waters; the God of glory thunders; the LORD is above many waters.
verses.28:4: The voice of the LORD is with power; the voice of the LORD is with splendor.
verses.28:5: The voice of the LORD breaks cedars, and the LORD smashes the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.28:6: And He makes them leap like a calf—Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild ox.
verses.28:7: The voice of the LORD carves out flames of fire.
verses.28:8: The voice of the LORD makes the wilderness tremble; the LORD makes the wilderness of Kadesh tremble.
verses.28:9: The voice of the LORD causes does to calve and lays forests bare; and in His temple everyone says, "Glory!"
verses.28:10: The LORD sat enthroned over the flood, and the LORD sits enthroned as King forever.
verses.28:11: The LORD will grant His people strength; the LORD will bless His people with peace.
verses.29:1: A psalm, a song for the dedication of the house, of David.
verses.29:2: I will exalt You, LORD, because You have drawn me up and have not allowed my enemies to rejoice over me.
verses.29:3: LORD my God, I cried out to You for help, and You healed me.
verses.29:4: LORD, You brought my soul up from Sheol; You restored me to life so that I would not go down to the pit.
verses.29:5: Sing praises to the LORD, you His loyal ones, and give thanks to His holy memorial.
verses.29:6: For His anger is for a moment, and in His favor is life; at evening weeping may lodge for the night, but in the morning comes a shout of joy.
verses.29:7: As for me, I said in my security, "I will never be shaken."
verses.29:8: LORD, in Your favor You established strength for my mountain; You hid Your face; I became terrified.
verses.29:9: To You, LORD, I called out, and to the Lord I pleaded for grace:
verses.29:10: "What gain is there in my blood when I go down to the pit? Will dust give thanks to You? Will it proclaim Your faithfulness?
verses.29:11: Hear, LORD, and be gracious to me; LORD, be a helper to me!"
verses.29:12: You turned my mourning into dancing for me; You untied my sackcloth and wrapped me with joy,
verses.29:13: so that my glory may sing praises to You and not keep silent. LORD my God, forever I will give thanks to You.
verses.30:1: For the music director. A psalm of David.
verses.30:2: In You, LORD, I have taken refuge; may I never be put to shame; in Your righteousness rescue me.
verses.30:3: Turn Your ear to me; deliver me quickly! Be for me a rock stronghold, a house of fortresses to save me.
verses.30:4: For You are my crag and my fortress, and for the sake of Your name You will direct me and guide me.
verses.30:5: You will bring me out of the net that they have hidden for me, for You are my stronghold.
verses.30:6: Into Your hand I entrust my spirit; You have redeemed me, LORD, God of truth.
verses.30:7: I hate those who pay heed to worthless vanities, but as for me, I trust in the LORD.
verses.30:8: I will exult and be glad in Your loyal love, because You have seen my affliction; You have known the distresses of my soul,
verses.30:9: and You have not surrendered me into the hand of an enemy; You have made my feet stand in a spacious place.
verses.30:10: Be gracious to me, LORD, because I am in distress; my eye has wasted away from grief—my soul and my body.
verses.30:11: For my life is consumed in sorrow and my years in groaning; my strength has faltered because of my iniquity, and my bones have wasted away.
verses.30:12: Because of all my foes I have become a disgrace—exceedingly so to my neighbors—and a dread to my acquaintances; those who see me outside flee from me.
verses.30:13: I have been forgotten from the heart like a dead man; I have become like a ruined vessel.
verses.30:14: For I have heard the slander of many—terror from all around; as they conspire together against me, they plot to take my life.
verses.30:15: Yet as for me, in You I trust, LORD; I have said, "You are my God."
verses.30:16: In Your hand are my times; deliver me from the hand of my enemies and from my pursuers.
verses.30:17: Make Your face shine upon Your servant; save me by Your loyal love.
verses.30:18: LORD, may I not be put to shame, for I have called on You; let the wicked be put to shame; let them fall silent in Sheol.
verses.30:19: May lips of falsehood become mute, those that speak insolence against the righteous with pride and contempt.
verses.30:20: How great is Your goodness, which You have stored up for those who fear You and performed for those who take refuge in You in the presence of the sons of mankind!
verses.30:21: You hide them in the hiding place of Your presence from the plots of men; You conceal them in a shelter from the contention of tongues.
verses.30:22: Blessed be the LORD, because He has wonderfully shown His loyal love to me in a besieged city.
verses.30:23: As for me, I said in my panic, "I have been cut off from before Your eyes." Yet indeed You heard the voice of my pleas for grace when I cried out to You for help.
verses.30:24: Love the LORD, all you His loyal ones! The LORD guards the faithful, yet repays in abundance the one who acts with pride.
verses.30:25: Be strong, and may your heart be courageous, all you who hope in the LORD!
verses.31:1: Of David. A Maskil. Blessed is the one whose transgression has been lifted away, whose sin has been covered.
verses.31:2: Blessed is the person to whom the LORD reckons no iniquity, and in whose spirit is no deception.
verses.31:3: When I remained silent, my bones wore away from my groaning throughout the day.
verses.31:4: For day and night Your hand weighed heavily on me; my moisture was turned into the parching heat of summer. Selah.
verses.31:5: My sin I made known to You, and my iniquity I did not cover up; I said, "I will make confession of my transgressions to the LORD," and You lifted away the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
verses.31:6: Because of this, let every faithful one pray to You at a time when You can be found; surely, in a flood of many waters, they will not reach him.
verses.31:7: You are a shelter for me; from distress You guard me; with joyful cries of deliverance You surround me. Selah.
verses.31:8: I will give you insight and teach you in the way that you should walk; I will give counsel with My eye on you.
verses.31:9: Do not be like a horse, like a mule with no understanding, whose trappings are bit and bridle to restrain it, or else it will not come near you.
verses.31:10: Many pains belong to the wicked, but loyal love surrounds the one who trusts in the LORD.
verses.31:11: Be glad in the LORD and exult, you righteous ones, and shout joyfully, all you upright of heart.
verses.32:1: Shout joyfully in the LORD, you righteous ones; praise is fitting for the upright.
verses.32:2: Give thanks to the LORD with a lyre; with a ten-stringed harp make melody to Him.
verses.32:3: Sing a new song to Him; play the strings skillfully with a shout of acclaim.
verses.32:4: For upright is the word of the LORD, and all His work is in faithfulness.
verses.32:5: He loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of the LORD's loyal love.
verses.32:6: Through the LORD's word the heavens were made, and through the breath of His mouth their entire host.
verses.32:7: He gathers the sea's waters like a mound; He places the deeps in storehouses.
verses.32:8: May all the earth fear the LORD; may all who inhabit the world be in awe of Him.
verses.32:9: For He Himself spoke, and it came into being; He Himself commanded, and it stood firm.
verses.32:10: The LORD annuls the counsel of nations; He thwarts the designs of peoples.
verses.32:11: The LORD's counsel stands firm forever, the designs of His heart through generation after generation.
verses.32:12: Blessed is the nation that has the LORD as its God, the people He chose as an inheritance for Himself.
verses.32:13: From the heavens the LORD gazes down; He sees all the sons of mankind.
verses.32:14: From the established place of His dwelling He looks intently upon all who inhabit the earth,
verses.32:15: He who forms their hearts altogether, He who discerns all their works.
verses.32:16: A king is not saved by a great force; a warrior is not rescued by great strength.
verses.32:17: A horse is a deception for salvation, and by its great might it cannot bring escape.
verses.32:18: Look, the LORD's eye is upon those who fear Him, upon those who wait for His loyal love,
verses.32:19: to rescue their soul from death and to preserve them alive during famine.
verses.32:20: Our soul has waited for the LORD; our help and our shield is He.
verses.32:21: For in Him our heart is glad, because in His holy name we have trusted.
verses.32:22: May Your loyal love, LORD, be upon us, just as we have waited for You.
verses.33:1: Of David, when he altered his demeanor before Abimelech, who drove him out, and he left.
verses.33:2: At all times I will bless the LORD; continually His praise will be in my mouth.
verses.33:3: In the LORD my soul will boast; may the humble hear and be glad.
verses.33:4: Magnify the LORD with me, and together let us lift His name high.
verses.33:5: I sought the LORD, and He responded to me, and from all my terrors He rescued me.
verses.33:6: They looked toward Him and became radiant, and may their faces not be ashamed.
verses.33:7: This afflicted man called out, and the LORD heard, and from all his distresses He saved him.
verses.33:8: The angel of the LORD pitches camp all around those who fear Him and delivers them.
verses.33:9: Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the man who takes shelter in Him.
verses.33:10: Fear the LORD, you His holy ones, for there is no lack for those who fear Him.
verses.33:11: Young lions become destitute and go hungry, but those who seek the LORD will not lack any good thing.
verses.33:12: Come, children, listen to me; the fear of the LORD I will teach you.
verses.33:13: Who is the man who delights in life, who loves days to see good?
verses.33:14: Guard your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking deception.
verses.33:15: Turn aside from evil and do good; search for peace and pursue it.
verses.33:16: The LORD's eyes are toward the righteous, and His ears are toward their cry for help.
verses.33:17: The LORD's face is against those who do evil, to cut off from the earth the memory of them.
verses.33:18: They cried out, and the LORD heard, and from all their distresses He rescued them.
verses.33:19: Near is the LORD to those broken in heart, and those crushed in spirit He saves.
verses.33:20: Many are the calamities of the righteous one, yet from all of them the LORD rescues him.
verses.33:21: He watches over all his bones; not a single one of them is broken.
verses.33:22: Evil will put the wicked to death, and those who hate the righteous one will be held guilty.
verses.33:23: The LORD redeems His servants' lives, and none of all who take shelter in Him will be held guilty.
verses.34:1: Of David. Strive, LORD, with those who strive against me; battle those who battle against me.
verses.34:2: Grasp shield and large shield, and rise to my aid.
verses.34:3: Draw out the spear and bar the way to meet my pursuers; tell my soul, "I am your deliverance."
verses.34:4: May those who seek my life be ashamed and disgraced; may those who plan my harm be turned backward and humiliated.
verses.34:5: May they become like chaff before the wind, while the angel of the LORD thrusts them away.
verses.34:6: May their way be darkness and slippery places, while the angel of the LORD pursues them.
verses.34:7: For without cause they hid their net for me in a pit; without cause they dug for my life.
verses.34:8: May devastation come upon him when he does not know, and may his net that he hid trap him; in devastation may he fall into it.
verses.34:9: And my soul will exult in the LORD; it will be glad in His deliverance.
verses.34:10: All my bones will say, "LORD, who is like You, rescuing the afflicted from someone stronger than he, and the afflicted and the needy from the one who plunders him?"
verses.34:11: Witnesses of violence rise up; they question me concerning what I do not know.
verses.34:12: They repay me with evil in place of good—bereavement to my soul.
verses.34:13: Yet as for me, when they were ill, sackcloth was my garment; I afflicted my soul with fasting, and my prayer would return to my chest.
verses.34:14: As for a friend, as for a brother of mine, I walked about; like one mourning a mother, I bowed low in gloom.
verses.34:15: Yet at my stumbling they rejoiced and assembled; wretches assembled against me without my knowing; they tore at me and did not cease.
verses.34:16: As godless mockers for a cake, they gnashed their teeth at me.
verses.34:17: Lord, how long will You watch? Bring back my soul from their devastations, my only one from young lions.
verses.34:18: I will give thanks to You in a great assembly; among a mighty people I will praise You.
verses.34:19: Do not let those who are falsely my enemies rejoice over me, nor let those who hate me without cause wink an eye.
verses.34:20: For it is not peace that they speak; rather, against the quiet ones of the land they plan words of deceit.
verses.34:21: And they widened their mouths against me; they said, "Aha! Aha! Our own eyes have seen!"
verses.34:22: You have seen, LORD; do not remain silent. Lord, do not stay far from me.
verses.34:23: Rouse Yourself and wake up for my justice; my God and my Lord, for my case.
verses.34:24: Judge me in accordance with Your righteousness, LORD my God, and do not let them rejoice over me.
verses.34:25: May they not say in their hearts, "Aha, our longing!" May they not say, "We have swallowed him down!"
verses.34:26: May those who rejoice at my harm be ashamed and humiliated together; may those who make themselves great against me wear shame and disgrace.
verses.34:27: May those who delight in my righteousness shout for joy and rejoice; and may they say continually, "May the LORD be great, who delights in the peace of His servant!"
verses.34:28: And my tongue will utter Your righteousness—Your praise all day long.
verses.35:1: For the music director. Of the servant of the LORD, of David.
verses.35:2: An oracle of transgression concerning the wicked is within my heart: there is no dread of God before his eyes.
verses.35:3: For he flatters himself in his own eyes regarding his iniquity being discovered and hated.
verses.35:4: The words of his mouth are wrongdoing and deceit; he has stopped acting wisely, doing good.
verses.35:5: He plans wrongdoing on his bed; he takes his stand on a way that is not good; he does not spurn evil.
verses.35:6: LORD, Your loyal love is in the heavens; Your faithfulness reaches up to the skies.
verses.35:7: Your righteousness is like God's mountains; Your judgments are a vast deep; mankind and animals You deliver, LORD.
verses.35:8: How precious is Your loyal love, God! And the sons of mankind seek refuge in the shadow of Your wings.
verses.35:9: They have their fill from the richness of Your house, and You let them drink from the stream of Your delights.
verses.35:10: For with You is the wellspring of life; by Your light we see light.
verses.35:11: Extend Your loyal love to those who know You, and Your righteousness to those upright of heart.
verses.35:12: Do not let the foot of arrogance come against me, nor the hand of the wicked send me wandering.
verses.35:13: There the workers of wrongdoing fell; they were thrust down and could not rise.
verses.36:1: Of David. Do not become agitated over those who do evil; do not be jealous of those who commit injustice.
verses.36:2: For they will swiftly wither like grass, and like green vegetation they will fade.
verses.36:3: Trust in the LORD and do what is good; dwell in the land and feed on faithfulness.
verses.36:4: Find your delight in the LORD, and He will give you the requests of your heart.
verses.36:5: Roll your way onto the LORD, trust in Him, and He Himself will act.
verses.36:6: And He will bring out your righteousness like the light, and your justice like midday.
verses.36:7: Be silent before the LORD and wait expectantly for Him; do not become agitated over one who makes his way succeed, over a man who carries out schemes.
verses.36:8: Let go of anger and abandon fury; do not become agitated—it only results in doing evil.
verses.36:9: For those who do evil will be cut off, but those who wait for the LORD—they will possess the land.
verses.36:10: A little while longer, and the wicked person will be no more; you will look intently at his place, and he will not be there.
verses.36:11: But the humble will possess the land and find delight in abundant peace.
verses.36:12: The wicked person schemes against the righteous one and grinds his teeth at him.
verses.36:13: The Lord laughs at him, because He sees that his day will come.
verses.36:14: The wicked have unsheathed a sword and bent their bow, to make the afflicted and needy fall, to slaughter those of upright way.
verses.36:15: Their sword will go into their own heart, and their bows will be broken.
verses.36:16: A little belonging to the righteous person is better than the abundance of many wicked people.
verses.36:17: For the arms of the wicked will be broken, yet the LORD supports the righteous.
verses.36:18: The LORD knows the days of those who are blameless, and their inheritance will endure forever.
verses.36:19: They will not be put to shame in a time of calamity, and in days of famine they will have their fill.
verses.36:20: For the wicked will perish, and the enemies of the LORD are like the splendor of meadows; they are consumed—in smoke they are consumed.
verses.36:21: A wicked person borrows and does not repay, whereas a righteous person shows grace and gives.
verses.36:22: For the ones blessed by Him will possess the land, and the ones cursed by Him will be cut off.
verses.36:23: By the LORD a man's steps are made firm, and He takes pleasure in his way.
verses.36:24: Though he falls, he will not be hurled down, for the LORD supports his hand.
verses.36:25: I was young, and I have also grown old, yet I have not seen a righteous person abandoned or his seed seeking bread.
verses.36:26: Throughout the day he shows grace and lends, and his seed is a blessing.
verses.36:27: Turn aside from evil and do what is good, and dwell forever.
verses.36:28: For the LORD loves justice and will not abandon His faithful ones; they are guarded forever, whereas the seed of the wicked is cut off.
verses.36:29: The righteous will possess the land and dwell on it forever.
verses.36:30: A righteous person's mouth voices wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.
verses.36:31: The instruction of his God is in his heart; his footsteps will not slip.
verses.36:32: A wicked person lies in wait for the righteous one and seeks to put him to death.
verses.36:33: The LORD will not abandon him in his hand, nor will He declare him guilty when he is judged.
verses.36:34: Wait for the LORD and observe His way, and He will raise you up to possess the land; when the wicked are cut off, you will look on.
verses.36:35: I have seen a ruthless wicked person spreading himself out like a lush native tree.
verses.36:36: Then he passed away, and look, he was gone; I sought him, yet he was not found.
verses.36:37: Observe the blameless and look at the upright, for a future belongs to a man of peace.
verses.36:38: But rebels will be destroyed together; the future of the wicked will be cut off.
verses.36:39: Now the salvation of the righteous comes from the LORD; He is their stronghold in a time of distress.
verses.36:40: And the LORD helps them and rescues them; He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in Him.
verses.37:1: A psalm of David, to bring to remembrance.
verses.37:2: LORD, do not reprove me in Your wrath, nor discipline me in Your fury.
verses.37:3: For Your arrows have sunk down into me, and Your hand has descended upon me.
verses.37:4: Nothing is sound in my flesh on account of Your indignation; there is no peace in my bones on account of my sin.
verses.37:5: For my iniquities have passed over my head; like a weighty load, they are too weighty for me.
verses.37:6: My wounds reek; they fester on account of my foolishness.
verses.37:7: I am bent and bowed low to the utmost; throughout the day I walk about mourning.
verses.37:8: For my flanks are full of burning, and nothing is sound in my flesh.
verses.37:9: I am numbed and crushed to the utmost; I roar from the groaning of my heart.
verses.37:10: Lord, before You is all my longing, and my sighing is not concealed from You.
verses.37:11: My heart pounds, my strength has abandoned me, and the light of my eyes—even that is not with me.
verses.37:12: Those who love me and my companions stand aloof from my affliction, and my relatives stand at a distance.
verses.37:13: Those seeking my life set snares, and those pursuing my harm speak of ruin; throughout the day they mutter deceits.
verses.37:14: Yet I, like a deaf person, do not hear; I am like a mute person who does not open his mouth.
verses.37:15: And I became like a man who does not hear, and in whose mouth there are no rebuttals.
verses.37:16: For it is You, LORD, for whom I wait; You Yourself will answer, Lord my God.
verses.37:17: For I said, "Do not let them gloat over me; when my foot slips, they exalt themselves over me."
verses.37:18: For I am about to stumble, and my pain is before me continually.
verses.37:19: For I declare my iniquity; I am anxious over my sin.
verses.37:20: Yet my enemies are vigorous and have grown mighty, and those who hate me falsely have grown numerous.
verses.37:21: And those who repay evil in return for good act as adversaries against me because I pursue what is good.
verses.37:22: Do not abandon me, LORD; my God, do not stay far from me.
verses.37:23: Hurry to my help, Lord, my salvation.
verses.38:1: For the music director, for Jeduthun. A psalm of David.
verses.38:2: I said, "I will keep watch over my ways so as not to sin with my tongue; I will keep a muzzle on my mouth while a wicked man is before me."
verses.38:3: I was mute in stillness; I kept silent from good, and my pain was stirred up.
verses.38:4: My heart grew hot inside me; in my musing, a fire blazed; I spoke with my tongue:
verses.38:5: "Make known to me, LORD, my end, and what the measure of my days is; may I know how transient I am.
verses.38:6: Look, You have made my days handbreadths, and my lifespan is like nothing before You; surely every person standing firm is altogether a breath. Selah.
verses.38:7: Surely as a shadow a man walks about; surely for a breath they are in commotion; he heaps things up and does not know who will gather them.
verses.38:8: And now, what am I waiting for, Lord? My expectation is in You.
verses.38:9: Rescue me from all my transgressions; do not make me the reproach of a fool.
verses.38:10: I am mute; I will not open my mouth, because You Yourself have acted.
verses.38:11: Take Your blow away from me; by the assault of Your hand I am spent.
verses.38:12: With rebukes for iniquity You discipline a man, and like a moth You dissolve what he treasures; surely every person is a breath. Selah.
verses.38:13: Hear my prayer, LORD, and listen closely to my cry for help; do not remain silent at my tears, for I am a sojourner with You, a temporary resident like all my fathers.
verses.38:14: Look away from me so that I may brighten up, before I go away and am no more."
verses.39:1: For the music director. A psalm of David.
verses.39:2: I waited earnestly for the LORD, and He inclined toward me and heard my cry for help.
verses.39:3: He brought me up from a pit of tumult, from the mud of the bog; He caused my feet to stand on a rock; He established my steps.
verses.39:4: And He placed a new song in my mouth, praise to our God. Many will see and be in awe, and they will trust in the LORD.
verses.39:5: Blessed is the man who has set the LORD as his trust, and has not turned to the arrogant or to those who swerve toward falsehood.
verses.39:6: Many are the wondrous deeds You Yourself have done, LORD my God, and Your plans toward us; there is no comparing to You. Should I declare and speak of them, they are too numerous to recount.
verses.39:7: Sacrifice and grain offering You did not delight in; ears You have dug for me; burnt offering and sin offering You did not ask for.
verses.39:8: Then I said, "Look, I have come; in the scroll of the book it is written concerning me.
verses.39:9: I delight in doing Your will, my God, and Your instruction is within my inward parts."
verses.39:10: I have announced the good news of righteousness in a great assembly; look, I do not hold back my lips; LORD, You Yourself know.
verses.39:11: Your righteousness I have not concealed within my heart; I have told of Your faithfulness and Your salvation; I have not kept Your loyal love and Your truth hidden from a great assembly.
verses.39:12: You, LORD, will not hold back Your compassion from me; Your loyal love and Your truth will guard me continually.
verses.39:13: For calamities without number have closed in around me; my iniquities have caught up with me, and I am unable to see; they are more numerous than the hairs of my head, and my heart has forsaken me.
verses.39:14: Be pleased, LORD, to rescue me; LORD, hurry to my help.
verses.39:15: May they be ashamed and disgraced together, those who seek my life to sweep it away; may they turn back and be humiliated, those who delight in my harm.
verses.39:16: May they be stunned on account of their shame, those who say to me, "Aha, aha!"
verses.39:17: May all who seek You exult and rejoice in You; may those who love Your salvation say continually, "May the LORD be magnified!"
verses.39:18: Yet I am afflicted and needy; the Lord gives thought to me. You are my help and my rescuer; my God, do not delay.
verses.40:1: For the music director. A psalm of David.
verses.40:2: Blessed is the one who is attentive to the weak; in a day of calamity the LORD will deliver him.
verses.40:3: The LORD will guard him and preserve his life, and he will be pronounced blessed in the land; and do not hand him over to the desire of his enemies.
verses.40:4: The LORD will uphold him on a bed of illness; You transform his entire bed in his sickness.
verses.40:5: I myself said, "LORD, show me grace; heal my soul, because I have sinned against You."
verses.40:6: My enemies speak evil concerning me: "When will he die and his name vanish?"
verses.40:7: And if one comes to visit, he speaks empty words; his heart collects wickedness for itself; he goes outside and speaks.
verses.40:8: Together all who hate me whisper against me; against me they scheme evil for me:
verses.40:9: "A ruinous thing has been poured into him; and now that he has lain down, he will not rise again."
verses.40:10: Even my close companion whom I trusted, the one who ate my bread, has raised his heel high against me.
verses.40:11: But You, LORD, show me grace and raise me up, so that I may pay them back.
verses.40:12: From this I know that You take delight in me, because my enemy does not raise a triumphant shout over me.
verses.40:13: And as for me, in my integrity You have held me fast, and You have stationed me before You forever.
verses.40:14: Blessed is the LORD, God of Israel, from eternity to eternity. Amen and Amen.
verses.41:1: For the music director: a Maskil of the sons of Korah.
verses.41:2: Just as a deer yearns for channels of water, so my soul yearns for You, God.
verses.41:3: My soul is thirsty for God, for the living God. When will I come and appear before the face of God?
verses.41:4: My tears have been bread for me day and night, while it is said to me all day long, "Where is your God?"
verses.41:5: I remember these things, and I pour out my soul within me: how I would pass along in the throng, walking in procession with them to the house of God, with the sound of jubilant shouting and thanksgiving, a crowd celebrating a festival.
verses.41:6: Why are you bowed down, my soul, and groaning within me? Wait in hope for God, for I will yet give thanks to Him for the deliverance of His presence.
verses.41:7: My God, my soul is bowed down within me; therefore I remember You from the land of Jordan and the Hermon summits, from Mount Mizar.
verses.41:8: Deep cries out to deep at the sound of Your cascades; all Your surges and Your waves have passed over me.
verses.41:9: In the daytime the LORD will command His loyal love, and in the night His song is with me, a prayer to the God of my life.
verses.41:10: I will say to God, my rock, "Why have You forgotten me? Why must I go in gloom because of the oppression of an enemy?"
verses.41:11: With a crushing in my bones, my foes reproach me, as they say to me all day long, "Where is your God?"
verses.41:12: Why are you bowed down, my soul, and why are you groaning within me? Wait in hope for God, for I will yet give thanks to Him, the deliverance of my face and my God.
verses.42:1: Vindicate me, God, and argue my case against an unfaithful nation; rescue me from a man of deceit and injustice.
verses.42:2: For You are the God of my stronghold; why have You rejected me? Why must I walk about in gloom because of the oppression of an enemy?
verses.42:3: Send forth Your light and Your truth; may they guide me; may they bring me to Your holy mountain and to Your dwelling places.
verses.42:4: Then I will come to the altar of God, to God, the gladness of my rejoicing; and I will give thanks to You with the lyre, God, my God.
verses.42:5: Why are you bowed down, my soul, and why are you groaning within me? Wait in hope for God, for I will yet give thanks to Him, the deliverance of my face and my God.
verses.43:1: For the music director: of the sons of Korah, a Maskil.
verses.43:2: God, with our ears we have heard; our fathers have recounted to us the deed You performed in their days, in days of old.
verses.43:3: You, with Your hand, dispossessed nations, yet You planted them; You afflicted peoples, yet You made them spread out.
verses.43:4: For they did not possess the land by their sword, nor did their arm save them; rather, it was Your right hand and Your arm and the light of Your face, because You favored them.
verses.43:5: You Yourself are my King, God; command deliverances for Jacob.
verses.43:6: By You we will thrust down our foes; in Your name we will trample those who rise against us.
verses.43:7: For I do not trust in my bow, and my sword will not save me.
verses.43:8: Instead, You have saved us from our foes, and those who hate us You have put to shame.
verses.43:9: In God we have gloried all day long, and to Your name we will give thanks forever. Selah.
verses.43:10: Yet You have rejected and humiliated us, and You do not march out with our armies.
verses.43:11: You turn us back from a foe, and those who hate us have taken plunder for themselves.
verses.43:12: You hand us over like sheep for food, and among the nations You have scattered us.
verses.43:13: You sell Your people for no wealth, and You have not raised their price.
verses.43:14: You set us as a reproach to our neighbors, a mockery and ridicule to those around us.
verses.43:15: You set us as a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
verses.43:16: All day long my humiliation is before me, and the shame of my face has covered me,
verses.43:17: at the voice of one who reproaches and reviles, because of an enemy and one seeking vengeance.
verses.43:18: All of this has come upon us, yet we have not forgotten You, and we have not acted falsely toward Your covenant.
verses.43:19: Our heart has not drawn back, nor have our steps turned aside from Your path.
verses.43:20: Yet You have crushed us in the place of jackals, and You have covered us over with deathly shadow.
verses.43:21: If we had forgotten the name of our God and spread out our palms to a foreign god,
verses.43:22: would God not search this out? For He knows the hidden things of the heart.
verses.43:23: Yet on Your account we are put to death all day long; we are reckoned like sheep for slaughter.
verses.43:24: Wake up! Why do You sleep, Lord? Awaken! Do not reject us forever.
verses.43:25: Why do You hide Your face, forgetting our affliction and our oppression?
verses.43:26: For our soul has bowed low to the dust; our belly has clung to the earth.
verses.43:27: Rise up as a help for us, and redeem us for the sake of Your loyal love.
verses.44:1: For the music director, according to Shoshannim, of the sons of Korah; a Maskil, a song of love.
verses.44:2: My heart stirs with a good word; I speak my works to a king; my tongue is the pen of a skilled scribe.
verses.44:3: You are far more handsome than the sons of mankind; grace has been poured onto your lips; for this reason God has blessed you forever.
verses.44:4: Strap your sword on your thigh, mighty warrior, in your splendor and your majesty!
verses.44:5: And in your majesty succeed, ride forth on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness; and may your right hand teach you fearsome deeds.
verses.44:6: Your arrows are sharp—peoples fall beneath you—in the heart of the enemies of the king.
verses.44:7: Your throne, God, is forever and ever; a scepter of equity is the scepter of Your kingdom.
verses.44:8: You loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, Your God, has anointed You with oil of gladness above Your companions.
verses.44:9: All your garments are myrrh, aloes, and cassia; from palaces of ivory, stringed instruments gladden you.
verses.44:10: Daughters of kings are among your esteemed women; the royal consort stands at your right hand in fine gold of Ophir.
verses.44:11: Listen, daughter, and see, and incline your ear, and forget your people and the house of your father;
verses.44:12: and the king will long for your beauty; for he is your lord, so bow down to him.
verses.44:13: And the daughter of Tyre—the wealthy of the people—will seek your favor with a gift.
verses.44:14: All glorious is the king's daughter within; her garment is of interwoven gold.
verses.44:15: In embroidered attire she is led to the king; virgins following her, her companions, are brought to you.
verses.44:16: They are led with gladness and exultation; they come into the king's palace.
verses.44:17: Instead of your fathers will be your sons; you will appoint them as princes throughout all the earth.
verses.44:18: I will make your name remembered in every generation; therefore peoples will praise you forever and ever.
verses.45:1: For the music director, of the sons of Korah, according to Alamoth; a song.
verses.45:2: God is a refuge and strength for us, a help in distresses, abundantly found.
verses.45:3: Therefore we will not be afraid, even when the earth changes and when mountains totter into the heart of the seas,
verses.45:4: though its waters roar and seethe, though mountains quake at its swelling. Selah.
verses.45:5: A river—its streams gladden the city of God, the holy place of the dwellings of the Most High.
verses.45:6: God is in her midst; she will not totter; God will help her at the break of morning.
verses.45:7: Nations roared, kingdoms tottered; He gave forth His voice, the earth melted.
verses.45:8: The LORD of hosts is with us; a high fortress for us is the God of Jacob. Selah.
verses.45:9: Come, gaze upon the deeds of the LORD, who has made desolations on the earth.
verses.45:10: He causes wars to cease as far as the end of the earth; He shatters the bow and cuts the spear apart; He burns wagons in the fire.
verses.45:11: "Desist, and know that I am God; I will be lifted high among the nations, I will be lifted high on the earth."
verses.45:12: The LORD of hosts is with us; a high fortress for us is the God of Jacob. Selah.
verses.46:1: For the music director, of the sons of Korah; a psalm.
verses.46:2: All peoples, clap your hands; shout aloud to God with a voice of jubilation.
verses.46:3: For the LORD, the Most High, is awesome—a great King over the whole earth.
verses.46:4: He subdues peoples beneath us, and nations beneath our feet.
verses.46:5: He chooses for us our inheritance, the pride of Jacob, whom He has loved. Selah.
verses.46:6: God has ascended amid a shout, the LORD with the sound of a ram's horn.
verses.46:7: Make music to God, make music; make music to our King, make music.
verses.46:8: For God is King of all the earth; make music with a Maskil.
verses.46:9: God reigns as King over the nations; God sits upon the throne of His holiness.
verses.46:10: The nobles of the peoples have gathered together as the people of the God of Abraham; for to God belong the shields of the earth; He is exceedingly exalted.
verses.47:1: A song, a psalm of the sons of Korah.
verses.47:2: The LORD is great and highly to be praised in the city of our God, His holy mountain.
verses.47:3: Lovely in height, the joy of the entire earth, is Mount Zion, the farthest reaches of the north, the city of the great King.
verses.47:4: In her citadels, God is known as a stronghold.
verses.47:5: For look, the kings assembled; they advanced together.
verses.47:6: They saw, and so they were stunned; they were dismayed, they fled in haste.
verses.47:7: Trembling gripped them there, agony like that of a woman giving birth.
verses.47:8: With an east wind You shatter the ships of Tarshish.
verses.47:9: Just as we heard, so we have seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God; God establishes her forever. Selah.
verses.47:10: We have pondered Your loyal love, God, in the midst of Your temple.
verses.47:11: Like Your name, God, so is Your praise to the bounds of the earth; Your right hand is full of righteousness.
verses.47:12: Let Mount Zion rejoice; let the daughters of Judah exult on account of Your judgments.
verses.47:13: Go around Zion and encircle her; count her towers.
