verses.88:52: with which Your enemies have taunted, LORD, with which they have taunted the footsteps of Your anointed.
verses.88:53: May the LORD be blessed forever! Amen and Amen.
verses.89:1: A prayer of Moses, the man of God. Lord, You have been a dwelling place for us from generation to generation.
verses.89:2: Before the mountains were born and You brought the earth and the world to birth, from eternity to eternity You are God.
verses.89:3: You turn humanity back to dust, and You say, "Turn back, sons of man."
verses.89:4: For a thousand years in Your eyes are like yesterday once it has passed, and like a watch in the night.
verses.89:5: You sweep them away in a torrent; they become like sleep, in the morning like grass that grows anew.
verses.89:6: In the morning it blossoms and grows anew; by evening it wilts and dries up.
verses.89:7: For we come to an end in Your anger, and in Your fury we are terrified.
verses.89:8: You have placed our iniquities in front of You, our hidden wrongdoing in the light of Your face.
verses.89:9: For all our days decline in Your wrath; we bring our years to a close like a sigh.
verses.89:10: The days of our years amount to seventy years, and if through strength, eighty years; yet their boast is toil and sorrow, for it passes swiftly and we fly away.
verses.89:11: Who knows the strength of Your anger, and Your wrath corresponding to the fear due You?
verses.89:12: Thus teach us to count our days, so that we may acquire a heart of wisdom.
verses.89:13: Turn back, LORD! How long? And relent toward Your servants.
verses.89:14: Satisfy us in the morning with Your loyal love, so that we may shout for joy and be glad throughout all our days.
verses.89:15: Make us glad in proportion to the days You have afflicted us, the years we have seen calamity.
verses.89:16: May Your work appear to Your servants, and Your splendor upon their children.
verses.89:17: And may the favor of the Lord our God be upon us; establish for us the work of our hands, and the work of our hands, establish it.
verses.90:1: The one who dwells in the hiding place of the Most High will lodge in the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.90:2: I say to the LORD, "My refuge and my stronghold, my God; in Him I will trust."
verses.90:3: For He Himself will rescue you from the snare of a fowler, from devastating pestilence.
verses.90:4: With His pinions He will shelter you, and beneath His wings you will take refuge; His faithfulness is a large shield and rampart.
verses.90:5: You will not fear the dread of night, nor an arrow that flies by day,
verses.90:6: nor pestilence that walks in thick darkness, nor a scourge that devastates at midday.
verses.90:7: A thousand may fall by your side, and ten thousand at your right hand, yet it will not draw near to you.
verses.90:8: Only with your eyes will you look on, and you will see the repayment of the wicked.
verses.90:9: For You, LORD, are my refuge; you have made the Most High your dwelling place.
verses.90:10: No calamity will come upon you, and no plague will approach your tent.
verses.90:11: For He will command His angels on your behalf, to watch over you in all your ways.
verses.90:12: Upon their palms they will lift you up, so that you do not strike your foot on a stone.
verses.90:13: Upon the lion and the cobra you will tread; you will trample the young lion and the serpent.
verses.90:14: "Because he has set his affection on Me, I will deliver him; I will set him high in safety, because he knows My name.
verses.90:15: He will call to Me, and I will answer him; I am with him in distress; I will free him and honor him.
verses.90:16: With length of days I will satisfy him, and I will let him look upon My salvation."
verses.91:1: A psalm, a song for the day of the Sabbath.
verses.91:2: It is good to give thanks to the LORD, and to make music to Your name, Most High,
verses.91:3: to declare Your loyal love in the morning, and Your faithfulness in the nights,
verses.91:4: with a ten-stringed instrument and with the harp, with resonant melody on the lyre.
verses.91:5: For You have made me glad, LORD, through Your work; at the works of Your hands I will shout for joy.
verses.91:6: How great Your works are, LORD! Exceedingly deep are Your thoughts!
verses.91:7: A senseless man does not know, and a fool does not understand this:
verses.91:8: that when the wicked flourish like grass and all workers of iniquity blossom, it is for them to be destroyed forever.
verses.91:9: Yet You are on high forever, LORD.
verses.91:10: For look, Your enemies, LORD, for look, Your enemies will perish; all workers of iniquity will be dispersed.
verses.91:11: Yet You have raised my horn like that of a wild ox; I have been drenched with fresh oil.
verses.91:12: And my eye has looked upon those lying in wait for me; my ears will hear of the wicked who rise against me.
verses.91:13: The righteous one will flourish like a palm tree; like a cedar in Lebanon he will grow tall.
verses.91:14: Planted in the house of the LORD, in the courts of our God they will flourish.
verses.91:15: They will still produce fruit in old age; they will be rich with sap and fresh,
verses.91:16: to declare that the LORD is upright; He is my rock, and in Him there is no injustice.
verses.92:1: The LORD reigns; He is arrayed in majesty. The LORD is arrayed; He has belted Himself with strength. Surely the world is set firm; it will not be shaken.
verses.92:2: Your throne is set firm from long ago; You are from eternity.
verses.92:3: The rivers have lifted up, LORD, the rivers have lifted up their voice; the rivers lift up their crashing waves.
verses.92:4: Above the voices of many waters—mighty are the breakers of the sea—mighty on high is the LORD.
verses.92:5: Your testimonies are exceedingly reliable; holiness is fitting for Your house, LORD, for length of days.
verses.93:1: God of vengeance, LORD, God of vengeance, shine out!
verses.93:2: Lift Yourself up, Judge of the earth; bring back recompense upon the arrogant.
verses.93:3: How long will the wicked, LORD, how long will the wicked triumph?
verses.93:4: They pour out, they speak insolence; all doers of iniquity boast.
verses.93:5: Your people, LORD, they crush, and Your inheritance they oppress.
verses.93:6: Widow and sojourner they kill, and orphans they murder.
verses.93:7: And they say, "The LORD does not see, and the God of Jacob does not pay attention."
verses.93:8: Pay attention, you brutish ones among the people; and you fools, when will you gain insight?
verses.93:9: The One who planted the ear, will He not hear? Or the One who shaped the eye, will He not look?
verses.93:10: The One who disciplines nations, will He not reprove—the One who teaches mankind knowledge?
verses.93:11: The LORD knows the thoughts of mankind, that they are vapor.
verses.93:12: How blessed is the man whom You discipline, LORD, and whom You teach from Your instruction,
verses.93:13: to grant him quiet from days of adversity, until a pit is dug for the wicked one.
verses.93:14: For the LORD will not desert His people, and His inheritance He will not forsake.
verses.93:15: For justice will return to righteousness, and after it will follow all who are upright of heart.
verses.93:16: Who will rise up for me against those who do evil? Who will stand firm for me against doers of iniquity?
verses.93:17: Had the LORD not been a help to me, my soul would soon have dwelt in silence.
verses.93:18: When I said, "My foot has slipped," Your loyal love, LORD, sustained me.
verses.93:19: In the abundance of my anxious thoughts within me, Your comforts gladden my soul.
verses.93:20: Can a throne of ruin be joined with You, one that shapes trouble by statute?
verses.93:21: They band together against the life of a righteous person, and innocent blood they pronounce guilty.
verses.93:22: Yet the LORD has become a fortress to me, and my God the rock of my shelter.
verses.93:23: And He has brought back upon them their iniquity, and through their wickedness He will cut them off; the LORD our God will cut them off.
verses.94:1: Come, let us sing with joy to the LORD; let us shout in triumph to the rock of our salvation.
verses.94:2: Let us approach His presence with thanksgiving; with songs let us shout in triumph to Him.
verses.94:3: For a great God is the LORD, and a great King over all gods.
verses.94:4: In His hand are the deep recesses of the earth, and the summits of the mountains belong to Him.
verses.94:5: His is the sea, and He Himself made it; and the dry land His hands shaped.
verses.94:6: Come, let us bow down and bend low; let us kneel before the LORD who made us.
verses.94:7: For He is our God, and we are the people of His pasture and the flock of His hand. Today, if only you would listen to His voice!
verses.94:8: "Do not harden your heart as at Meribah, like the day of Massah in the wilderness,
verses.94:9: where your forefathers tested Me, put Me to the proof, even though they saw My work.
verses.94:10: For forty years I was disgusted with that generation, and I said, 'They are a people wandering in heart, and they have not known My ways.'
verses.94:11: So I swore in My anger, 'They will certainly not come into My rest.'"
verses.95:1: Sing a new song to the LORD; sing to the LORD, all the earth.
verses.95:2: Sing to the LORD, bless His name; proclaim the good news of His salvation from day to day.
verses.95:3: Recount His glory among the nations, His wondrous deeds among all the peoples.
verses.95:4: For the LORD is great and highly to be praised; He is to be feared beyond all gods.
verses.95:5: For all the gods of the peoples are empty idols, yet the LORD made the heavens.
verses.95:6: Majesty and splendor are before Him; might and beauty are in His sanctuary.
verses.95:7: Ascribe to the LORD, clans of the peoples, ascribe to the LORD glory and might.
verses.95:8: Ascribe to the LORD the glory of His name; carry an offering and come into His courtyards.
verses.95:9: Bow down to the LORD in the splendor of holiness; quake at His presence, all the earth.
verses.95:10: Say among the nations, "The LORD reigns! Indeed, the world is established; it will not be shaken. He will judge the peoples with uprightness."
verses.95:11: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth exult; let the sea and its fullness roar.
verses.95:12: Let the field rejoice, and all that is in it; then all the trees of the forest will ring out in joy
verses.95:13: in the presence of the LORD, for He is coming, for He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with His faithfulness.
verses.96:1: The LORD reigns! Let the earth exult; let many coastlands be glad.
verses.96:2: Cloud and dense darkness are around Him; the foundation of His throne is righteousness and justice.
verses.96:3: Fire goes ahead of Him and burns up His foes on every side.
verses.96:4: His lightning bolts lit up the world; the earth saw and quaked.
verses.96:5: Mountains melted like wax before the LORD, before the Lord of all the earth.
verses.96:6: The heavens have declared His righteousness, and all the peoples have seen His glory.
verses.96:7: May all who serve carved images be put to shame, those who boast in empty idols; bow down to Him, all you gods.
verses.96:8: Zion heard and was glad, and the daughters of Judah exulted because of Your judgments, LORD.
verses.96:9: For You, LORD, are Most High above all the earth; You are exceedingly exalted above all gods.
verses.96:10: You who love the LORD, hate evil! He guards the lives of His devoted ones; from the hand of the wicked He delivers them.
verses.96:11: Light has been sown for the righteous, and for the upright in heart, gladness.
verses.96:12: Be glad in the LORD, you righteous, and give thanks to the remembrance of His holiness.
verses.97:1: A psalm. Sing a new song to the LORD, for He has done wondrous deeds; His right hand and His holy arm have brought salvation for Him.
verses.97:2: The LORD has made His salvation known; before the eyes of the nations He has revealed His righteousness.
verses.97:3: He has remembered His loyal love and His faithfulness toward the house of Israel; all the farthest ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.97:4: Shout in triumph to the LORD, all the earth; burst forth, ring out in joy, and make music.
verses.97:5: Make music to the LORD with the lyre, with the lyre and the voice of song.
verses.97:6: With trumpets and the sound of the ram's horn, shout in triumph before the King, the LORD.
verses.97:7: Let the sea and its fullness roar, the world and those dwelling in it.
verses.97:8: May rivers clap their hands; may mountains ring out in joy together
verses.97:9: in the presence of the LORD, for He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with uprightness.
verses.98:1: The LORD reigns; the peoples tremble. He is seated upon the cherubim; the earth reels.
verses.98:2: In Zion the LORD is great, and He is high above all the peoples.
verses.98:3: Let them give thanks to Your name, great and awe-inspiring; He is holy.
verses.98:4: And the might of the King loves justice. You Yourself have established uprightness; You have carried out justice and righteousness in Jacob.
verses.98:5: Exalt the LORD our God, and bow low at His footstool; He is holy.
verses.98:6: Moses and Aaron were among His priests, and Samuel among those calling on His name. They would call to the LORD, and He would answer them.
verses.98:7: In a pillar of cloud He would speak to them; they kept His testimonies and the statute He gave them.
verses.98:8: LORD our God, You Yourself answered them; You were to them a God who forgave, yet took vengeance for their deeds.
verses.98:9: Exalt the LORD our God, and bow low at His holy mountain, for the LORD our God is holy.
verses.99:1: A psalm for thanksgiving. Shout in triumph to the LORD, all the earth.
verses.99:2: Serve the LORD with joy; come before Him with jubilant song.
verses.99:3: Know that the LORD is God; He Himself made us, and we belong to Him; we are His people and the flock of His pasture.
verses.99:4: Come into His gates with thanksgiving, into His courts with praise; give thanks to Him; bless His name.
verses.99:5: For the LORD is good; His loyal love lasts forever, and His faithfulness to generation after generation.
verses.100:1: Of David. A psalm. Of loyal love and justice I will sing; to You, LORD, I will make melody.
verses.100:2: I will give attention to the blameless way. When will You come to me? I will walk in the integrity of my heart within my house.
verses.100:3: I will not place before my eyes any vile thing. I hate the practice of unfaithful deeds; it will not cling to me.
verses.100:4: A twisted heart will depart from me; evil I will not know.
verses.100:5: The one who slanders his neighbor in secret, him I will wipe out; the one with haughty eyes and an arrogant heart, him I cannot endure.
verses.100:6: My eyes are on the trustworthy of the land, so that they may dwell with me; the one who walks in the blameless way, he will serve me.
verses.100:7: Within my house, one who practices deceit will not dwell; one who speaks lies will not be established before my eyes.
verses.100:8: Morning by morning I will wipe out all the wicked of the land, to cut off from the city of the LORD all workers of iniquity.
verses.101:1: A prayer for an afflicted one when he grows faint and pours out his lament before the LORD.
verses.101:2: LORD, hear my prayer, and may my cry for help come to You.
verses.101:3: Do not hide Your face from me on the day I am in distress; bend Your ear to me; on the day I call, quickly answer me.
verses.101:4: For my days have vanished in smoke, and my bones are scorched like a hearth.
verses.101:5: Struck down like grass, my heart has withered, for I have forgotten to eat my bread.
verses.101:6: From the sound of my groaning, my bone clings to my flesh.
verses.101:7: I resemble an owl of the wilderness; I have become like a little owl of the ruins.
verses.101:8: I stay awake, and I have become like a solitary bird on a roof.
verses.101:9: All day long my enemies reproach me; those who rage against me swear oaths by me.
verses.101:10: For I eat ashes as bread, and I mix my drink with weeping,
verses.101:11: because of Your indignation and Your fury, for You lifted me up and flung me away.
verses.101:12: My days are like a shadow stretched out, and as for me, I wither like grass.
verses.101:13: Yet You, LORD, sit enthroned forever, and Your remembrance is from generation to generation.
verses.101:14: You will rise up; You will show compassion to Zion, for it is time to show grace to her, because the set time has arrived.
verses.101:15: For Your servants delight in her stones, and they pity her dust.
verses.101:16: Then nations will fear the LORD's name, and all the kings of the earth, Your glory.
verses.101:17: For the LORD has built Zion; He has been seen in His glory.
verses.101:18: He has turned toward the prayer of the destitute and has not disdained their prayer.
verses.101:19: Let this be written for a later generation, and a people to be created will praise the LORD.
verses.101:20: For He looked down from the height of His holiness; the LORD gazed from heaven toward the earth,
verses.101:21: to hear the groaning of a prisoner, to unbind those doomed to death,
verses.101:22: so that they may recount in Zion the LORD's name, and His praise in Jerusalem,
verses.101:23: when peoples are assembled together, and kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
verses.101:24: Along the way He has weakened my strength; He has cut short my days.
verses.101:25: I say, "My God, do not carry me off in the middle of my days; Your years are through generation after generation."
verses.101:26: Long ago You founded the earth, and heaven is the work of Your hands.
verses.101:27: They will perish, yet You will stand firm; and all of them will wear away like a garment; like a robe You will replace them, and they will pass away.
verses.101:28: Yet You are the same, and Your years will not end.
verses.101:29: The children of Your servants will abide, and before You their seed will be established.
verses.102:1: Of David. Bless the LORD, my soul, and all my inward parts, His holy name.
verses.102:2: Bless the LORD, my soul, and do not forget any of His benefits.
verses.102:3: He is the One who pardons all your iniquity, who heals all your illnesses,
verses.102:4: who redeems your life out of the pit, who crowns you with loyal love and compassion,
verses.102:5: who satisfies your lifetime with good, so that your youth renews itself like the eagle's.
verses.102:6: The LORD carries out acts of righteousness and judgments for all who are oppressed.
verses.102:7: He made His ways known to Moses; to the sons of Israel, His deeds.
verses.102:8: Compassionate and gracious is the LORD, slow to anger and great in loyal love.
verses.102:9: He will not contend perpetually, nor will He retain anger forever.
verses.102:10: Not according to our sins has He dealt with us, and not according to our iniquities has He repaid us.
verses.102:11: For as high as heaven is above the earth, so mighty is His loyal love over those who fear Him.
verses.102:12: As far as east is from west, He has put our transgressions far from us.
verses.102:13: Just as a father feels compassion for children, so the LORD feels compassion for those who fear Him.
verses.102:14: For He Himself knows our form, mindful that we are dust.
verses.102:15: As for a mortal, his days are like grass; like a blossom of the field, so he blossoms.
verses.102:16: For a wind passes over it, and it is no more, and its place no longer recognizes it.
verses.102:17: Yet the LORD's loyal love is from eternity to eternity upon those who fear Him, and His righteousness is for children's children,
verses.102:18: for those who keep His covenant and for those who remember His precepts to carry them out.
verses.102:19: In the heavens the LORD has established His throne, and His kingdom rules over everything.
verses.102:20: Bless the LORD, His angels, mighty in power, who carry out His word, heeding the voice of His word.
verses.102:21: Bless the LORD, all His hosts, His attendants who carry out His will.
verses.102:22: Bless the LORD, all His works, in all the places of His rule. Bless the LORD, my soul.
verses.103:1: Bless the LORD, my soul! LORD my God, You are exceedingly great; You are robed in majesty and splendor,
verses.103:2: wrapping Yourself in light like a cloak, stretching out the heavens like a tent curtain.
verses.103:3: who lays the beams of His upper chambers in the waters, who sets the clouds as His chariot, who walks on the wings of the wind,
verses.103:4: making winds His messengers, blazing fire His attendants.
verses.103:5: He founded the earth on its bases; it will not be shaken forever and ever.
verses.103:6: With the deep like a garment You covered it; above the mountains the waters stood.
verses.103:7: At Your rebuke they fled; at the sound of Your thunder they rushed away in alarm.
verses.103:8: They went up over the mountains, they descended into the valleys, to the place that You founded for them.
verses.103:9: You set a boundary that they must not cross; they will not return to cover the earth.
verses.103:10: He sends out springs into the ravines; between the mountains they flow along.
verses.103:11: They provide drink for every wild animal of the field; wild donkeys quench their thirst.
verses.103:12: By them the birds of the heavens dwell; from among the leafy branches they give voice.
verses.103:13: From His upper chambers He waters the mountains; with the fruit of Your works the earth is satisfied.
verses.103:14: He makes grass sprout for the livestock, and plants for the labor of mankind, to bring forth bread from the earth;
verses.103:15: and wine gladdens the heart of mortal man, to make the face gleam with oil, and bread sustains the heart of mortal man.
verses.103:16: The trees of the LORD are satisfied, the cedars of Lebanon that He planted,
verses.103:17: where birds nest; as for the stork, cypress trees are her home.
verses.103:18: The lofty mountains are for the wild goats; crags are a refuge for the rock hyraxes.
verses.103:19: He made the moon for appointed seasons; the sun knows its setting.
verses.103:20: You bring darkness, and it is night; in it every wild animal of the forest moves about.
verses.103:21: The young lions roar for prey, and they seek their food from God.
verses.103:22: The sun rises; they draw back, and in their dens they lie down.
verses.103:23: Man sets out to his work and to his labor until evening.
verses.103:24: How numerous are Your works, LORD! All of them You made in wisdom; the earth is full of Your creation.
verses.103:25: Here is the sea, great and broad on both sides; there are teeming things without number, living creatures, small along with great.
verses.103:26: There ships travel along, and Leviathan, whom You fashioned to play in it.
verses.103:27: All of them look expectantly to You to give them their food in its time.
verses.103:28: When You give to them, they gather it; when You open Your hand, they are satisfied with what is good.
verses.103:29: When You conceal Your face, they are alarmed; when You withdraw their breath, they expire, and to their dust they return.
verses.103:30: When You send out Your Spirit, they are created, and You restore the face of the ground.
verses.103:31: May the glory of the LORD be forever; may the LORD be glad in His works!
verses.103:32: He is the One who gazes at the earth, and it quakes; He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
verses.103:33: I will sing to the LORD throughout my life; I will make music to my God as long as I exist.
verses.103:34: May my meditation be sweet to Him; I myself will be glad in the LORD.
verses.103:35: May sinners be consumed from the earth, and may the wicked exist no longer! Bless the LORD, my soul! Praise the LORD!
verses.104:1: Give thanks to the LORD, call on His name; make His acts known among the peoples.
verses.104:2: Sing to Him, make melody to Him; speak about all His marvelous deeds.
verses.104:3: Boast in His holy name; let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
verses.104:4: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face constantly.
verses.104:5: Remember His marvelous deeds that He performed, His wonders and the judgments of His mouth,
verses.104:6: seed of Abraham His servant, sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
verses.104:7: He is the LORD our God; throughout all the earth are His judgments.
verses.104:8: He has remembered His covenant forever, the word He commanded for a thousand generations,
verses.104:9: which He made with Abraham, and His oath to Isaac.
verses.104:10: And He established it for Jacob as a statute, for Israel as an everlasting covenant,
verses.104:11: saying, "To you I will give the land of Canaan, the allotment of your inheritance."
verses.104:12: When they were men few in number, very few, and sojourners in it,
verses.104:13: they went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
verses.104:14: He did not permit anyone to oppress them, and because of them He reproved kings:
verses.104:15: "Do not touch My anointed ones, and to My prophets do no harm."
verses.104:16: Then He summoned a famine on the land; He broke every staff of bread.
verses.104:17: He sent a man ahead of them; Joseph was sold as a slave.
verses.104:18: They afflicted his foot with a fetter; his soul came into iron.
verses.104:19: Until the time his word came about, the utterance of the LORD refined him.
verses.104:20: The king sent and freed him, the ruler of peoples, and released him.
verses.104:21: He appointed him master of his house and ruler over all his property,
verses.104:22: to bind his officials at his will, and to make his elders wise.
verses.104:23: So Israel entered Egypt, and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
verses.104:24: And He made His people exceedingly fruitful, and made them mightier than their adversaries.
verses.104:25: He turned their heart to hate His people, to plot craftily against His servants.
verses.104:26: He sent His servant Moses, and Aaron, whom He chose.
verses.104:27: They performed among them the words of His signs, and wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.104:28: He sent darkness, and it grew dark; and they did not rebel against His word.
verses.104:29: He turned their waters into blood and killed their fish.
verses.104:30: Their land teemed with frogs, in the chambers of their kings.
verses.104:31: He spoke, and a swarm of flies came, gnats throughout all their territory.
verses.104:32: He made their rains hail, flaming fire in their land.
verses.104:33: And He struck their vines and their fig trees, and broke to pieces the trees of their territory.
verses.104:34: He spoke, and locusts came, and creeping locusts beyond number,
verses.104:35: and they devoured every plant in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.
verses.104:36: And He struck every firstborn in their land, the first of all their vigor.
verses.104:37: And He brought them out with silver and gold, and not one among His tribes stumbled.
verses.104:38: Egypt rejoiced when they went out, for dread of them had fallen on them.
verses.104:39: He spread out a cloud for a covering, and fire to illuminate the night.
verses.104:40: They asked, and He brought quail, and with bread of heaven He satisfied them.
verses.104:41: He opened the rock, and waters streamed out; they flowed through the dry places as a river.
verses.104:42: For He remembered His holy word, and Abraham His servant.
verses.104:43: And He brought out His people with gladness, His chosen ones with joyful singing.
verses.104:44: And He gave to them the lands of the nations, and they possessed the toil of the peoples,
verses.104:45: in order that they might keep His statutes and guard His laws. Praise the LORD!
verses.105:1: Praise the LORD! Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good, for His loyal love lasts forever.
verses.105:2: Who can recount the mighty deeds of the LORD, or make all His praise heard?
verses.105:3: Blessed are those who keep justice, the one who practices righteousness at all times.
verses.105:4: Remember me, LORD, with Your favor for Your people; attend to me with Your salvation,
verses.105:5: so that I may see the welfare of Your chosen ones, be glad in the gladness of Your nation, and exult alongside Your heritage.
verses.105:6: We have sinned along with our fathers; we have acted perversely, we have acted wickedly.
verses.105:7: Our fathers in Egypt did not comprehend Your wondrous deeds; they did not remember the abundance of Your acts of loyal love, and they rebelled beside the sea, at the Sea of Reeds.
verses.105:8: Yet He saved them for the sake of His name, to make His might known.
verses.105:9: He rebuked the Sea of Reeds, and it dried up; then He led them through the depths as across a wilderness.
verses.105:10: And He saved them from the hand of one who hated them, and He redeemed them from the enemy's hand.
verses.105:11: The waters covered their foes; not a single one of them remained.
verses.105:12: So they believed in His words; they sang out His praise.
verses.105:13: They were quick to forget His deeds; they did not await His counsel.
verses.105:14: And they longed with fierce craving in the wilderness, and tested God in the wasteland.
verses.105:15: So He granted them their request, yet He sent a wasting illness into their souls.
verses.105:16: And they grew jealous of Moses in the camp, and of Aaron, the LORD's holy one.
verses.105:17: The ground opened up and swallowed Dathan, and covered over the assembly of Abiram.
verses.105:18: And fire blazed in their assembly; a flame devoured the wicked.
verses.105:19: They made a calf at Horeb, and bowed down to a molten image.
verses.105:20: And they traded their glory for the likeness of an ox that eats grass.
verses.105:21: They forgot God, their Savior, the One who performed great deeds in Egypt,
verses.105:22: wondrous deeds in the land of Ham, fearsome deeds beside the Sea of Reeds.
verses.105:23: Then He declared He would destroy them—had Moses, His chosen one, not stood in the breach before Him to turn back His fury from bringing ruin.
verses.105:24: And they rejected the desirable land; they did not believe His word.
verses.105:25: And they grumbled in their tents; they did not heed the voice of the LORD.
verses.105:26: So He lifted His hand to them to cause them to fall in the wilderness,
verses.105:27: and to cause their seed to fall among the nations, and to scatter them across the lands.
verses.105:28: Then they bound themselves to Baal of Peor, and they ate sacrifices to the dead.
verses.105:29: So they provoked Him to anger by their practices, and a plague burst out among them.
verses.105:30: But Phinehas stood up and executed judgment, and the plague was halted.
verses.105:31: And it was credited to him as righteousness, for generation after generation, forever.
verses.105:32: And they provoked Him to wrath at the waters of Meribah, and it went badly for Moses on account of them,
verses.105:33: for they rebelled against His Spirit, and he spoke thoughtlessly with his lips.
verses.105:34: They did not destroy the peoples about whom the LORD had spoken to them.
verses.105:35: Instead, they mingled among the nations and learned their deeds.
verses.105:36: And they served their idols, and these became a trap for them.
verses.105:37: And they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to the demons,
verses.105:38: and poured out innocent blood—the blood of their sons and their daughters whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan—and the land was profaned by bloodshed.
verses.105:39: So they became unclean through their deeds, and they prostituted themselves in their practices.
verses.105:40: Therefore the LORD's anger burned against His people, and He detested His heritage.
verses.105:41: And He turned them over into the hand of nations, and those who hated them ruled over them.
verses.105:42: And their enemies oppressed them, and they were subdued beneath their hand.
verses.105:43: Many times He would rescue them, yet they kept rebelling in their counsel and sank low because of their iniquity.
verses.105:44: Yet He looked on their distress when He heard their outcry.
verses.105:45: And He remembered His covenant on their behalf, and He relented in accordance with the abundance of His acts of loyal love.
verses.105:46: And He caused them to find compassion before all their captors.
verses.105:47: Save us, LORD our God, and gather us out of the nations, to give thanks to Your holy name, and to boast in Your praise.
verses.105:48: Blessed be the LORD, God of Israel, from eternity to eternity! And let all the people say, "Amen!" Praise the LORD!
verses.106:1: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good, for His loyal love is forever.
verses.106:2: Let those redeemed by the LORD say this, whom He redeemed from the hand of the foe.
verses.106:3: And He gathered them from the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the sea.
verses.106:4: They wandered in the wilderness, on a wasteland path; they did not find a city to live in.
verses.106:5: Hungry and thirsty as well, their soul grew faint within them.
verses.106:6: Then they cried out to the LORD in their distress; He rescued them from their anguish.
verses.106:7: He guided them along a straight path, to go to a city to live in.
verses.106:8: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loyal love and for His marvelous deeds toward the children of mankind.
verses.106:9: For He has satisfied the yearning soul, and He has filled the hungry soul with good things.
verses.106:10: There were those sitting in darkness and deep shadow, prisoners of affliction and iron.
verses.106:11: For they rebelled against God's words and scorned the counsel of the Most High.
verses.106:12: So He subdued their heart with hard labor; they stumbled, and there was no helper.
verses.106:13: Then they cried out to the LORD in their distress; He saved them from their anguish.
verses.106:14: He brought them out of darkness and deep shadow, and He tore their bonds apart.
verses.106:15: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loyal love and for His marvelous deeds toward the children of mankind.
verses.106:16: For He has shattered bronze doors and cut through iron bars.
verses.106:17: Fools, on account of the path of their transgression and on account of their iniquities, were afflicted.
verses.106:18: Their soul detested all food, and they reached as far as the gates of death.
verses.106:19: Then they cried out to the LORD in their distress; He saved them from their anguish.
verses.106:20: He sent His word and healed them, and He delivered them from their pits.
verses.106:21: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loyal love and for His marvelous deeds toward the children of mankind.
verses.106:22: And let them sacrifice thanksgiving offerings and recount His works with joyful shouting.
verses.106:23: Those going down to the sea in ships, conducting business on mighty waters,
verses.106:24: they saw the works of the LORD and His marvelous deeds in the deep.
verses.106:25: And He spoke and raised up a storm wind, which lifted its waves high.
verses.106:26: They ascended to the heavens, they descended to the depths; their soul melted away in calamity.
verses.106:27: They reeled and swayed like a drunkard, and all their wisdom was swallowed up.
verses.106:28: Then they cried out to the LORD in their distress, and He brought them out of their anguish.
verses.106:29: He brought the storm to stillness, and their waves grew quiet.
verses.106:30: Then they rejoiced because they became calm, and He led them to the harbor of their desire.
verses.106:31: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loyal love and for His marvelous deeds toward the children of mankind.
verses.106:32: Let them exalt Him in the assembly of the people and praise Him in the session of the elders.
verses.106:33: He turns rivers into a wilderness and springs of water into parched ground,
verses.106:34: a fruitful land into a salt flat, on account of the wickedness of those living in it.
verses.106:35: He turns a wilderness into a pool of water, and an arid land into springs of water.
verses.106:36: And there He settles the hungry, and they establish a city to live in.
verses.106:37: They sow fields and plant vineyards, and they produce a fruitful crop.
verses.106:38: He blesses them, and they increase greatly, and He does not diminish their livestock.
verses.106:39: Yet they grow few and sink low because of oppression, calamity, and grief.
verses.106:40: He pours contempt upon nobles and makes them wander in a wasteland with no path.
verses.106:41: Yet He lifts the needy safely out of affliction and makes families like a flock.
verses.106:42: The upright see it and rejoice, and all injustice shuts its mouth.
verses.106:43: Who is wise? Let him observe these things, and let them closely consider the LORD's acts of loyal love.
verses.107:1: A song, a psalm of David.
verses.107:2: My heart is firm, God; I will sing and make music, even with my glory.
verses.107:3: Wake up, harp and lyre; I will awaken the dawn.
verses.107:4: I will give thanks to You among the peoples, LORD, and I will make music to You among the nations.
verses.107:5: For great above the heavens is Your loyal love, and as far as the clouds is Your faithfulness.
verses.107:6: Be exalted above the heavens, God, and may Your glory be over all the earth.
verses.107:7: So that Your beloved ones may be rescued, save by Your right hand and answer me.
verses.107:8: God spoke in His holiness: "I will exult; I will divide Shechem, and I will measure off the valley of Succoth.
verses.107:9: Mine is Gilead, Mine is Manasseh; and Ephraim is the stronghold of My head; Judah is My ruler's staff.
verses.107:10: Moab is My washing basin; onto Edom I will throw My sandal; over Philistia I will shout triumphantly."
verses.107:11: Who will lead me into the fortified city? Who will guide me as far as Edom?
verses.107:12: Have You not cast us off, God? And You do not go out, God, with our armies.
verses.107:13: Grant us help against the foe, for salvation by man is worthless.
verses.107:14: Through God we will perform valiant deeds, and He Himself will trample our foes.
verses.108:1: For the music director; a psalm of David. God of my praise, do not remain silent.
verses.108:2: For they have opened a wicked mouth and a deceitful mouth against me; they have spoken to me with a tongue of falsehood.
verses.108:3: And words of hatred have encircled me, and they have fought against me without reason.
verses.108:4: In return for my love they accuse me, while I am at prayer.
verses.108:5: And they have laid evil upon me in return for good, and hatred in return for my love.
verses.108:6: Put a wicked man over him, and may an accuser stand at his right hand.
verses.108:7: When he is judged, may he go out guilty, and may his prayer turn into sin.
verses.108:8: May his days be few; may someone else take his office.
verses.108:9: May his children become fatherless, and his wife a widow.
verses.108:10: May his children constantly wander about and beg, and may they search far from their ruins.
verses.108:11: May a creditor ensnare all that is his, and may strangers loot his labor.
verses.108:12: May there be no one to continue loyal love to him, and no one to show favor to his fatherless children.
verses.108:13: May his descendants be cut off; in the next generation may their name be wiped out.
verses.108:14: May the iniquity of his forefathers be remembered before the LORD, and may his mother's sin not be wiped out.
verses.108:15: May they remain before the LORD continually, and may He cut off their memory from the earth,
verses.108:16: because he did not remember to practice loyal love, but pursued an afflicted and needy man, one broken in heart, to put him to death.
verses.108:17: He loved cursing, and it came upon him; he had no delight in blessing, and it stayed far from him.
verses.108:18: He clothed himself with cursing like his robe, and it went like water into his inward parts and like oil into his bones.
verses.108:19: May it be for him like clothing he wraps himself in, and like a belt he continually fastens on.
verses.108:20: May this be the wages for my accusers from the LORD, and for those who speak evil against my soul.
verses.108:21: But You, GOD the Lord, act for me for the sake of Your name; because Your loyal love is good, rescue me.
verses.108:22: For I am afflicted and needy, and my heart is pierced within me.
verses.108:23: Like a shadow as it stretches out, I pass away; I am shaken off like a locust.
verses.108:24: My knees falter from fasting, and my flesh has wasted away for lack of fat.
verses.108:25: And I have become an object of reproach to them; when they see me, they shake their heads.
verses.108:26: Help me, LORD my God; save me according to Your loyal love.
verses.108:27: And may they know that this is Your hand; You, LORD, have done it.
verses.108:28: Let them curse, but You bless; when they rise up, they will be put to shame, while Your servant will rejoice.
verses.108:29: May my accusers be clothed with disgrace, and may they wrap themselves in their shame as in a robe.
verses.108:30: I will thank the LORD abundantly with my mouth, and in the midst of the many I will praise Him.
verses.108:31: For He stands at the right hand of a needy person, to save him from those who pass judgment on his soul.
verses.109:1: A psalm of David. The declaration of the LORD to my lord: "Sit at My right hand until I set your enemies as a footstool for your feet."
verses.109:2: The LORD will extend from Zion the scepter of your strength; rule in the midst of your enemies.
verses.109:3: Your people will be freewill offerings on the day of your power; in splendors of holiness, from the womb of the dawn, to you belongs the dew of your youth.
verses.109:4: The LORD has sworn and will not relent: "You are a priest forever in the manner of Melchizedek."
verses.109:5: The Lord is at your right hand; He will crush kings on the day of His anger.
verses.109:6: He will pass judgment among the nations, filling them with dead bodies; He will crush the head over a vast land.
verses.109:7: From a stream along the way He will drink; therefore He will raise His head.
verses.110:1: Praise the LORD! I will thank the LORD with a whole heart, in the council of the upright and in the congregation.
verses.110:2: The works of the LORD are great, sought out by all who take delight in them.
verses.110:3: His work is majesty and splendor, and His righteousness stands forever.
verses.110:4: He has made a memorial for His wondrous deeds; gracious and compassionate is the LORD.
verses.110:5: He has given provision to those who fear Him; He will forever remember His covenant.
verses.110:6: He has declared to His people the power of His works, by giving them the inheritance of nations.
verses.110:7: The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are reliable.
verses.110:8: They are sustained forever and ever, carried out in truth and uprightness.
verses.110:9: He sent redemption to His people; He has decreed His covenant forever; His name is holy and awe-inspiring.
verses.110:10: The beginning of wisdom is the fear of the LORD; good insight belongs to all who practice them; His praise stands forever.
verses.111:1: Praise the LORD! Happy is the man who fears the LORD, who deeply delights in His commandments.
verses.111:2: His seed will be powerful in the land; a generation of upright ones will be blessed.
verses.111:3: Abundance and riches are in his house, and his righteousness stands forever.
verses.111:4: In the darkness light rises for the upright; he is gracious, compassionate, and righteous.
verses.111:5: It goes well for the man who is gracious and lends; he manages his affairs with justice.
verses.111:6: For he will never totter; the righteous one will be in eternal remembrance.
verses.111:7: He will not fear a bad report; his heart is steady, trusting in the LORD.
verses.111:8: His heart is sustained; he will not fear, until he looks on his foes.
verses.111:9: He has scattered widely, he has given to the needy; his righteousness stands forever; his horn will rise in honor.
verses.111:10: The wicked man will see and grow angry; he will grind his teeth and melt away; the longing of the wicked will perish.
verses.112:1: Praise the LORD! Praise, servants of the LORD; praise the name of the LORD.
verses.112:2: May the name of the LORD be blessed from now on and forever.
verses.112:3: From the sun's rising to its setting, the name of the LORD is worthy of praise.
verses.112:4: High above all nations is the LORD; above the heavens is His glory.
verses.112:5: Who is like the LORD our God, who sits on high,
verses.112:6: who lowers Himself to look upon the heavens and upon the earth?
verses.112:7: He raises up the poor from the dust; from the ash heap He lifts the needy high,
verses.112:8: to seat them with nobles, with the nobles of His people.
verses.112:9: He settles the barren woman of the house as a glad mother of children. Praise the LORD!
verses.113:1: When Israel came out from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people speaking a foreign language,
verses.113:2: Judah became His holy place, Israel His realm.
verses.113:3: The sea saw and fled; the Jordan turned backward.
verses.113:4: The mountains leaped like rams, the hills like young sheep.
verses.113:5: What is the matter with you, sea, that you flee; Jordan, that you turn backward;
verses.113:6: mountains, that you leap like rams; hills, like young sheep?
verses.113:7: Earth, quake in the presence of the Lord, in the presence of the God of Jacob,
verses.113:8: who transforms the rock into a pool of water, flint into a wellspring of water.
verses.113:9: Not to us, LORD, not to us, but give glory to Your name on account of Your loyal love, on account of Your faithfulness.
verses.113:10: Why should the nations say, "Where, then, is their God?"
verses.113:11: Yet our God is in the heavens; everything He desires, He does.
verses.113:12: Their idols are silver and gold, a work of human hands.
verses.113:13: They have mouths, yet they do not speak; they have eyes, yet they do not see.
verses.113:14: They have ears, yet they do not hear; they have noses, yet they do not smell.
verses.113:15: Hands are theirs, yet they do not touch; feet are theirs, yet they do not walk; they utter no sound with their throats.
verses.113:16: Like them their makers will become, everyone who trusts in them.
verses.113:17: Israel, trust in the LORD; He is their helper and their shield.
verses.113:18: House of Aaron, trust in the LORD; He is their helper and their shield.
verses.113:19: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD; He is their helper and their shield.
verses.113:20: The LORD has remembered us; He will bless: He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.
verses.113:21: He will bless those who fear the LORD, the small along with the great.
verses.113:22: May the LORD increase you, you and your children.
verses.113:23: Blessed are you by the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
verses.113:24: The heavens are heavens belonging to the LORD, but the earth He has given to the children of humanity.
verses.113:25: The dead will not praise the LORD, nor will any who descend into silence.
verses.113:26: Yet we will bless the LORD from now on and forever. Praise the LORD!
verses.114:1: I love that the LORD hears my voice, my pleas for grace.
verses.114:2: Because He has bent His ear to me, throughout my days I will call.
verses.114:3: The cords of death surrounded me, and the straits of Sheol found me; distress and grief I found.
verses.114:4: And I called on the name of the LORD: "Please, LORD, rescue my soul!"
verses.114:5: Gracious and righteous is the LORD, and our God shows compassion.
verses.114:6: The LORD guards the simple; I sank low, and He saved me.
verses.114:7: Return, my soul, to your rest, for the LORD has dealt generously with you.
verses.114:8: For You have freed my soul from death, my eye from tears, my foot from falling.
verses.114:9: I will walk about before the LORD in the lands of the living.
verses.115:1: I believed, even as I spoke, "I am deeply afflicted."
verses.115:2: I said in my panic, "Every human being is a liar."
verses.115:3: What shall I give back to the LORD for all His generous deeds toward me?
verses.115:4: I will raise the cup of salvation, and I will call on the name of the LORD.
verses.115:6: Costly in the eyes of the LORD is the death of His loyal ones.
verses.115:7: Please, LORD, indeed I am Your servant; I am Your servant, the son of Your female servant. You have untied my bonds.
verses.115:8: To You I will sacrifice a thanksgiving sacrifice, and I will call on the name of the LORD.
verses.115:9: My vows to the LORD I will fulfill, yes, before all His people,
verses.115:10: in the courtyards of the house of the LORD, within you, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
verses.116:1: All nations, praise the LORD; all the peoples, acclaim Him!
verses.116:2: For His loyal love has prevailed over us, and the faithfulness of the LORD is forever. Praise the LORD!
verses.117:1: Offer thanks to the LORD, because He is good; for His loyal love lasts forever.
verses.117:2: Now let Israel say, "His loyal love lasts forever."
verses.117:3: Now let the house of Aaron say, "His loyal love lasts forever."
verses.117:4: Now let those who fear the LORD say, "His loyal love lasts forever."
verses.117:5: From tight straits I called to the LORD; the LORD answered me, bringing me into an open expanse.
verses.117:6: The LORD is for me; I will not be afraid. What can a human do to me?
verses.117:7: The LORD is for me among my helpers, and I will look on those who hate me.
verses.117:8: It is better to seek refuge in the LORD than to rely on human beings.
verses.117:9: It is better to seek refuge in the LORD than to rely on nobles.
verses.117:10: All nations encircled me; in the name of the LORD I will certainly cut them off.
verses.117:11: They encircled me, indeed they encircled me; in the name of the LORD I will certainly cut them off.
verses.117:12: They encircled me like bees; they were snuffed out like a fire of thorns; in the name of the LORD I will certainly cut them off.
verses.117:13: You pushed me forcefully so that I would fall, yet the LORD helped me.
verses.117:14: My strength and song is the LORD, and He has become salvation for me.
verses.117:15: A sound of ringing joy and salvation is in the tents of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD acts with might.
verses.117:16: The right hand of the LORD is raised high; the right hand of the LORD acts with might.
verses.117:17: I will not die; rather, I will live and recount the works of the LORD.
verses.117:18: The LORD severely disciplined me, yet He did not give me up to death.
verses.117:19: Open the gates of righteousness for me; I will go in through them and thank the LORD.
verses.117:20: This is the LORD's gate; the righteous will go in through it.
verses.117:21: I thank You because You answered me, and You have become salvation for me.
verses.117:22: A stone the builders spurned has become the foremost cornerstone.
verses.117:23: From the LORD this has come about; it is wonderful in our eyes.
verses.117:24: This is the day the LORD made; let us exult and be glad in it.
verses.117:25: Please, LORD, save now! Please, LORD, grant success now!
verses.117:26: Blessed is the one coming in the name of the LORD; we bless you from the LORD's house.
verses.117:27: The LORD is God, and He has shone light on us; bind the festival offering with ropes up to the horns of the altar.
verses.117:28: You are my God, and I will thank You; my God, I will exalt You.
verses.117:29: Offer thanks to the LORD, because He is good; for His loyal love lasts forever.
verses.118:1: Blessed are those who are blameless in their way, who walk in the law of the LORD.
verses.118:2: Blessed are those who guard His testimonies; with all their heart they seek Him.
verses.118:3: Indeed, they do no injustice; they walk in His ways.
verses.118:4: You Yourself have commanded Your precepts to be kept thoroughly.
verses.118:5: If only my ways were established to keep Your statutes!
verses.118:6: Then I will not be put to shame when I look to all Your commandments.
verses.118:7: I will give You thanks with uprightness of heart as I learn the judgments of Your righteousness.
verses.118:8: I will keep Your statutes; do not abandon me completely.
verses.118:9: How can a young man keep his path pure? By keeping watch according to Your word.
verses.118:10: With my whole heart I have sought You; do not let me stray from Your commandments.
verses.118:11: In my heart I have stored up Your spoken word, so that I may not sin against You.
verses.118:12: Blessed are You, LORD; teach me Your statutes.
verses.118:13: With my lips I have recounted all the judgments of Your mouth.
verses.118:14: In the way of Your testimonies I have rejoiced, as much as over all wealth.
verses.118:15: On Your precepts I will meditate, and I will look upon Your paths.
verses.118:16: In Your statutes I will take delight; I will not forget Your word.
verses.118:17: Deal generously with Your servant, so that I may live and keep Your word.
verses.118:18: Open my eyes, so that I may look upon wonders from Your law.
verses.118:19: I am a sojourner on the earth; do not conceal Your commandments from me.
verses.118:20: My soul is broken with longing for Your judgments at all times.
verses.118:21: You have rebuked the arrogant, the cursed ones, who stray from Your commandments.
verses.118:22: Roll away from me reproach and contempt, for I have guarded Your testimonies.
verses.118:23: Even though princes sit and speak together against me, Your servant will meditate on Your statutes.
verses.118:24: Indeed, Your testimonies are my delight, the men of my counsel.
verses.118:25: My soul has clung to the dust; give me life according to Your word.
verses.118:26: I recounted my ways, and You answered me; teach me Your statutes.
verses.118:27: Give me understanding of the way of Your precepts, and I will meditate on Your wonders.
verses.118:28: My soul weeps from sorrow; uphold me according to Your word.
verses.118:29: Put away from me the way of falsehood, and graciously give me Your law.
verses.118:30: The way of faithfulness I have chosen; Your judgments I have set before me.
verses.118:31: I have clung to Your testimonies; LORD, do not put me to shame.
verses.118:32: I will run along the way of Your commandments, for You enlarge my heart.
verses.118:33: Instruct me, LORD, in the way of Your statutes, and I will guard it to the end.
verses.118:34: Give me understanding, so that I may guard Your law and keep it with my whole heart.
verses.118:35: Lead me along the pathway of Your commandments, for in it I delight.
verses.118:36: Incline my heart toward Your testimonies, and not toward unjust gain.
verses.118:37: Turn my eyes away from seeing what is worthless; in Your ways give me life.
verses.118:38: Confirm Your spoken word to Your servant, which leads to the fear of You.
verses.118:39: Turn away my reproach that I dread, for Your judgments are good.
verses.118:40: Look, I have longed for Your precepts; give me life in Your righteousness.
verses.118:41: And may Your acts of loyal love come to me, LORD, Your salvation according to Your spoken word.
verses.118:42: Then I will answer with a word the one who reproaches me, for I have trusted in Your word.
verses.118:43: And do not snatch the word of truth completely from my mouth, for I have waited for Your judgments.
verses.118:44: And I will keep Your law always, forever and ever.
verses.118:45: And I will walk about in a wide space, for I have sought Your precepts.
verses.118:46: And I will speak of Your testimonies in the presence of kings, and I will not be put to shame.
verses.118:47: And I will take delight in Your commandments, which I love.
verses.118:48: And I will lift up my palms toward Your commandments, which I love, and I will meditate on Your statutes.
verses.118:49: Remember the word to Your servant, on which You have caused me to hope.
verses.118:50: This is my comfort in my affliction: that Your spoken word has given me life.
verses.118:51: The arrogant have mocked me exceedingly, yet from Your law I have not turned aside.
verses.118:52: I remembered Your judgments from ancient times, LORD, and comforted myself.
verses.118:53: Burning indignation has gripped me because of the wicked, who abandon Your law.
verses.118:54: Your statutes have been songs to me in the house of my sojournings.
verses.118:55: I have remembered Your name in the night, LORD, and have kept Your law.
verses.118:56: This has been mine, that I have guarded Your precepts.
verses.118:57: My portion is the LORD; I have resolved to keep Your words.
verses.118:58: I have sought Your favor with my whole heart; be gracious to me according to Your spoken word.
verses.118:59: I pondered my ways, and I turned my feet back to Your testimonies.
verses.118:60: I hurried and did not hesitate to keep Your commandments.
verses.118:61: The ropes of the wicked have surrounded me, yet Your law I have not forgotten.
verses.118:62: At midnight I will rise to give You thanks because of the judgments of Your righteousness.
verses.118:63: I am a companion to all who fear You, and to those who keep Your precepts.
verses.118:64: The earth is full of Your loyal love, LORD; teach me Your statutes.
verses.118:65: You have done good to Your servant, LORD, according to Your word.
verses.118:66: Teach me good sense and knowledge, for I have believed in Your commandments.
verses.118:67: Before I was afflicted I was going astray, but now I keep Your spoken word.
verses.118:68: You are good, and You do good; teach me Your statutes.
verses.118:69: The arrogant have smeared falsehood over me, yet with my whole heart I will guard Your precepts.
verses.118:70: Their heart has grown thick like fat, yet in Your law I take delight.
verses.118:71: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, so that I may learn Your statutes.
verses.118:72: Better for me is the law of Your mouth than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
verses.118:73: Your hands have made me and formed me; give me understanding, so that I may learn Your commandments.
verses.118:74: Those who fear You will see me and be glad, for I have waited for Your word.
verses.118:75: I know, LORD, that Your judgments are righteous, and You have afflicted me in faithfulness.
verses.118:76: Please let Your loyal love comfort me, according to Your spoken word to Your servant.
verses.118:77: May Your tender mercies come to me, so that I may live, because Your law is my delight.
verses.118:78: May the arrogant be put to shame, for with falsehood they have wronged me; yet I will meditate on Your precepts.
verses.118:79: May those who fear You turn back to me, and those who know Your testimonies.
verses.118:80: May my heart be blameless in Your statutes, so that I will not be put to shame.
verses.118:81: My soul grows faint for Your salvation; for Your word I have waited.
verses.118:82: My eyes grow faint for Your spoken word, saying, "When will You comfort me?"
verses.118:83: For I have become like a wineskin in smoke, yet Your statutes I have not forgotten.
verses.118:84: How many are the days of Your servant? When will You carry out judgment against those who pursue me?
verses.118:85: The arrogant have dug pits for me, those who are not according to Your law.
verses.118:86: All Your commandments are faithful; with falsehood they have pursued me; help me!
verses.118:87: They nearly put an end to me on the earth, yet I have not abandoned Your precepts.
verses.118:88: According to Your loyal love give me life, so that I may keep the testimony of Your mouth.
verses.118:89: Forever, LORD, Your word stands firm in the heavens.
verses.118:90: Your faithfulness endures from generation to generation; You have established the earth, and it stands.
verses.118:91: By Your judgments they stand today, for all things are Your servants.
verses.118:92: Had Your law not been my delight, then I would have perished in my affliction.
verses.118:93: Never will I forget Your precepts, for through them You have given me life.
verses.118:94: I belong to You; save me, for I have sought Your precepts.
verses.118:95: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me, yet Your testimonies I will closely consider.
verses.118:96: To all perfection I have seen an end, yet exceedingly broad is Your commandment.
verses.118:97: How I love Your law! All day long it is my meditation.
verses.118:98: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for they belong to me forever.
verses.118:99: I have greater insight than all my teachers, because Your testimonies are my meditation.
verses.118:100: I have more understanding than the aged, for I have guarded Your precepts.
verses.118:101: From every evil path I have held back my feet, so that I may keep Your word.
verses.118:102: From Your judgments I have not turned aside, for You Yourself have instructed me.
verses.118:103: How sweet are Your spoken words to my palate, more than honey to my mouth!
verses.118:104: From Your precepts I gain understanding; therefore I hate every path of falsehood.
verses.118:105: A lamp for my foot is Your word, and a light for my pathway.
verses.118:106: I have sworn and confirmed it, to keep the judgments of Your righteousness.
verses.118:107: I have been deeply afflicted; LORD, give me life according to Your word.
verses.118:108: Please accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, LORD, and teach me Your judgments.
verses.118:109: My life is in my hand always, yet Your law I have not forgotten.
verses.118:110: The wicked have set a trap for me, yet from Your precepts I have not wandered.
verses.118:111: I have taken Your testimonies as an inheritance forever, for they are the gladness of my heart.
verses.118:112: I have inclined my heart to carry out Your statutes forever, to the end.
verses.118:113: The double-minded I hate, but Your law I love.
verses.118:114: You are my shelter and my shield; for Your word I have waited.
verses.118:115: Turn away from me, evildoers, so that I may guard the commandments of my God.
verses.118:116: Sustain me according to Your spoken word, so that I may live, and do not shame me in my hope.
verses.118:117: Support me, and I will be saved, and I will pay regard to Your statutes always.
verses.118:118: You have spurned all who stray from Your statutes, for their cunning is falsehood.
verses.118:119: Like dross You have put away all the wicked of the earth; therefore I love Your testimonies.
verses.118:120: My flesh shudders from dread of You, and I fear Your judgments.
verses.118:121: I have practiced justice and righteousness; do not leave me to those who oppress me.
verses.118:122: Stand guarantor for Your servant for good; may the arrogant not oppress me.
verses.118:123: My eyes grow faint for Your salvation, and for the spoken word of Your righteousness.
verses.118:124: Treat Your servant according to Your loyal love, and teach me Your statutes.
verses.118:125: Your servant I am; give me understanding, so that I may know Your testimonies.
verses.118:126: It is time for the LORD to act; they have broken Your law.
verses.118:127: Therefore I love Your commandments more than gold, and more than fine gold.
verses.118:128: Therefore I regard all the precepts concerning everything as right; every path of falsehood I hate.
verses.118:129: Wonderful are Your testimonies; therefore my soul has guarded them.
verses.118:130: The opening of Your words sheds light, giving understanding to the simple.
verses.118:131: My mouth I opened wide and panted, because I yearned for Your commandments.
verses.118:132: Turn to me and be gracious to me, as is customary toward those who love Your name.
verses.118:133: Establish my steps by Your spoken word, and do not let any iniquity rule over me.
verses.118:134: Ransom me from the oppression of man, so that I may keep Your precepts.
verses.118:135: Cause Your face to shine on Your servant, and teach me Your statutes.
verses.118:136: Streams of water flow down from my eyes, because they do not keep Your law.
verses.118:137: Righteous are You, LORD, and right are Your judgments.
verses.118:138: In righteousness You have commanded Your testimonies, and in utmost faithfulness.
verses.118:139: My zeal has consumed me, for my foes have forgotten Your words.
verses.118:140: Thoroughly refined is Your spoken word, and Your servant loves it.
verses.118:141: I am insignificant and despised, yet Your precepts I have not forgotten.
verses.118:142: Your righteousness is righteousness forever, and Your law is truth.
verses.118:143: Distress and anguish have found me, yet Your commandments are my delight.
verses.118:144: Righteous are Your testimonies forever; give me understanding, so that I may live.
verses.118:145: I have called out with my whole heart; answer me, LORD! Your statutes I will guard.
verses.118:146: I have called to You; save me, so that I may keep Your testimonies.
verses.118:147: I rose before dawn and cried out for help; for Your word I have waited.
verses.118:148: My eyes are awake ahead of the night watches, to meditate on Your spoken word.
verses.118:149: Hear my voice according to Your loyal love; LORD, give me life according to Your judgments.
verses.118:150: Those who pursue wicked schemes have drawn near; from Your law they are far.
verses.118:151: Near are You, LORD, and all Your commandments are truth.
verses.118:152: Long ago I knew from Your testimonies that You founded them forever.
verses.118:153: See my affliction and rescue me, for Your law I have not forgotten.
verses.118:154: Plead my case and redeem me; according to Your spoken word give me life.
verses.118:155: Far from the wicked is salvation, because they have not sought Your statutes.
verses.118:156: Your tender mercies are abundant, LORD; give me life according to Your judgments.
verses.118:157: Many are my pursuers and my foes, yet from Your testimonies I have not turned aside.
verses.118:158: I saw the treacherous and felt loathing, because they did not keep Your spoken word.
verses.118:159: See that I love Your precepts; LORD, according to Your loyal love give me life.
verses.118:160: The sum of Your word is truth, and every judgment of Your righteousness is forever.
verses.118:161: Princes have pursued me without cause, yet at Your word my heart stands in awe.
verses.118:162: I rejoice over Your spoken word, like one who finds abundant plunder.
verses.118:163: Falsehood I hate and detest, but Your law I love.
verses.118:164: Seven times a day I praise You because of the judgments of Your righteousness.
verses.118:165: Abundant peace belongs to those who love Your law, and there is no stumbling block for them.
verses.118:166: I have hoped for Your salvation, LORD, and I have carried out Your commandments.
verses.118:167: My soul has kept Your testimonies, and I love them greatly.
verses.118:168: I have kept Your precepts and Your testimonies, because all my ways are before You.
verses.118:169: May my cry draw near before You, LORD; according to Your word give me understanding.
verses.118:170: May my plea come before You; according to Your spoken word deliver me.
verses.118:171: May my lips pour forth praise, because You teach me Your statutes.
verses.118:172: May my tongue sing of Your spoken word, for all Your commandments are righteous.
verses.118:173: May Your hand be ready to help me, because Your precepts I have chosen.
verses.118:174: I have longed for Your salvation, LORD, and Your law is my delight.
verses.118:175: May my soul live and praise You, and may Your judgments help me.
verses.118:176: I have wandered like a lost sheep; search for Your servant, for Your commandments I have not forgotten.
verses.119:1: A song of the ascents. To the LORD I called in my distress, and He answered me.
verses.119:2: LORD, rescue my soul from lips of falsehood, from a tongue of deceit.
verses.119:3: What will He give to you, and what will He add to you, tongue of deceit?
verses.119:4: Sharpened arrows of a warrior, with live coals of broom trees.
verses.119:5: Woe to me, because I have sojourned in Meshech; I have dwelt beside the tents of Kedar.
verses.119:6: Long enough has my soul dwelt with one who hates peace.
verses.119:7: I am peace, yet when I speak, they are for war.
verses.120:1: A song for the ascents. I raise my eyes to the mountains. Where will my help come from?
verses.120:2: My help is from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
verses.120:3: May He not let your foot slip; may the One who guards you not slumber.
verses.120:4: Look, the One who guards Israel neither slumbers nor sleeps.
verses.120:5: The LORD is your guardian; the LORD is your shade at your right hand.
verses.120:6: During the day the sun will not strike you, nor the moon at night.
verses.120:7: The LORD will guard you from every evil; He will guard your soul.
verses.120:8: The LORD will guard your going out and your coming back, from now and forever.
verses.121:1: A song of the ascents, of David. I was joyful when they said to me, "To the house of the LORD we will go."
verses.121:2: Our feet have been standing inside your gates, Jerusalem.
verses.121:3: Jerusalem, built like a city that is joined together as one,
verses.121:4: where the tribes ascend, the tribes of the LORD, a decree for Israel, to offer thanks to the name of the LORD.
verses.121:5: For there thrones stand for judgment, thrones belonging to the house of David.
verses.121:6: Ask for the peace of Jerusalem; may those who love you be at ease.
verses.121:7: May peace be within your rampart, tranquility within your citadels.
verses.121:8: On account of my brothers and my companions, let me now speak peace within you.
verses.121:9: On account of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek good for you.
verses.122:1: A song of the ascents. To You I have lifted my eyes, You who are seated in the heavens.
verses.122:2: Look, as the eyes of servants are turned toward the hand of their master, as the eyes of a female servant toward the hand of her mistress, so our eyes are turned toward the LORD our God until He shows us grace.
verses.122:3: Show us grace, LORD, show us grace, for we are more than sated with contempt.
verses.122:4: Our soul is more than sated with the mocking of the complacent, with the contempt of proud oppressors.
verses.123:1: A song of the ascents, of David. "Had it not been the LORD who was for us," now let Israel say,
verses.123:2: "had it not been the LORD who was for us when people rose against us,
verses.123:3: then they would have swallowed us alive when their wrath burned against us;
verses.123:4: then the waters would have swept us away, a torrent would have passed over our soul;
verses.123:5: then the seething waters would have passed over our soul."
verses.123:6: Blessed is the LORD, who did not give us over as prey to their teeth.
verses.123:7: Our soul escaped like a bird from the snare of trappers; the snare was broken, and we escaped.
verses.123:8: Our help lies in the name of the LORD, Maker of heaven and earth.
verses.124:1: A song of the ascents. Those trusting in the LORD are like Mount Zion: it will not be shaken; it remains forever.
verses.124:2: Jerusalem—mountains are all around her, and the LORD is all around His people, from now on and forever.
verses.124:3: For the scepter of wickedness will not rest on the allotted portion of the righteous, so that the righteous may not extend their hands to injustice.
verses.124:4: Do good, LORD, to the good and to those upright in their hearts.
verses.124:5: But those who turn aside onto their crooked paths—the LORD will lead them away along with those who work iniquity. Peace upon Israel.
verses.125:1: A song of the ascents. When the LORD restored Zion's fortunes, we were like dreamers.
verses.125:2: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with jubilant shouting; then they said among the nations, "The LORD has done great deeds for these people."
verses.125:3: The LORD has done great deeds for us; we were glad.
verses.125:4: LORD, restore our fortunes, like watercourses in the Negev.
verses.125:5: Those who sow in tears will reap with jubilant shouting.
verses.125:6: The one who walks along weeping, carrying the bag of seed, will surely come in with jubilant shouting, carrying his sheaves.
verses.126:1: A song of the ascents, of Solomon. If the LORD does not build a house, its builders toil on it in vain; if the LORD does not guard a city, a guard stays awake in vain.
verses.126:2: It is in vain for you to get up early, to stay late before resting, eating the bread of painful toil; surely He gives sleep to His beloved.
verses.126:3: Look, sons are an inheritance from the LORD; the fruit of the womb is a reward.
verses.126:4: Like arrows in a warrior's hand, so are the sons of one's youth.
verses.126:5: How happy is the man who has filled his quiver with them; they will not be put to shame when they speak with enemies in the gate.
verses.127:1: A song of the ascents. How happy is each one who fears the LORD, who walks in His ways.
verses.127:2: Indeed, you will eat the labor of your hands; you will be happy, and it will go well for you.
verses.127:3: Your wife will be like a fruit-bearing vine within the inner parts of your house; your children like olive saplings around your table.
verses.127:4: See, for in this way a man who fears the LORD will be blessed.
verses.127:5: May the LORD bless you from Zion, and may you see the well-being of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
verses.127:6: And may you see your children's children. Peace upon Israel.
verses.128:1: A song of the ascents. "Often they have harassed me since my youth," let Israel now say:
verses.128:2: "Often they have harassed me since my youth, yet they have not overpowered me.
verses.128:3: On my back plowers plowed; they lengthened their furrow.
verses.128:4: The LORD is righteous; He has severed the rope of the wicked."
verses.128:5: Let all who hate Zion be disgraced and turned back.
verses.128:6: Let them be like grass on rooftops, which dries up before it shoots up,
verses.128:7: with which no reaper fills his hand, nor a sheaf-gatherer his arms;
verses.128:8: and passersby do not say, "The LORD's blessing be upon you; we bless you in the name of the LORD."
verses.129:1: A song of the ascents. From the depths I have called to You, LORD.
verses.129:2: Lord, listen to my voice; may Your ears be attentive to the voice of my pleas for grace.
verses.129:3: If You, LORD, keep account of iniquities, Lord, who can stand?
verses.129:4: But with You is forgiveness, so that You may be feared.
verses.129:5: I wait eagerly for the LORD; my soul waits eagerly, and I hope in His word.
verses.129:6: My soul waits eagerly for the Lord more than those keeping watch for the morning, those keeping watch for the morning.
verses.129:7: Hope in the LORD, Israel, for with the LORD is loyal love, and abundant redemption is with Him.
verses.129:8: And He Himself will redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
verses.130:1: A song of the ascents. Of David. LORD, my heart is not lofty, and my eyes are not lifted high; nor do I walk in great matters or in things too extraordinary for me.
verses.130:2: Indeed, I have calmed and stilled my soul, like a weaned child upon his mother; my soul within me is like that weaned child.
verses.130:3: Hope in the LORD, Israel, from now on and forever.
verses.131:1: A song of the ascents. Remember, LORD, for David all his affliction,
verses.131:2: how he swore to the LORD, made a vow to the Mighty One of Jacob:
verses.131:3: "I will certainly not enter the tent of my house; I will not go up onto the couch of my bedding;
verses.131:4: I will not grant sleep to my eyes, nor to my eyelids slumber,
verses.131:5: until I find a place for the LORD, dwelling places for the Mighty One of Jacob."
verses.131:6: Look, we heard of it in Ephrathah; we found it in the fields of the forest.
verses.131:7: Let us enter His dwelling places; let us bow down at His footstool.
verses.131:8: Rise up, LORD, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your strength.
verses.131:9: May Your priests clothe themselves with righteousness, and may Your loyal ones shout for joy.
verses.131:10: On account of David Your servant, do not turn back the face of Your anointed one.
verses.131:11: The LORD swore to David in truth; He will not turn back from it: "One from the fruit of your body I will place on your throne.
verses.131:12: If your sons keep My covenant and My testimony that I teach them, their sons as well will sit on your throne for eternity."
verses.131:13: For the LORD has chosen Zion; He has desired her as a dwelling for Himself:
verses.131:14: "This is My resting place for eternity; here I will dwell, because I have desired her.
verses.131:15: Her provisions I will surely bless; her needy I will satisfy with bread.
verses.131:16: And her priests I will clothe with salvation, and her loyal ones will indeed shout for joy.
verses.131:17: There I will cause a horn to sprout for David; I have readied a lamp for My anointed one.
verses.131:18: I will clothe his enemies with shame, yet upon him his crown will gleam."
verses.132:1: A song of the ascents, of David. Look, how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to dwell together as one!
verses.132:2: It is like the good oil on the head, descending onto the beard, the beard of Aaron, that descends onto the collar of his garments;
verses.132:3: like the dew of Hermon that descends upon the mountains of Zion; for there the LORD has commanded the blessing: life for all eternity.
verses.133:1: A song of the ascents. Now, bless the LORD, all servants of the LORD, who stand in the house of the LORD during the nights.
verses.133:2: Raise your hands toward the holy place, and bless the LORD.
verses.133:3: May the LORD bless you from Zion, the Maker of heaven and earth.
verses.134:1: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD's name; praise Him, you servants of the LORD,
verses.134:2: who stand in the LORD's house, in the courtyards of our God's house.
verses.134:3: Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good; make music to His name, for it is delightful.
verses.134:4: For the LORD chose Jacob for Himself, Israel as His personal treasure.
verses.134:5: For I myself know that the LORD is great, and our Lord is greater than all gods.
verses.134:6: All that the LORD desires, He does, in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and all depths.
verses.134:7: He causes clouds to rise from the end of the earth; He makes lightning flashes for the rain; He brings the wind out from His storehouses.
verses.134:8: He is the One who struck down Egypt's firstborn, from human to animal.
verses.134:9: He sent signs and portents into your midst, Egypt, against Pharaoh and against all his servants.
verses.134:10: He is the One who struck down many nations and killed powerful kings:
verses.134:11: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan;
verses.134:12: and He gave their land as an inheritance, an inheritance for Israel, His people.
verses.134:13: LORD, Your name is forever; LORD, Your remembrance is for generation after generation.
verses.134:14: For the LORD will judge His people, and He will feel compassion for His servants.
verses.134:15: The nations' idols are silver and gold, the work of human hands.
verses.134:16: They have mouths, yet they do not speak; they have eyes, yet they do not see;
