native_verses.50:10: For Mine is every wild animal of the forest, the cattle on a thousand mountains.
native_verses.50:11: I know all the birds of the mountains, and whatever moves in the field is with Me.
native_verses.50:12: If I grew hungry, I would not tell you, for Mine is the world and its fullness.
native_verses.50:13: Do I eat the flesh of mighty bulls, or drink the blood of male goats?
native_verses.50:14: Sacrifice thanksgiving to God, and fulfill your vows to the Most High,
native_verses.50:15: and call to Me in the day of distress; I will rescue you, and you will honor Me."
native_verses.50:16: But to the wicked God says, "What right do you have to recount My statutes and take My covenant upon your mouth?
native_verses.50:17: Yet you yourself hate discipline, and you throw My words behind you.
native_verses.50:18: When you see a thief, you gladly join with him, and your share is with adulterers.
native_verses.50:19: You unleash your mouth in evil, and your tongue fabricates deceit.
native_verses.50:20: You sit speaking against your brother; you cast slander against the son of your mother.
native_verses.50:21: These things you did, and I kept silent; you imagined that I was altogether like you. I will rebuke you and set it in order before your eyes.
native_verses.50:22: Understand this now, you who forget God, otherwise I will tear you apart, and there will be no rescuer.
native_verses.50:23: Whoever sacrifices thanksgiving honors Me, and to the one who directs his way I will show the salvation of God."
native_verses.51:1: For the music director. A psalm of David.
native_verses.51:2: When the prophet Nathan came to him, after he went in to Bathsheba.
native_verses.51:3: Show me grace, God, according to Your loyal love; according to the abundance of Your compassion, wipe away my transgressions.
native_verses.51:4: Wash me fully from my iniquity, and purify me from my sin.
native_verses.51:5: For I myself know my transgressions, and my sin is continually before me.
native_verses.51:6: Against You, You alone, I have sinned, and I have done what is evil in Your eyes, so that You are in the right when You speak, and without fault when You judge.
native_verses.51:7: Look, in iniquity I was brought forth, and my mother conceived me in sin.
native_verses.51:8: Look, You delight in truth in the inward parts, and in what is hidden You make me know wisdom.
native_verses.51:9: Cleanse me from sin with hyssop, and I will be pure; wash me, and I will become whiter than snow.
native_verses.51:10: Make me hear gladness and joy; may the bones You have crushed exult.
native_verses.51:11: Hide Your face from my sins, and wipe away all my iniquities.
native_verses.51:12: Create a pure heart for me, God, and renew a firm spirit within me.
native_verses.51:13: Do not throw me out from Your presence, and do not take away Your holy Spirit from me.
native_verses.51:14: Bring back to me the gladness of Your salvation, and may a willing spirit uphold me.
native_verses.51:15: I will instruct transgressors in Your ways, and sinners will turn back to You.
native_verses.51:16: Rescue me from bloodguilt, God, God of my salvation; my tongue will shout joyfully of Your righteousness.
native_verses.51:17: Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will proclaim Your praise.
native_verses.51:18: For You do not delight in a sacrifice, or else I would give one; You find no pleasure in a burnt offering.
native_verses.51:19: God's sacrifices are a broken spirit; a broken and crushed heart, God, You will not scorn.
native_verses.51:20: In Your good pleasure, do good to Zion; build Jerusalem's walls.
native_verses.51:21: Then You will delight in sacrifices of righteousness, burnt offering and whole offering; then they will offer up bulls on Your altar.
native_verses.52:1: For the music director. A Maskil of David.
native_verses.52:2: When Doeg the Edomite came and reported to Saul and said to him, "David has come to Ahimelech's house."
native_verses.52:3: Why do you boast in evil, mighty warrior? God's loyal love continues all day long.
native_verses.52:4: Your tongue plans ruin, like a sharpened razor, you doer of deceit.
native_verses.52:5: You love evil over good, falsehood over speaking righteousness. Selah.
native_verses.52:6: You love all devouring words, you tongue of deceit.
native_verses.52:7: God too will demolish you permanently; He will snatch you up and rip you from the tent, and pull you up by the roots from the land of the living. Selah.
native_verses.52:8: And the righteous will look on and fear, and they will laugh at him:
native_verses.52:9: "Here is the man who would not make God his stronghold, but trusted in the abundance of his wealth; he grew strong in his ruin."
native_verses.52:10: But I am like a lush olive tree in God's house; I trust in God's loyal love forever and ever.
native_verses.52:11: I will give thanks to You forever because You have acted, and I will wait for Your name, since it is good, before Your loyal ones.
native_verses.53:1: For the music director, according to Mahalath. A Maskil of David.
native_verses.53:2: A fool says in his heart, "There is no God." They have acted corruptly and committed detestable injustice; no one does what is good.
native_verses.53:3: God looked down from heaven on the sons of mankind to see whether there is anyone with insight, anyone seeking God.
native_verses.53:4: Every one of them has turned back; together they have become tainted. No one does what is good, not even a single one.
native_verses.53:5: Do they not know, the workers of wickedness, who eat My people just as they eat bread? They do not call on God.
native_verses.53:6: There they trembled in dread where there was no dread, for God has scattered the bones of the one encamping against you; you have shamed them, because God has rejected them.
native_verses.53:7: If only Israel's salvation would come from Zion! When God restores His people's fortunes, may Jacob exult, may Israel be joyful.
native_verses.54:1: For the music director, with stringed instruments. A Maskil of David.
native_verses.54:2: When the Ziphites came and said to Saul, "Is David not hiding himself with us?"
native_verses.54:3: God, by Your name save me, and by Your might vindicate me.
native_verses.54:4: God, hear my prayer; listen closely to the words of my mouth.
native_verses.54:5: For strangers have risen up against me, and ruthless men have sought my life; they have not placed God before themselves. Selah.
native_verses.54:6: Look, God is a helper to me; the Lord is among those who sustain my life.
native_verses.54:7: He will turn the evil back upon my lurking foes; in Your faithfulness, wipe them out.
native_verses.54:8: I will sacrifice to You with a freewill offering; I will offer thanks to Your name, LORD, because it is good.
native_verses.54:9: For He has rescued me out of every distress, and my eye has looked upon my enemies.
native_verses.55:1: For the music director, with stringed instruments. A Maskil of David.
native_verses.55:2: Listen closely, God, to my prayer, and do not conceal Yourself from my plea for favor.
native_verses.55:3: Pay attention to me and answer me; I roam restlessly in my lament and groan aloud,
native_verses.55:4: because of an enemy's voice, from the oppression of a wicked man; for they make trouble fall upon me, and in anger they harbor animosity against me.
native_verses.55:5: My heart writhes inside me, and terrors of death have fallen upon me.
native_verses.55:6: Fear and trembling come into me, and shuddering covers me.
native_verses.55:7: And I said, "Who will give me wings like a dove? I would fly away and settle down."
native_verses.55:8: Look, I would wander far off; I would spend the night in the wilderness. Selah.
native_verses.55:9: I would hurry to a place of escape for myself from a rushing wind, from a storm.
native_verses.55:10: Confound, Lord, divide their language, for I have seen violence and conflict in the city.
native_verses.55:11: Day and night they circle around it upon its walls, and iniquity and misery are inside it.
native_verses.55:12: Ruin is inside it, and oppression and deceit do not depart from its public square.
native_verses.55:13: For it is not an enemy who insults me—then I could endure it; it is not someone who hates me who has magnified himself against me—then I could hide from him.
native_verses.55:14: Yet it is you, a man of my own rank, my close companion and my intimate friend,
native_verses.55:15: we who together used to hold sweet counsel; in the house of God we used to walk among the throng.
native_verses.55:16: May death come unawares upon them; may they descend to Sheol alive, for evils are in their lodging, inside them.
native_verses.55:17: As for me, I will call out to God, and the LORD will save me.
native_verses.55:18: Evening and morning and noon, I will lament and moan, and He will hear my voice.
native_verses.55:19: He has redeemed my life in peace from the battle against me, for in great numbers they were against me.
native_verses.55:20: God will hear and answer them—He who sits enthroned from ancient times, Selah—those for whom there are no changes and who do not fear God.
native_verses.55:21: He has stretched out his hands against those at peace with him; he has profaned his covenant.
native_verses.55:22: Smooth were the buttery utterances of his mouth, yet battle was in his heart; softer than oil were his words, yet they were unsheathed swords.
native_verses.55:23: Cast your load upon the LORD, and He Himself will sustain you; never will He permit the righteous to totter.
native_verses.55:24: But You, God, will bring them down into the well of destruction; men of bloodshed and deceit will not reach half their days. Yet as for me, I will trust in You.
native_verses.56:1: For the music director, according to The Dove of Distant Silence. A Miktam of David, when the Philistines captured him in Gath.
native_verses.56:2: Show me grace, God, for mortal man has trampled me; fighting all day long, he presses hard against me.
native_verses.56:3: My lurking foes have trampled on me all day long, for many are fighting haughtily against me.
native_verses.56:4: On the day I am afraid, in You I will trust.
native_verses.56:5: In God I will praise His word. In God I have trusted; I will not be afraid. What could flesh do to me?
native_verses.56:6: They twist my words all day long; all their thoughts against me are for evil.
native_verses.56:7: They band together, they lie hidden; they themselves keep watch on my footprints, just as they have lain in wait for my life.
native_verses.56:8: Because of iniquity, is there escape for them? In anger, bring down the peoples, God.
native_verses.56:9: My wandering You Yourself have counted; place my tears in Your wineskin. Are they not in Your register?
native_verses.56:10: Then my enemies will turn backward on the day I call. I know this: God is for me.
native_verses.56:11: In God I will praise the word; in the LORD I will praise the word.
native_verses.56:12: In God I have trusted; I will not be afraid. What could man do to me?
native_verses.56:13: Upon me, God, are the vows to You; I will pay offerings of thanksgiving to You.
native_verses.56:14: For You have rescued my life from death—surely my feet from stumbling—in order to walk in the presence of God, in the light of the living.
native_verses.57:1: For the music director: "Do Not Destroy." A Miktam of David, when he fled from before Saul in the cave.
native_verses.57:2: Show me grace, God, show me grace, for in You my soul has taken refuge; and in the shadow of Your wings I will take refuge until calamities pass by.
native_verses.57:3: I call out to God Most High, to God who brings it to completion for me.
native_verses.57:4: He will send from heaven and save me; He puts to shame the one who tramples on me. Selah. God will send His loyal love and His truth.
native_verses.57:5: My soul is in the midst of lions; I lie down among fiery ones, sons of men whose teeth are spears and arrows, and whose tongue is a sharp sword.
native_verses.57:6: Be exalted above the heavens, God; may Your glory be above all the earth.
native_verses.57:7: They made a net ready for my steps; my soul bowed low. They dug a pit in front of me; they fell into its midst. Selah.
native_verses.57:8: My heart is firm, God, my heart is firm; I will sing and make music.
native_verses.57:9: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake the dawn.
native_verses.57:10: I will give thanks to You among the peoples, Lord; I will make music to You among the nations.
native_verses.57:11: For Your loyal love is great up to the heavens, and Your truth up to the skies.
native_verses.57:12: Be exalted above the heavens, God; may Your glory be above all the earth.
native_verses.58:1: For the music director: "Do Not Destroy." A Miktam of David.
native_verses.58:2: Do you truly speak righteousness in silence? Do you judge with uprightness, sons of men?
native_verses.58:3: Rather, in your heart you carry out wrongs; on the earth you weigh out the violence of your hands.
native_verses.58:4: The wicked are alienated from the womb; those who speak falsehood go astray from birth.
native_verses.58:5: They have venom resembling a serpent's venom, like a deaf cobra that shuts its ear,
native_verses.58:6: which does not listen to the voice of charmers, or of an expert caster of spells.
native_verses.58:7: God, break their teeth in their mouths; smash the fangs of the young lions, LORD.
native_verses.58:8: May they melt away like water that flows off; when he aims his arrows, may they be as though cut off.
native_verses.58:9: May they be like a snail that dissolves as it moves, like the miscarriage of a woman that never sees the sun.
native_verses.58:10: Before your pots can feel the bramble, whether green or ablaze, He will sweep it away in a whirlwind.
native_verses.58:11: The righteous one will be glad when he sees vengeance; he will wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
native_verses.58:12: And people will say, "Truly there is fruit for the righteous; truly there is a God who judges on the earth."
native_verses.59:1: For the music director: "Do Not Destroy." A Miktam of David, when Saul sent men, and they kept watch over the house to put him to death.
native_verses.59:2: Rescue me from my enemies, my God; set me high above those who rise up against me.
native_verses.59:3: Rescue me from workers of iniquity, and from men of bloodshed save me.
native_verses.59:4: For look, they have lain in wait for my life; fierce men band together against me, for no transgression of mine and no sin of mine, LORD.
native_verses.59:5: For no guilt on my part, they run and take their stand; wake up to meet me and see!
native_verses.59:6: And You, LORD God of hosts, God of Israel, rouse Yourself to call all the nations to account; show no grace to any who deal treacherously in iniquity. Selah.
native_verses.59:7: They come back at evening; they growl like a dog and prowl around the city.
native_verses.59:8: Look, they spew forth with their mouths; swords are on their lips, for they say, "Who is listening?"
native_verses.59:9: But You, LORD, laugh at them; You deride all the nations.
native_verses.59:10: Because of his strength I will keep watch for You, for God is my stronghold.
native_verses.59:11: The God of my loyal love will meet me; God will let me look upon my foes.
native_verses.59:12: Do not kill them, so that my people do not forget; make them wander by Your power and bring them down, our shield, Lord.
native_verses.59:13: For the sin of their mouths, the word of their lips, may they be caught in their pride, and because of the cursing and deception they utter.
native_verses.59:14: Bring them to an end in wrath, bring them to an end until they are no more, so that they may know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah.
native_verses.59:15: And they come back at evening; they growl like a dog and prowl around the city.
native_verses.59:16: They wander about for food; if they are not satisfied, they spend the night.
native_verses.59:17: But as for me, I will sing of Your strength, and in the morning I will sing joyfully of Your loyal love; for You have been a stronghold for me and a place of refuge on the day of my distress.
native_verses.59:18: My strength, to You I will make music, for God is my stronghold, the God of my loyal love.
native_verses.60:1: For the music director, according to Lily of Testimony. A Miktam of David, for teaching,
native_verses.60:2: when he fought with Aram-naharaim and with Aram-zobah, and Joab returned and struck down Edom in the Valley of Salt, twelve thousand.
native_verses.60:3: God, You have cast us off; You have broken through us. You have been angry; restore us!
native_verses.60:4: You have caused the land to quake, You have cracked it open; heal its fractures, for it staggers.
native_verses.60:5: You have shown Your people hardship; You have made us drink wine of reeling.
native_verses.60:6: You have given those who fear You a banner to be lifted high on account of truth. Selah.
native_verses.60:7: So that Your beloved ones may be rescued, save with Your right hand and answer me!
native_verses.60:8: God spoke in His holiness: "I will exult; I will apportion Shechem and measure the Valley of Succoth.
native_verses.60:9: Mine is Gilead, and Mine is Manasseh; and Ephraim is the stronghold of My head; Judah is My ruler's staff.
native_verses.60:10: Moab is My washing basin; onto Edom I will cast My sandal; over Me, Philistia, shout in triumph!"
native_verses.60:11: Who will bring me to a fortified city? Who has guided me as far as Edom?
native_verses.60:12: Have You not cast us off, God? And You do not go out, God, with our armies.
native_verses.60:13: Give us help against the foe, for worthless is the deliverance of man.
native_verses.60:14: Through God we will act with valor, and He Himself will trample our foes.
native_verses.61:1: For the music director, with a stringed instrument. Of David.
native_verses.61:2: Hear, God, my cry; pay attention to my prayer.
native_verses.61:3: From the end of the earth I call out to You as my heart grows faint; guide me onto a rock too high for me.
native_verses.61:4: For You have been a refuge to me, a tower of strength in the face of an enemy.
native_verses.61:5: May I dwell in Your tent for all ages; may I take refuge in the cover of Your wings. Selah.
native_verses.61:6: For You Yourself, God, have heard my vows; You have granted the inheritance of those who fear Your name.
native_verses.61:7: May You add days to the king's days; may his years be like generation after generation.
native_verses.61:8: May he sit enthroned forever before God; appoint loyal love and truth that they may guard him.
native_verses.61:9: Thus I will sing praise to Your name forever, paying my vows day after day.
native_verses.62:1: For the music director, according to Jeduthun. A psalm of David.
native_verses.62:2: Only toward God is my soul in stillness; from Him is my salvation.
native_verses.62:3: Only He is my rock and my salvation, my high fortress; I will not be severely shaken.
native_verses.62:4: How long will you assail a man? Will you batter him, all of you, like a leaning wall, a toppling fence?
native_verses.62:5: Only from his eminence do they plot to cast him down; they delight in falsehood. With their mouth they bless, yet in their inward parts they curse. Selah.
native_verses.62:6: Only for God be still, my soul, for from Him is my hope.
native_verses.62:7: Only He is my rock and my salvation, my high fortress; I will not be shaken.
native_verses.62:8: Upon God rest my salvation and my glory; the rock of my strength, my refuge, is in God.
native_verses.62:9: Trust in Him at every time, people; pour out your heart in His presence; God is a refuge to us. Selah.
native_verses.62:10: Only a breath are the sons of mankind, a falsehood are the sons of man; on the scales they rise; all together they are less than a breath.
native_verses.62:11: Do not trust in extortion, and in robbery do not put empty hope; when wealth flourishes, do not fix your heart on it.
native_verses.62:12: Once God spoke; twice I heard this: that strength belongs to God,
native_verses.62:13: and to You, Lord, belongs loyal love, for You Yourself repay each one according to his deed.
native_verses.63:1: A psalm of David, while he was in the wilderness of Judah.
native_verses.63:2: God, You are my God; I diligently seek You. For You my soul thirsts, for You my flesh pines, in a parched and weary land without water.
native_verses.63:3: So in the sanctuary I have gazed upon You, to see Your strength and Your glory.
native_verses.63:4: Because Your loyal love is better than life, my lips will extol You.
native_verses.63:5: So I will bless You throughout my life; in Your name I will raise my hands.
native_verses.63:6: As with fat and richness my soul will be satisfied, and with lips of ringing joy my mouth will give praise.
native_verses.63:7: Whenever I remember You on my bed, during the night watches I meditate on You.
native_verses.63:8: For You have been a help to me, and in the shadow of Your wings I will shout for joy.
native_verses.63:9: My soul clings close behind You; Your right hand holds me fast.
native_verses.63:10: But those who seek my life for ruin will go into the lowest regions of the earth.
native_verses.63:11: They will be surrendered to the power of the sword; they will become a share for jackals.
native_verses.63:12: Yet the king will be glad in God; everyone who swears by Him will exult, for the mouth of those who speak falsehood will be shut.
native_verses.64:1: For the music director. A psalm of David.
native_verses.64:2: God, hear my voice in my complaint; guard my life from terror of the enemy.
native_verses.64:3: Hide me from the secret council of evildoers, from the uproar of those who practice iniquity,
native_verses.64:4: who have sharpened their tongue like a sword; they have aimed their arrow, a bitter word,
native_verses.64:5: to shoot from hiding places at a blameless person; suddenly they shoot him, and they do not fear.
native_verses.64:6: They strengthen themselves in an evil plan; they speak of hiding snares; they say, "Who will see them?"
native_verses.64:7: They search out injustices: "We have completed a carefully searched-out plot." And the inward part of a man and the heart are deep.
native_verses.64:8: But God will shoot them with an arrow; suddenly their wounds will come.
native_verses.64:9: And they will be made to stumble, with their own tongue against them; all who look upon them will shake their heads.
native_verses.64:10: Then all humanity will fear, and they will declare the deed of God and ponder His work.
native_verses.64:11: The righteous one will be glad in the LORD and find refuge in Him, and all the upright of heart will exult.
native_verses.65:1: For the music director. A psalm of David. A song.
native_verses.65:2: To You silence is praise, God, in Zion, and to You a vow will be fulfilled.
native_verses.65:3: Hearer of prayer, to You all flesh will come.
native_verses.65:4: Deeds of iniquity have prevailed over me; as for our transgressions, You Yourself atone for them.
native_verses.65:5: Blessed is the person You choose and bring close, that he may dwell in Your courts; may we be satisfied with the goodness of Your house, the holy place of Your temple.
native_verses.65:6: With awesome deeds in righteousness You answer us, God of our salvation, the confidence of all the ends of the earth and of the far-off sea,
native_verses.65:7: who sets the mountains firm by His power, girded in might,
native_verses.65:8: who calms the roar of the seas, the roar of their waves, and the commotion of the peoples.
native_verses.65:9: And the inhabitants of the farthest bounds stand in awe of Your signs; You make the places where morning and evening go forth shout for joy.
native_verses.65:10: You have visited the earth and watered it; greatly You enrich it. The watercourse of God is full of water; You make ready their grain, for in this way You make it ready.
native_verses.65:11: You saturate its furrows; You level its ridges; with showers You soften it; You bless its sprouting.
native_verses.65:12: You have crowned the year of Your goodness, and Your tracks drip with richness.
native_verses.65:13: The wilderness pastures drip, and the hills wrap themselves in joy.
native_verses.65:14: The meadows are dressed in the flocks, and the valleys cloak themselves with grain; they shout in triumph, indeed they sing.
native_verses.66:1: For the music director. A song. A psalm. Raise a joyful shout to God, all the earth.
native_verses.66:2: Sing praise to the glory of His name; render His praise glorious.
native_verses.66:3: Say to God, "How awe-inspiring are Your deeds! Because of the abundance of Your strength, Your enemies will cringe before You.
native_verses.66:4: All the earth will bow down to You and will sing praise to You; they will sing praise to Your name." Selah.
native_verses.66:5: Come and see the works of God; He is awe-inspiring in deed toward the sons of mankind.
native_verses.66:6: He turned the sea into dry ground; they crossed through the river on foot; there let us rejoice in Him.
native_verses.66:7: He rules in His might forever; His eyes keep watch over the nations; let the rebellious not lift themselves up. Selah.
native_verses.66:8: Bless our God, you peoples, and make the sound of His praise heard,
native_verses.66:9: the One who sets our soul in life and has not allowed our foot to slip.
native_verses.66:10: For You have tested us, God; You refined us like the refining of silver.
native_verses.66:11: You brought us into the net; You placed a crushing weight upon our loins.
native_verses.66:12: You caused men to ride over our heads; we went into fire and into water, yet You brought us out to overflowing abundance.
native_verses.66:13: I will enter Your house with burnt offerings; I will fulfill my vows to You,
native_verses.66:14: which my lips voiced and my mouth spoke when I was in distress.
native_verses.66:15: I will offer up to You burnt offerings of fattened animals, along with the smoke of rams; I will prepare bulls with male goats. Selah.
native_verses.66:16: Come, listen—all you who fear God—and let me recount what He has done for my soul.
native_verses.66:17: To Him I called out with my mouth, and high praise was under my tongue.
native_verses.66:18: If I had regarded iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not have heard.
native_verses.66:19: Yet surely God has heard; He has paid attention to the voice of my prayer.
native_verses.66:20: Blessed be God, who has not turned aside my prayer or His loyal love from me.
native_verses.67:1: For the music director; with stringed instruments. A psalm. A song.
native_verses.67:2: May God show favor to us and bless us; may He cause His face to shine with us. Selah.
native_verses.67:3: So that Your way may be known in the earth, Your salvation among all nations.
native_verses.67:4: Let the peoples give thanks to You, God; let all the peoples give thanks to You.
native_verses.67:5: May the nations rejoice and sing out with joy, for You judge the peoples with uprightness and lead the nations on the earth. Selah.
native_verses.67:6: Let the peoples give thanks to You, God; let all the peoples give thanks to You.
native_verses.67:7: The earth has given its yield; God, our God, will bless us.
native_verses.67:8: God will bless us, and all the ends of the earth will fear Him.
native_verses.68:1: For the music director. Of David. A psalm. A song.
native_verses.68:2: May God rise up; may His enemies scatter, and may those who hate Him flee from His presence.
native_verses.68:3: As smoke is driven away, may You drive them away; as wax melts before fire, may the wicked perish before God.
native_verses.68:4: But let the righteous be glad and exult before God; let them be jubilant with gladness.
native_verses.68:5: Sing to God; sing praise to His name! Cast up a highway for the One who rides through the desert plains—His name is the LORD—and exult before Him.
native_verses.68:6: Father of orphans and judge of widows is God in His holy dwelling.
native_verses.68:7: God settles the lonely into a home; He brings out prisoners into prosperity; only the rebellious inhabit a scorched land.
native_verses.68:8: God, when You went forth before Your people, when You strode through the wasteland, Selah,
native_verses.68:9: the earth shook; indeed, the heavens dripped at the presence of God, the One of Sinai, at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
native_verses.68:10: You showered down a generous rain, God; Your inheritance, when it grew weary, You Yourself made firm.
native_verses.68:11: Your company settled in it; in Your goodness You made provision for the poor, God.
native_verses.68:12: The Lord gives the word; the women proclaiming the good news are a vast army.
native_verses.68:13: The kings of armies flee, they flee, and the woman at home divides the plunder.
native_verses.68:14: Though you lie down among the sheepfolds—wings of a dove overlaid with silver, and its pinions with pale yellow gold.
native_verses.68:15: When the Almighty dispersed kings in it, it snowed on Zalmon.
native_verses.68:16: A mountain of God is Mount Bashan; a many-peaked mountain is Mount Bashan.
native_verses.68:17: Why do you gaze with envy, you many-peaked mountains, at the mountain God desired for His dwelling? Indeed, the LORD will dwell there forever.
native_verses.68:18: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, thousands upon thousands; the Lord is among them—Sinai is in the sanctuary.
native_verses.68:19: You ascended to the height; You took captives; You received gifts among mankind, even among the rebellious, so that the LORD God may dwell there.
native_verses.68:20: Blessed be the Lord! Day by day He carries our burden—God, our salvation. Selah.
native_verses.68:21: The God who is for us is a God of saving acts, and to GOD, the Lord, belong ways of escape from death.
native_verses.68:22: Surely God will smash the head of His enemies, the hairy scalp of the one who walks on in his trespasses.
native_verses.68:23: The Lord said, "From Bashan I will bring them back; I will bring them back from the depths of the sea,
native_verses.68:24: so that you may strike your foot in blood, and the tongue of your dogs may have its share from the enemies."
native_verses.68:25: They have seen Your processions, God, the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.
native_verses.68:26: The singers went ahead, the musicians behind, in the midst of young women beating tambourines.
native_verses.68:27: In the assemblies bless God, the Lord, you who are from the fountain of Israel.
native_verses.68:28: There is Benjamin, the youngest, leading them, the leaders of Judah with their throng, the leaders of Zebulun, the leaders of Naphtali.
native_verses.68:29: Your God has ordained your strength; be strong, God, You who have worked for us.
native_verses.68:30: Because of Your temple above Jerusalem, kings will carry tribute to You.
native_verses.68:31: Rebuke the beasts of the reeds, the herd of bulls with the calves of the peoples, prostrating themselves with pieces of silver; He has scattered the peoples who delight in battles.
native_verses.68:32: Ambassadors will come from Egypt; Cush will swiftly stretch out its hands to God.
native_verses.68:33: Kingdoms of the earth, sing to God; sing praise to the Lord. Selah.
native_verses.68:34: To the One who rides in the highest heavens of old—look, He gives forth His voice, a voice of strength.
native_verses.68:35: Ascribe strength to God! Over Israel is His majesty, and His strength is in the clouds.
native_verses.68:36: Awe-inspiring are You, God, from Your sanctuaries! The God of Israel is the One who gives strength and might to the people. Blessed be God!
native_verses.69:1: For the music director, on Lilies. Of David.
native_verses.69:2: Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my throat.
native_verses.69:3: I have sunk in the mire of the deep, and there is no place to stand; I have come into the depths of the waters, and a torrent has swept over me.
native_verses.69:4: I have grown weary in my crying out; my throat is parched; my eyes have failed while waiting for my God.
native_verses.69:5: Those who hate me for no reason outnumber the hairs of my head; mighty are those who would destroy me, who are falsely my enemies; what I did not steal, I must then return.
native_verses.69:6: God, You Yourself know my folly, and my guilty deeds are not concealed from You.
native_verses.69:7: Do not let those who wait for You be put to shame because of me, Lord GOD of hosts; do not let those who seek You be disgraced because of me, God of Israel.
native_verses.69:8: For on Your account I have borne reproach; disgrace has covered my face.
native_verses.69:9: I have become estranged from my brothers, and a foreigner to the sons of my mother.
native_verses.69:10: For zeal for Your house has devoured me, and the taunts of those who taunt You have fallen on me.
native_verses.69:11: I wept with my soul in fasting, and it became reproaches against me.
native_verses.69:12: I made sackcloth my garment, and I became a byword for them.
native_verses.69:13: Those who sit at the gate talk about me, and I am the song of those who drink strong drink.
native_verses.69:14: But as for me, my prayer is to You, LORD, at a time of favor; God, in the abundance of Your loyal love, answer me in the faithfulness of Your salvation.
native_verses.69:15: Rescue me from the mud, and let me not sink; let me be rescued from those who hate me and from the depths of the waters.
native_verses.69:16: Do not let the torrent of waters sweep over me, and do not let the deep swallow me; do not let the pit shut its mouth over me.
native_verses.69:17: Answer me, LORD, for Your loyal love is good; according to the abundance of Your mercies, turn toward me.
native_verses.69:18: And do not hide Your face from Your servant, for I am in distress; hurry, answer me.
native_verses.69:19: Come near to my soul, redeem it; because of my enemies, ransom me.
native_verses.69:20: You Yourself know my reproach, and my shame, and my disgrace; before You are all my adversaries.
native_verses.69:21: Reproach has broken my heart, so that I am desperately ill; I hoped for sympathy, but there was none, and for comforters, but I did not find any.
native_verses.69:22: They put poison into my food, and for my thirst they made me drink vinegar.
native_verses.69:23: Let their table before them become a snare, and for those at peace, a trap.
native_verses.69:24: Let their eyes grow dark so they cannot see, and make their loins totter continually.
native_verses.69:25: Pour out Your fury on them, and let Your fierce anger overtake them.
native_verses.69:26: Let their encampment become desolate; in their tents let there be no inhabitant.
native_verses.69:27: For they have pursued the one whom You Yourself struck, and they talk of the pain of those You have wounded.
native_verses.69:28: Place iniquity upon their iniquity, and do not let them come into Your righteousness.
native_verses.69:29: Let them be wiped out from the book of the living, and do not let them be written with the righteous.
native_verses.69:30: But as for me, I am poor and in pain; may Your salvation, God, lift me securely on high.
native_verses.69:31: I will praise God's name in song, and with thanksgiving I will magnify Him.
native_verses.69:32: And it will be more pleasing to the LORD than an ox, a bull bearing horns and hooves.
native_verses.69:33: The humble have seen it and will rejoice; you who seek God, may your heart live.
native_verses.69:34: For the LORD listens to the needy, and He does not despise His prisoners.
native_verses.69:35: May the heavens and the earth praise Him, the seas and all that moves in them.
native_verses.69:36: For God will save Zion and will build the cities of Judah, and they will live there and take possession of it.
native_verses.69:37: And the seed of His servants will inherit it, and those who love His name will settle in it.
native_verses.70:1: For the music director. Of David. To bring to remembrance.
native_verses.70:2: God, hurry to rescue me; LORD, hurry to my help!
native_verses.70:3: May those who seek my life be put to shame and humiliated; may those who delight in my harm be turned backward and disgraced.
native_verses.70:4: Let them turn back on account of their shame, those who say, "Aha, aha!"
native_verses.70:5: May all who seek You exult and rejoice in You, and may those who love Your salvation continually say, "May God be magnified!"
native_verses.70:6: But as for me, I am poor and needy; God, hurry to me! You are my help and the One who delivers me; LORD, do not delay.
native_verses.71:1: In You, LORD, I have taken refuge; may I never be put to shame.
native_verses.71:2: In Your righteousness rescue me and deliver me; turn Your ear toward me and save me.
native_verses.71:3: Be for me a rock of dwelling to which I can continually come; You have issued the command to save me, for You are my crag and my fortress.
native_verses.71:4: My God, deliver me from the hand of the wicked, from the grip of the unjust and the ruthless.
native_verses.71:5: For You are my hope, Lord GOD, my trust from my youth.
native_verses.71:6: On You I have leaned from the womb; from my mother's body You are the One who brought me out; in You is my praise continually.
native_verses.71:7: I have become like a wonder to many, yet You are my refuge of strength.
native_verses.71:8: Let my mouth be filled with Your praise, with Your splendor all day long.
native_verses.71:9: Do not cast me away in the time of old age; when my strength fails, do not abandon me.
native_verses.71:10: For my enemies have spoken about me, and those who watch for my life have taken counsel together,
native_verses.71:11: saying, "God has abandoned him; pursue and seize him, for there is no rescuer."
native_verses.71:12: God, do not be far from me; my God, hurry to my help!
native_verses.71:13: May the adversaries of my life be put to shame and come to an end; may those who seek my harm be wrapped in reproach and disgrace.
native_verses.71:14: But as for me, I will continually hope, and I will add to all Your praise.
native_verses.71:15: My mouth will recount Your righteousness, and Your salvation all day long, for I do not know their numbers.
native_verses.71:16: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord GOD; I will call to remembrance Your righteousness, Yours alone.
native_verses.71:17: God, You have taught me from my youth, and until now I declare Your marvelous deeds.
native_verses.71:18: And even to old age and gray hair, God, do not abandon me, until I declare Your arm to the next generation, and Your might to everyone who will come.
native_verses.71:19: And Your righteousness, God, extends to the heights; You who have done great things, God, who is like You?
native_verses.71:20: You who have shown me many distresses and calamities will again restore me to life, and from the depths of the earth You will again bring me up.
native_verses.71:21: You will multiply my greatness, and turn and comfort me.
native_verses.71:22: I too will give thanks to You with the harp, for Your faithfulness, my God; I will sing praise to You with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.
native_verses.71:23: My lips will ring out with joy when I sing praise to You, and my soul, which You have ransomed.
native_verses.71:24: My tongue too will speak of Your righteousness all day long, for they have been put to shame, for they have been humiliated, those who seek my harm.
native_verses.72:1: For Solomon. God, give Your judgments to the king, and Your righteousness to the son of the king.
native_verses.72:2: Let him judge Your people in righteousness, and Your afflicted ones with justice.
native_verses.72:3: May the mountains bear peace for the people, and the hills through righteousness.
native_verses.72:4: Let him defend the afflicted of the people, save the children of the needy, and crush the oppressor.
native_verses.72:5: May they fear You while the sun shines, and while the moon endures, generation after generation.
native_verses.72:6: May he descend like rain on mown grass, like showers drenching the earth.
native_verses.72:7: May the righteous flourish in his days, and an abundance of peace until there is no moon.
native_verses.72:8: And let him exercise dominion from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.
native_verses.72:9: Before him may the dwellers of the desert kneel, and may his enemies lick the dust.
native_verses.72:10: May the kings of Tarshish and the coastlands pay tribute; may the kings of Sheba and Seba present gifts.
native_verses.72:11: And may all kings bow low to him; may all nations serve him.
native_verses.72:12: For he will rescue the needy who cries for help, and the afflicted who has no helper.
native_verses.72:13: He will take pity on the weak and the needy, and he will save the lives of the needy.
native_verses.72:14: From oppression and from violence he will redeem their life, and their blood will be precious in his eyes.
native_verses.72:15: And may he live, and may some of the gold of Sheba be given to him; may prayer be offered for him continually, and may he be blessed all day long.
native_verses.72:16: May there be an abundance of grain in the land on the top of the mountains; may its fruit rustle like Lebanon, and may those from the city blossom like the grass of the earth.
native_verses.72:17: May his name remain forever; as long as the sun endures, may his name continue; may people bless themselves by him; may all nations pronounce him blessed.
native_verses.72:18: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone performs wondrous deeds.
native_verses.72:19: And blessed be the name of His glory forever, and may the entire earth be filled with His glory. Amen and Amen.
native_verses.72:20: The prayers of David son of Jesse are finished.
native_verses.73:1: A psalm of Asaph. Indeed, God is good to Israel, to those pure of heart.
native_verses.73:2: Yet as for me, my feet had almost given way; my steps had all but slipped.
native_verses.73:3: For I envied the boastful, seeing the prosperity of the wicked.
native_verses.73:4: For there are no pangs at their death, and their body is plump.
native_verses.73:5: They are not in the trouble of mortals, nor are they stricken along with mankind.
native_verses.73:6: Therefore pride encircles them like a necklace; violence wraps them as a garment.
native_verses.73:7: Their eyes protrude from fatness; the imaginations of their heart overflow.
native_verses.73:8: They scoff and maliciously speak of oppression; from on high they speak.
native_verses.73:9: They set their mouth in the heavens, and their tongue walks across the earth.
native_verses.73:10: Therefore His people return here, and waters of fullness are drained by them.
native_verses.73:11: And they say, "How does God know, and is there knowledge in the Most High?"
native_verses.73:12: Look, these are the wicked, and forever carefree, they have increased their wealth.
native_verses.73:13: Indeed, in vain I have purified my heart and washed my hands in innocence.
native_verses.73:14: And I have been stricken all day long, and my chastisement comes every morning.
native_verses.73:15: If I had said, "I will speak like this," then I would have dealt treacherously with the generation of Your children.
native_verses.73:16: So when I pondered how to know this, it was trouble in my eyes,
native_verses.73:17: until I entered the sanctuaries of God; then I understood their end.
native_verses.73:18: Indeed, You set them on slippery ground; You cause them to fall into ruins.
native_verses.73:19: How they become a desolation in an instant! They are swept away, wholly consumed by terrors!
native_verses.73:20: Like a dream upon waking, Lord, when You stir Yourself, You will despise their image.
native_verses.73:21: When my heart grew embittered and I was pierced in my inward parts,
native_verses.73:22: then I was senseless and did not know; I was a brute beast with You.
native_verses.73:23: Yet I am continually with You; You have grasped my right hand.
native_verses.73:24: By Your counsel You will lead me, and afterward You will take me to glory.
native_verses.73:25: Whom do I have in heaven? And alongside You, I desire nothing on earth.
native_verses.73:26: My flesh and my heart waste away, yet God is the rock of my heart and my portion forever.
native_verses.73:27: For look, those far from You will perish; You wipe out all who prove unfaithful to You.
native_verses.73:28: But as for me, the nearness of God is good for me; I have set my refuge in the Lord GOD, to recount all Your works.
native_verses.74:1: A Maskil of Asaph. Why, God, have You cast us off forever? Why does Your anger smoke against the flock of Your pasture?
native_verses.74:2: Remember Your congregation, which You acquired of old, which You redeemed as the tribe of Your inheritance, and Mount Zion, in which You dwelt.
native_verses.74:3: Lift Your steps toward the perpetual ruins; the enemy has damaged everything in the holy place.
native_verses.74:4: Your adversaries roared within Your assembly place; they set their own signs as signs.
native_verses.74:5: It appeared like one lifting axes upward in a thicket of trees.
native_verses.74:6: And now they smash its carved work altogether with hatchet and hammers.
native_verses.74:7: They consigned Your sanctuary to the fire; they profaned the dwelling place of Your name to the ground.
native_verses.74:8: They said in their heart, "Let us crush them altogether." They burned down all the assembly places of God in the land.
native_verses.74:9: Our own signs we have not seen; there is no longer a prophet, and no one with us knows how long.
native_verses.74:10: How long, God, will the adversary taunt? Will the enemy scorn Your name forever?
native_verses.74:11: Why do You draw back Your hand and Your right hand? From the midst of Your bosom, consume them!
native_verses.74:12: Yet God is my King from of old, performing acts of salvation in the midst of the earth.
native_verses.74:13: You parted the sea by Your strength; You shattered the heads of the sea monsters upon the waters.
native_verses.74:14: You smashed the heads of Leviathan; You gave him as food to the people of the desert.
native_verses.74:15: You broke open spring and torrent; You dried up perennial rivers.
native_verses.74:16: The day is Yours, and the night is Yours also; You established the light and the sun.
native_verses.74:17: You fixed all the boundaries of the earth; summer and winter, You formed them.
native_verses.74:18: Remember this: the enemy has taunted the LORD, and a foolish people have scorned Your name.
native_verses.74:19: Do not hand over the soul of Your turtledove to the wild beast; do not forever forget the life of Your afflicted ones.
native_verses.74:20: Look to the covenant, for the dark places of the land are filled with dwellings of violence.
native_verses.74:21: Do not let the crushed one turn back humiliated; may the afflicted and the needy praise Your name.
native_verses.74:22: Arise, God, plead Your cause; remember the taunt against You from a fool all day long.
native_verses.74:23: Do not forget the voice of Your adversaries, the tumult of those rising against You, ascending continually.
native_verses.75:1: For the music director: "Do Not Destroy." A psalm of Asaph, a song.
native_verses.75:2: We give thanks to You, God; we give thanks, and Your name is near; people recount Your marvelous works.
native_verses.75:3: "When I take an appointed time, I Myself will judge with uprightness.
native_verses.75:4: The earth and all its inhabitants are melting; I Myself have steadied its pillars." Selah.
native_verses.75:5: I said to those who boast, "Do not boast," and to the wicked, "Do not raise a horn.
native_verses.75:6: Do not raise your horn on high; do not speak with a defiant neck."
native_verses.75:7: For raising up does not come from the east or from the west, nor from the wilderness;
native_verses.75:8: rather, God is judge: one He brings low, and another He raises up.
native_verses.75:9: For a cup is in the LORD's hand, and the wine foams, full of a spiced mixture, and He pours from it; indeed, all the wicked of the earth will drain out and drink its dregs.
native_verses.75:10: But I will proclaim it forever; I will sing praise to the God of Jacob.
native_verses.75:11: And I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, while the horns of the righteous will be raised high.
native_verses.76:1: For the music director, with stringed instruments. A psalm of Asaph, a song.
native_verses.76:2: God is known in Judah; in Israel His name is great.
native_verses.76:3: And His shelter is in Salem, and His dwelling is in Zion.
native_verses.76:4: There He shattered the fiery bolts of the bow, shield and sword and battle. Selah.
native_verses.76:5: Radiant are You, more majestic than the mountains of prey.
native_verses.76:6: The stouthearted were despoiled; they slept their sleep, and none of the men of valor found their hands.
native_verses.76:7: At Your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse fell into a deep sleep.
native_verses.76:8: You, You are to be feared! And who can stand before You from the moment of Your anger?
native_verses.76:9: From heaven You made judgment heard; the earth feared and grew still,
native_verses.76:10: when God rose up for judgment, to deliver all the humble of the earth. Selah.
native_verses.76:11: Surely the fury of mankind will praise You; the remnant of furies You will gird on.
native_verses.76:12: Make vows and pay them to the LORD your God; let all those around Him bring tribute to the One to be feared.
native_verses.76:13: He cuts off the spirit of rulers; to the kings of the earth, He is to be feared.
native_verses.77:1: For the music director, according to Jeduthun. A psalm of Asaph.
native_verses.77:2: My voice goes to God, and I cry out; my voice goes to God, and He will give ear to me.
native_verses.77:3: In the day of my distress I sought the Lord; at night my hand was stretched out and did not grow numb; my soul refused to be comforted.
native_verses.77:4: I remember God and I groan; I meditate, and my spirit grows faint. Selah.
native_verses.77:5: You held my eyelids open; I was deeply troubled and could not speak.
native_verses.77:6: I pondered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
native_verses.77:7: I remember my song in the night; with my heart I meditate, and my spirit searches diligently:
native_verses.77:8: Will the Lord cast off forever, and never again show favor?
native_verses.77:9: Has His loyal love come to an end forever? Has His promise ceased for all generations?
native_verses.77:10: Has God forgotten to show grace? Or has He in anger closed off His compassion? Selah.
native_verses.77:11: And I said, "This is my affliction: that the right hand of the Most High has changed."
native_verses.77:12: I will remember the acts of the LORD; indeed, I will remember Your wonders from of old.
native_verses.77:13: And I will reflect on all Your work, and on Your deeds I will meditate.
native_verses.77:14: God, Your way is in holiness. Who is a god as great as God?
native_verses.77:15: You are the God who does wonders; You have made Your strength known among the peoples.
native_verses.77:16: You redeemed Your people with Your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
native_verses.77:17: The waters saw You, God; the waters saw You and convulsed; indeed, the depths trembled.
native_verses.77:18: The clouds poured down water; the skies gave voice; even Your arrows darted to and fro.
native_verses.77:19: The voice of Your thunder was in the whirlwind; lightning flashes illuminated the world; the earth trembled and quaked.
native_verses.77:20: Your way was in the sea, and Your path in great waters, and Your footprints were not known.
native_verses.77:21: You guided Your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
native_verses.78:1: A Maskil of Asaph. Listen closely, my people, to my instruction; incline your ear to the sayings of my mouth.
native_verses.78:2: With a parable I will open my mouth; I will pour forth riddles from ancient times,
native_verses.78:3: things we have heard and come to know, and that our fathers have recounted to us.
native_verses.78:4: We will not conceal them from their children, recounting to a future generation the praises of the LORD, and His might, and His wondrous deeds that He has done.
native_verses.78:5: He established a testimony in Jacob and placed a law in Israel, which He commanded our fathers to make known to their children,
native_verses.78:6: so that a future generation would know them, children yet to be born, and would arise and recount them to their children,
native_verses.78:7: and place their confidence in God, and not forget the acts of God, but observe His commandments,
native_verses.78:8: and not be like their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that did not make its heart steadfast and whose spirit was not faithful with God.
native_verses.78:9: The sons of Ephraim, armed and shooting with the bow, turned back on the day of battle.
native_verses.78:10: They did not keep the covenant of God, and in His law they refused to walk.
native_verses.78:11: And they forgot His acts and His wondrous deeds that He had shown them.
native_verses.78:12: In the presence of their fathers He worked wonders in the land of Egypt, the field of Zoan.
native_verses.78:13: He split the sea and brought them across, and He caused the waters to stand like a heap.
native_verses.78:14: He guided them with the cloud by day, and all through the night with the light of fire.
native_verses.78:15: He split open rocks in the wilderness and gave them drink as from the great depths.
native_verses.78:16: He brought out flowing streams from the crag and made waters run down like rivers.
native_verses.78:17: Yet they continued even more to sin against Him, rebelling against the Most High in the dry land.
native_verses.78:18: And they tested God in their heart by asking for food for their appetite.
native_verses.78:19: And they spoke against God; they said, "Is God able to set a table in the wilderness?
native_verses.78:20: Look, He struck the rock and waters gushed out, and torrents overflowed; is He able to give bread as well, or will He prepare meat for His people?"
native_verses.78:21: Therefore the LORD heard and grew furious, so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also rose against Israel,
native_verses.78:22: because they did not believe in God, nor did they trust in His deliverance.
native_verses.78:23: Nevertheless, He commanded the clouds on high, and He opened the doors of heaven;
native_verses.78:24: He rained down manna on them to eat, and the grain of heaven He gave them.
native_verses.78:25: Man ate the bread of the mighty ones; He sent them provisions to the full.
native_verses.78:26: He sent forth the east wind in the heavens, and by His might He drove on the south wind.
native_verses.78:27: And He rained down on them meat like dust, and winged birds like the sand of the seas;
native_verses.78:28: and He caused them to fall in the middle of their camp, all around their dwellings.
native_verses.78:29: So they ate and were thoroughly satisfied, and their craving He brought to them.
native_verses.78:30: They had not turned away from their craving, and their food was still in their mouths,
native_verses.78:31: when the anger of God rose against them, and He killed some of their sturdiest ones and brought low the young men of Israel.
native_verses.78:32: Despite all this, they sinned still more and did not believe in His wondrous deeds.
native_verses.78:33: So He ended their days in emptiness, and their years in terror.
native_verses.78:34: Whenever He killed them, they would seek Him; they would turn back and eagerly seek God.
native_verses.78:35: Then they remembered that God was their rock, and God Most High was their redeemer.
native_verses.78:36: Yet they flattered Him with their mouths, and with their tongues they lied to Him.
native_verses.78:37: And their heart was not steadfast with Him, and they were not faithful in His covenant.
native_verses.78:38: Yet He was compassionate; He pardoned iniquity and did not destroy them, and many times He turned back His anger and did not rouse all His wrath.
native_verses.78:39: And He remembered that they were flesh, a wind that goes away and does not return.
native_verses.78:40: How many times they rebelled against Him in the wilderness; they grieved Him in the wasteland!
native_verses.78:41: Again they tested God, and they caused pain to the Holy One of Israel.
native_verses.78:42: They did not remember His hand, the day when He ransomed them from the adversary,
native_verses.78:43: when He set His signs in Egypt and His portents in the field of Zoan.
native_verses.78:44: And He turned their canals into blood, and their flowing streams they could not drink.
native_verses.78:45: He sent against them swarms of flies that devoured them, and frogs that destroyed them.
native_verses.78:46: He gave their produce to the devouring locust, and their labor to the locust.
native_verses.78:47: He killed their vines with hail, and their sycamore trees with frost.
native_verses.78:48: He handed over their cattle to the hail, and their herds to lightning bolts.
native_verses.78:49: He sent against them the fierceness of His anger: fury, indignation, and distress, a troop of messengers of disaster.
native_verses.78:50: He made a level path for His anger; He did not hold back their soul from death, and their life He handed over to the plague.
native_verses.78:51: And He struck every firstborn in Egypt, the firstfruits of vigor in the tents of Ham.
native_verses.78:52: Then He brought forth His people like sheep and led them along like a flock in the wilderness.
native_verses.78:53: He guided them in safety, and they did not fear, while the sea covered their enemies.
native_verses.78:54: And He brought them to His holy territory, this mountain that His right hand acquired.
native_verses.78:55: He drove out nations from before them, allotted them by a measuring line as an inheritance, and caused the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
native_verses.78:56: Yet they tested and rebelled against God Most High, and His testimonies they did not keep.
native_verses.78:57: They drew back and dealt treacherously like their fathers; they twisted aside like a deceitful bow.
native_verses.78:58: And they angered Him with their high places, and with their carved images they stirred Him to jealousy.
native_verses.78:59: God heard and grew furious, and He completely rejected Israel.
native_verses.78:60: He abandoned the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent He had set up among humankind.
native_verses.78:61: He gave His might into captivity, and His splendor into the hand of the adversary.
native_verses.78:62: And He handed over His people to the sword, and with His inheritance He grew furious.
native_verses.78:63: Fire consumed their young men, and their young women were not celebrated with wedding songs.
native_verses.78:64: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows did not weep.
native_verses.78:65: Then the Lord awoke like one asleep, like a warrior shouting aloud from wine.
native_verses.78:66: He struck His adversaries backward; He gave them everlasting disgrace.
native_verses.78:67: And He rejected the tent of Joseph, and the tribe of Ephraim He did not choose;
native_verses.78:68: rather, He chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which He loved.
native_verses.78:69: He built His sanctuary like the heights, like the earth that He established forever.
native_verses.78:70: And He chose His servant David and took him from the sheep pens;
native_verses.78:71: from behind the nursing ewes He brought him, to shepherd His people Jacob and His inheritance Israel.
native_verses.78:72: And he shepherded them according to the integrity of his heart, and with the skill of his hands he guided them.
native_verses.79:1: A psalm of Asaph. God, nations have entered Your inheritance; they have defiled the temple of Your holiness; they have made Jerusalem into heaps of ruins.
native_verses.79:2: They have given the corpses of Your servants as food to the birds of the sky, the flesh of Your faithful ones to the beasts of the earth.
native_verses.79:3: They have poured out their blood like water around Jerusalem, and there is no one to bury them.
native_verses.79:4: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, mockery and ridicule to those around us.
native_verses.79:5: How long, LORD? Will You remain angry forever? Will Your jealousy blaze like fire?
native_verses.79:6: Pour out Your fury on the nations that do not know You, and on kingdoms that do not call on Your name.
native_verses.79:7: For they have devoured Jacob and made his dwelling place desolate.
native_verses.79:8: Do not remember against us former iniquities; let Your mercies come quickly to meet us, for we have sunk very low.
native_verses.79:9: Help us, God of our salvation, on account of the glory of Your name; rescue us and make atonement for our sins for the sake of Your name.
native_verses.79:10: Why should the nations say, "Where is their God?" Let vengeance for the blood of Your servants that has been poured out be made known among the nations before our eyes.
native_verses.79:11: May the groaning of the prisoner come before You; according to the greatness of Your arm, spare those condemned to die.
native_verses.79:12: And pay back to our neighbors sevenfold into their lap their reproach, with which they reproached You, Lord.
native_verses.79:13: And we, Your people and the flock of Your pasture, will give thanks to You forever; from generation to generation we will declare Your praise.
native_verses.80:1: For the music director, according to Lilies. A testimony; a psalm of Asaph.
native_verses.80:2: Shepherd of Israel, give ear, You who guide Joseph like a flock; You who sit enthroned on the cherubim, shine forth.
native_verses.80:3: Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, awaken Your might, and come for our salvation.
native_verses.80:4: God, restore us, and make Your face shine, that we may be saved.
native_verses.80:5: LORD God of hosts, how long will You fume against the prayer of Your people?
native_verses.80:6: You have fed them bread of tears and made them drink tears by the large measure.
native_verses.80:7: You make us a cause of strife to our neighbors, and our enemies mock among themselves.
native_verses.80:8: God of hosts, restore us, and make Your face shine, that we may be saved.
native_verses.80:9: You brought a vine from Egypt; You expelled nations and planted it.
native_verses.80:10: You cleared space before it, and it put down its roots and filled the land.
native_verses.80:11: Mountains were covered by its shade, and the cedars of God by its branches.
native_verses.80:12: It sent out its boughs as far as the sea, and its young shoots to the River.
native_verses.80:13: Why have You breached its walls, so that all who pass along the road pluck from it?
native_verses.80:14: A boar from the forest gnaws it down, and creatures of the field graze on it.
native_verses.80:15: God of hosts, please turn back; look down from heaven and see, and watch over this vine,
native_verses.80:16: and the rootstock that Your right hand planted, and over the son whom You strengthened for Yourself.
native_verses.80:17: It is burned by fire, it is cut off; at the rebuke of Your face they perish.
native_verses.80:18: May Your hand be on the man of Your right hand, on the son of man whom You strengthened for Yourself.
native_verses.80:19: So we will not turn away from You; give us life, and we will call on Your name.
native_verses.80:20: LORD God of hosts, restore us; make Your face shine, that we may be saved.
native_verses.81:1: For the music director, according to the Gittith. Of Asaph.
native_verses.81:2: Sing joyfully to God our strength; shout in triumph to the God of Jacob.
native_verses.81:3: Lift up a song and strike the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.
native_verses.81:4: Blow the ram's horn at the new moon, at the full moon, for the day of our festival.
native_verses.81:5: For it is a statute for Israel, a ruling of the God of Jacob.
native_verses.81:6: He set it as a testimony in Joseph when He went out against the land of Egypt. I hear a language I did not know:
native_verses.81:7: "I removed his shoulder from the burden; his hands were released from the basket.
native_verses.81:8: In distress you called out, and I rescued you; I answered you in the cover of thunder; I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah.
native_verses.81:9: Listen, My people, and let Me admonish you; Israel, if only you would listen to Me!
native_verses.81:10: There must be no strange god among you, and you must not bow down to a foreign god.
native_verses.81:11: I am the LORD your God, the One who brought you up from the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, that I may fill it.
native_verses.81:12: Yet My people did not listen to My voice, and Israel would not yield to Me.
native_verses.81:13: So I let them go in the stubbornness of their heart, to walk in their own counsels.
native_verses.81:14: If only My people were listening to Me, if Israel would walk in My ways!
native_verses.81:15: In a moment I would subdue their enemies, and against their adversaries I would turn back My hand.
native_verses.81:16: Those who hate the LORD would feign obedience to Him, and their time would last forever.
native_verses.81:17: And He would feed him with the choicest wheat, and from the rock I would satisfy you with honey."
native_verses.82:1: A psalm of Asaph. God has stationed Himself in the assembly of God; in the midst of the gods He judges:
native_verses.82:2: "How long will you judge with injustice and show favor to the wicked? Selah.
native_verses.82:3: Judge for the weak and the orphan; vindicate the afflicted and the poor.
native_verses.82:4: Deliver the weak and the needy; rescue them from the hand of the wicked.
native_verses.82:5: They do not know, nor do they understand; they go about in darkness; all the foundations of the earth totter.
native_verses.82:6: I Myself said, 'You are gods, and you are all sons of the Most High.'
native_verses.82:7: Yet like mortals you will die, and like one of the princes you will fall."
native_verses.82:8: Rise up, God, judge the earth, for You Yourself inherit all the nations.
native_verses.83:1: A song, a psalm of Asaph.
native_verses.83:2: God, let there be no stillness for You; do not stay silent, and do not remain quiet, God.
native_verses.83:3: For look, Your enemies are in tumult, and those who hate You have lifted up their heads.
native_verses.83:4: Against Your people they shrewdly devise secret counsel, and they take counsel together against Your sheltered ones.
native_verses.83:5: They have said, "Come, and let us blot them out from being a nation, so that the name of Israel will no longer be remembered."
native_verses.83:6: For with one heart they have taken counsel together; against You they strike a covenant:
native_verses.83:7: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the Hagrites,
native_verses.83:8: Gebal and Ammon and Amalek, Philistia with the residents of Tyre.
native_verses.83:9: Assyria also has allied itself with them; they have become an arm for the sons of Lot. Selah.
native_verses.83:10: Do to them as to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin at the Kishon stream.
native_verses.83:11: They were wiped out at En-dor; they became dung for the soil.
native_verses.83:12: Make their nobles like Oreb and like Zeeb, and all their rulers like Zebah and like Zalmunna,
native_verses.83:13: who said, "Let us take possession of the pastures of God for ourselves."
native_verses.83:14: My God, make them like tumbleweed, like stubble before the wind.
native_verses.83:15: As fire burns a forest, and as a flame scorches mountains,
native_verses.83:16: so pursue them with Your storm, and with Your whirlwind terrify them.
native_verses.83:17: Fill their faces with disgrace, so that they may seek Your name, LORD.
native_verses.83:18: May they be ashamed and terrified forever; may they be humiliated and perish;
native_verses.83:19: and let them know that You—Your name is the LORD—alone are Most High over all the earth.
native_verses.84:1: For the music director, upon the Gittith. A psalm of the sons of Korah.
native_verses.84:2: How beloved are Your dwelling places, LORD of hosts!
native_verses.84:3: My soul yearns and even grows faint for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh cry out joyfully to the living God.
native_verses.84:4: Even a bird has found a house, and a swallow a nest for herself where she sets her fledglings, beside Your altars, LORD of hosts, my King and my God.
native_verses.84:5: Blessed are those who dwell in Your house; continually they praise You. Selah.
native_verses.84:6: Blessed is the person whose strength is in You; highways are in their heart.
native_verses.84:7: Passing through the valley of Baca, they turn it into a spring; the early rain also clothes it with blessings.
native_verses.84:8: They walk from strength to strength; each appears before God in Zion.
native_verses.84:9: LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer; listen, God of Jacob. Selah.
native_verses.84:10: Look upon our shield, God, and regard the face of Your anointed.
native_verses.84:11: For better is a day in Your courts than a thousand; I have chosen to stand at the threshold in the house of my God rather than to lodge in tents of wickedness.
native_verses.84:12: For the LORD God is sun and shield; the LORD gives favor and glory; He does not withhold good from those who walk in integrity.
native_verses.84:13: LORD of hosts, blessed is the person who trusts in You.
native_verses.85:1: For the music director. Of the sons of Korah. A psalm.
native_verses.85:2: LORD, You favored Your land; You turned back the captivity of Jacob.
native_verses.85:3: You pardoned the iniquity of Your people; You covered over all their sin. Selah.
native_verses.85:4: You drew back all Your wrath; You turned back from the burning of Your anger.
native_verses.85:5: Restore us, God of our salvation, and put an end to Your indignation with us.
native_verses.85:6: Will You stay angry with us forever? Will You draw out Your anger to generation after generation?
native_verses.85:7: Will You not turn and give us life again, so that Your people may be glad in You?
native_verses.85:8: Show us, LORD, Your loyal love, and give us Your salvation.
native_verses.85:9: I will listen to what God the LORD will speak, for He will speak peace to His people and to His loyal ones; and may they not turn back to folly.
native_verses.85:10: Truly, His salvation is close to those who fear Him, for glory to dwell in our land.
native_verses.85:11: Loyal love and truth have met one another; righteousness and peace have kissed.
native_verses.85:12: Truth sprouts from the earth, and righteousness gazes down from heaven.
native_verses.85:13: The LORD will also give what is good, and our land will give its produce.
native_verses.85:14: Righteousness will walk ahead of Him and make a path of His steps.
native_verses.86:1: A prayer of David. Bend Your ear, LORD, answer me, for I am afflicted and needy.
native_verses.86:2: Guard my soul, for I am loyal; You are my God—save Your servant who trusts in You.
native_verses.86:3: Be gracious to me, Lord, for to You I call all day long.
native_verses.86:4: Bring gladness to the soul of Your servant, for to You, Lord, I lift my soul.
native_verses.86:5: For You, Lord, are good and forgiving, and abundant in loyal love to all who call on You.
native_verses.86:6: Give ear to my prayer, LORD, and pay attention to the voice of my pleas for grace.
native_verses.86:7: On the day of my distress I call to You, for You will answer me.
native_verses.86:8: No one among the gods is like You, Lord, and nothing is like Your deeds.
native_verses.86:9: All nations that You have made will come and bow down before You, Lord, and honor Your name.
native_verses.86:10: For You are great and perform wonders; You are God alone.
native_verses.86:11: Instruct me, LORD, in Your way; I will walk in Your truth. Unify my heart to fear Your name.
native_verses.86:12: I will thank You, Lord my God, with all my heart, and I will honor Your name forever.
native_verses.86:13: For Your loyal love is great toward me, and You have rescued my soul from lowest Sheol.
native_verses.86:14: God, insolent men have risen against me, and a company of ruthless men have sought my life, and they have not placed You before them.
native_verses.86:15: But You, Lord, are a God compassionate and gracious, slow to anger and abundant in loyal love and truth.
native_verses.86:16: Turn toward me and be gracious to me; grant Your strength to Your servant, and save the son of Your female servant.
native_verses.86:17: Perform a sign for good on my behalf, so that those who hate me may see and be shamed, because You, LORD, have helped me and consoled me.
native_verses.87:1: Of the sons of Korah. A psalm, a song. His foundation is on the holy mountains.
native_verses.87:2: The LORD loves the gates of Zion above all the dwellings of Jacob.
native_verses.87:3: Glorious things are spoken concerning you, city of God. Selah.
native_verses.87:4: "I will name Rahab and Babylon among those who know Me; look, Philistia and Tyre, together with Cush—this one was born there."
native_verses.87:5: And concerning Zion it will be said, "Each and every one was born in her," and He, the Most High, will establish her.
native_verses.87:6: The LORD will count as He writes down the peoples, "This one was born there." Selah.
native_verses.87:7: And singers as well as dancers will say, "All my wellsprings are in you."
native_verses.88:1: A song, a psalm of the sons of Korah. For the music director, set to Mahalath Leannoth. A Maskil of Heman the Ezrahite.
native_verses.88:2: LORD, God of my salvation, by day I have cried out, and at night before You.
native_verses.88:3: May my prayer come into Your presence; turn Your ear to my outcry.
native_verses.88:4: For my soul has had its fill of calamities, and my life has reached Sheol.
native_verses.88:5: I am numbered with those going down to the pit; I have become like a man with no strength,
native_verses.88:6: turned loose among the dead, like those killed who lie in the grave, whom You no longer remember, and they have been severed from Your hand.
native_verses.88:7: You have placed me in the lowest pit, in dark regions, in the deeps.
native_verses.88:8: Upon me Your wrath has pressed heavily, and with all Your breakers You have afflicted me. Selah.
native_verses.88:9: You have put my acquaintances far from me; You have made me an utter abomination to them. I am confined and cannot go out.
native_verses.88:10: My eye languishes from affliction; I have called to You, LORD, every day; I have spread out my palms to You.
native_verses.88:11: Will You work a wonder for the dead? Or will the shades rise up and praise You? Selah.
native_verses.88:12: Will Your loyal love be recounted in the grave, or Your faithfulness in Abaddon?
native_verses.88:13: Will Your wonder become known in the darkness, and Your righteousness in a land of forgetfulness?
native_verses.88:14: But I have cried to You for help, LORD, and in the morning my prayer comes to meet You.
native_verses.88:15: Why, LORD, do You spurn my soul and hide Your face from me?
native_verses.88:16: I am afflicted and perishing from youth; I have borne Your terrors; I am numb.
native_verses.88:17: Over me Your fierce anger has swept; Your horrors have annihilated me.
native_verses.88:18: Like water they have surrounded me all day long; they have closed around me as one.
native_verses.88:19: You have put loved one and companion far from me; my acquaintances are darkness.
native_verses.89:1: A Maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite.
native_verses.89:2: Of the LORD's acts of loyal love I will sing forever; to every generation I will make Your faithfulness known with my mouth.
native_verses.89:3: For I have said, "Forever loyal love will be built up; as for the heavens, You establish Your faithfulness in them."
native_verses.89:4: "I have cut a covenant with My chosen one; I have sworn an oath to My servant David,
native_verses.89:5: 'Forever I will establish your seed, and I will build up your throne to every generation.'" Selah.
native_verses.89:6: And the heavens will praise Your wonder, LORD, indeed Your faithfulness in the assembly of the holy ones.
native_verses.89:7: For who in the skies compares with the LORD? Who resembles the LORD among the divine beings?
native_verses.89:8: God is greatly revered in the council of the holy ones, and awe-inspiring above all who surround Him.
native_verses.89:9: LORD, God of hosts, who is mighty like You, LORD? And Your faithfulness is all around You.
native_verses.89:10: You rule over the surging of the sea; when its waves lift up, You calm them.
native_verses.89:11: You crushed Rahab like one killed; with the arm of Your strength You scattered Your enemies.
native_verses.89:12: Yours are the heavens, and Yours too is the earth; the world and its fullness, You founded them.
native_verses.89:13: North and south, You created them; Tabor and Hermon ring out with joy at Your name.
native_verses.89:14: Yours is an arm with might; Your hand is strong, and Your right hand is lifted high.
native_verses.89:15: Righteousness and justice are the base of Your throne; loyal love and truth go before Your face.
native_verses.89:16: Blessed are the people who know the shout of joy; LORD, in the light of Your face they walk.
native_verses.89:17: In Your name they exult all day long, and by Your righteousness they are lifted high.
native_verses.89:18: For You are the splendor of their strength, and by Your favor our horn is lifted high.
native_verses.89:19: For to the LORD belongs our shield, and to the Holy One of Israel belongs our king.
native_verses.89:20: Then You spoke in a vision to Your loyal ones and said, "I have placed help upon a mighty warrior; I have lifted high a chosen one from the people.
native_verses.89:21: I have found My servant David; I have anointed him with My holy oil,
native_verses.89:22: with whom My hand will remain established; indeed, My arm will make him strong.
native_verses.89:23: No enemy will exact tribute from him, nor will a son of injustice afflict him.
native_verses.89:24: And I will smash his adversaries before his face, and those who hate him I will strike down.
native_verses.89:25: And My faithfulness and My loyal love will be with him, and in My name his horn will be lifted high.
native_verses.89:26: And I will place his hand upon the sea, and his right hand upon the rivers.
native_verses.89:27: He will call out to Me, 'You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.'
native_verses.89:28: And I too will appoint him as firstborn, the highest above the kings of the earth.
native_verses.89:29: Forever I will keep My loyal love for him, and My covenant will remain faithful to him.
native_verses.89:30: And I will set his seed for all time, and his throne like the days of the heavens.
native_verses.89:31: If his sons abandon My law and do not walk in My ordinances,
native_verses.89:32: if they profane My statutes and do not keep My commands,
native_verses.89:33: then I will punish their rebellion with a rod and their iniquity with blows.
